notes: Parsed from the {{Ability}} (= Template:Infobox hero ability) calls in the '== Abilities ==' section of each hero page.

slot: passive / skill1 / skill2 / ultimate, derived from the section heading; 'other' for extra sections (transformations, alternate forms, Skill 4, etc.). `heading` keeps the original wiki heading path.
cooldown / manaCost / energyCost are per skill level (skills: levels 1-6, ultimate: levels 1-3) in seconds / mana points. Raw text is kept in `raw` when the value is not a pure numeric list.

scalings: one entry per {{scale}} template in the description, in order of appearance. base 'a-b' means value at skill level 1 to max level; ratios are % of the named stat (or × for per-level / lifesteal).
levelScaling: 'Label: v1 / v2 / ...' lines parsed from the level-scaling, ult-level-scaling, hero-level-scaling, stack-scaling and properties fields.
ccTypes is a keyword heuristic over description + notes (stun, slow, airborne, suppress, ...). Verify before relying on it; skillEffects are the wiki's own tags (Burst, AoE, CC, Slowed, Buff...).
Ranges are in in-game units only when the wiki states them (castRange field or inside text); most pages do not provide areas/ranges.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Moon Blessing
skills.description:
Each time Miya hits a target with her Basic Attack, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a Moonlight Shadow with each Basic Attack that deals 30 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Moon Arrow
skills.description: Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack, dealing 10-35 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4 seconds. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts upon casting.
*This skill cannot be cast again until its duration ends.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Arrow of Eclipse
skills.description: Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing 270-420 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing 40-105 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Hidden Moonlight
skills.description:
Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 65% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2 seconds or until she launches an attack.
Miya gains full stacks of Moon Blessing upon leaving the state.
skills.notes: *"Attacks" that end the duration of Moon Blessing only refer to Miya's basic attacks and her non-ultimate skill casts.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Bloodthirst
skills.description: Balmond recovers 5% Max HP after killing a Minion or Creep, and 20% Max HP after killing a hero.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Soul Lock
skills.description: Balmond charges to the target direction for a set distance or until he hits an enemy hero, dealing 150-275 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. The enemy hero hit will be knocked back slightly, and will have their Movement Speed reduced by 40% and Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 3 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Cyclone Sweep
skills.description:
Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed that decays over time and spins his axe for 3 seconds, dealing 25-100 (+25% Total Physical Attack) (+2% Extra HP) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times. Each subsequent hit on the same enemy will deal 8.5% increased damage (up to 68%).
The Physical Attack bonus portion of the damage can Crit.
skills.notes:
*Cyclone Sweep can only be cancelled by using his other skills. (added Patch Notes 1.7.82)
*Cyclone Sweep cannot be interrupted by Crowd Control. (added Patch Notes 1.8.44)

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Lethal Counter
skills.description:
Balmond unleashes a huge strike in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+target's 30%-45% Lost HP) True Damage.
This skill only deals up to 1000–2000 damage to non-hero units.
skills.notes: *Does not show an area of effect pre-animation with Savage Pointguard skin.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Enemy's Bane
skills.description: Saber's attacks reduce enemies' Physical Defense by 3–8 for 5 seconds on hit. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
skills.notes:
*"Attacks" that reduces physical defense only refer to Saber's basic attack and skill damage.
*Defense reduction can only be applied to non-minion enemies.
*The defense reduction is immediately applied to the first attack dealt.
*Unlike most level-based scaling, Saber's passive value does not depend on a formula. It will simply increase by 1 when a certain level is reached.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Orbiting Swords
skills.description:
Saber shoots out 5 swords that orbit around him, dealing 80-105 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies
on contact. After orbiting around Saber for roughly 5 seconds, the swords will fly back to Saber.
Within the duration of this skill, when Saber deals damage with his Basic Attacks or skills, he will send an orbiting sword towards the target, dealing 210-260 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the main target and 50% of the damage to other targets it passes through and reducing the cooldown of Charge by 1 second. It deals only 50% damage to all non-hero enemies such as minions and creeps.
skills.notes:
*When attacking a turret, Saber will still shoot a sword toward it and reduce Charge's cooldown, but will not deal damage to it.
*Saber can cast Orbiting Swords during dashes and in motion using joystick. (Patch Notes 1.6.84). In order to cast Orbiting Swords during Triple Sweep, input must be quickly made during the initial dash. Saber will be rendered unable to cast Orbiting Swords after knocking up an enemy.
*The shooting swords' extra damage will prioritize targets in this order: Visible main target → Visible enemy heroes → Invisible main target. Some situations such as using Triple Sweep on a target inside bush while Saber himself is outside of the bush (therefore making the main target concealed) and an enemy appears on the screen, will cause the shooting swords to home in on latter enemy instead. This interaction will even prioritize targeting visible minions over invisible main target.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Charge
skills.description: Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75-150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way while enhancing his next Basic Attack. Saber can dash to the target, and his enhanced Basic Attack deals 75-150 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows the target by 60% for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Despite its name, "Charge" is technically a blink skill, therefore it can go through obstacles.
*The enhanced basic attack has a range of 2.5.
*There is a bug where, if the enhanced basic attack is triggered but somehow fails to land, the enhanced basic attack will still be consumed.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Triple Sweep
skills.description: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2 seconds and striking them 3 times over the duration. The first two strikes deal 120-180 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third strike deals 240-360 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes:
*If Saber is killed during Triple Sweep's duration, the enemy will stay airborne, but no further damage will be dealt.
*Saber's and the enemy target's camera height increases within the skill's duration.
*If Triple Sweep fails to land due to certain circumstances (such as invincibility or enemy's death), Saber will abruptly stop executing the skill and the skill will start on cooldown.
*After Saber knocks up an enemy, Triple Sweep can only be interrupted by suppressed. However, the initial dash Saber makes is considered a blink, therefore rendering it vulnerable to be cancelled by knockback and airborne if Saber was hit before he could reach the enemy. Due to this, Triple Sweep is also unusable when affected by root and immobilize.
**As the blink is considered a separate phase, activating Winter Crown during it will halt Saber in place and cancel the knock-up part entirely.
*Saber can cast Retribution during the duration of this skill.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Crimson Blood Banquet
skills.description:
When Alice's skills hit, she gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson, lasting 4 seconds. Once Crimson reaches 2 stacks, Blood Banquet activates, dealing 25 (+30% Total Magic Power) plus 0.5%~2.5% of the target's Max HP  (scales with level) as Magic Damage to nearby units (hitting heroes with skills refreshes the duration) and recovering 10 (+3% Extra HP) HP for Alice every 0.5 seconds.
While Blood Banquet is active, Alice gains 8% Movement Speed. Blood Banquet can deal up to 70(+10*Hero Level) Magic Damage to creeps.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Crimson Gleam
skills.description: Alice fires blood energy forward, dealing 100-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Before the blood energy dissipates, this skill can be cast again to activate Scarlet Shadow, allowing Alice to blink to the blood energy's location.
skills.notes:
*Crimson Cleam's cooldown starts after the stream disappears or is casted again.
*Player can hold the skill button to locate the blood sphere.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Doom Waltz
skills.description: Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350-550 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1 second. If Blood Banquet is active at this time, it also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of Blood Banquet's damage and healing Alice for the same amount.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Throne of Ruin
skills.description:
Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%. After 1.5 seconds, she descends with force, dealing 500-700 (+150% Total Magic Power) (+20% Extra HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1 second.
While charging her Ultimate, Alice can only use Scarlet Shadow

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Molina's Gift
skills.description:
Upon taking fatal damage, Nana removes all debuffs on her and transforms, becoming untargetable and invincible, and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. She also recovers 10% Max HP over the duration.
Nana can only transform once every 150 seconds and cannot cast skills in the transformed form.
skills.notes:
*A visual indicator is shown around Nana when Molina's Gift is ready. (see Patch Notes 1.6.58)
*If Nana has Immortality available, Molina's Gift will trigger first, end does not cancel Yin's My Turn.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Magic Boomerang
skills.description: Nana hurls her Magical Boomerang in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. The boomerang deals 320-440 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy For every additional enemy hit, the damage is reduced by 20%  (max reduction of 60%).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Molina Smooch
skills.description:
Nana summons Molina at the target location. After a short delay. Molina will chase the nearest enemy hero in range for 2.5 seconds. Molina will deal 250-375 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hero it collides with and transform them for 1.5 seconds, and also slow them by 50% and reduce their Magic Defense by 25% for the duration.
If there are no enemy heroes in range, Molina will disappear after 12 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Affected enemies are revealed.
*Molina will chase the enemy hero at an exponential rate[how much?] before it disappears.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Molina Blitz
skills.description:
Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each time dealing  440-660 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within the area and slowing them by 50% for 1 second.
Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1 second.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Fearless
skills.description:
Tigreal gains a stack of Fearless each time he casts a skills or is hit by Basic Attack. After getting 4 stacks, Tigreal will consume all Fearless stacks to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from turrets).
Attacks from Minions do not grant Fearless atacks nor trigger this effect.
skills.notes:
*Fearless stacks will completely deplete 6 seconds after Tigreal is unable to maintain it.
*Fully gain stacks from Lord and Turtle damage but not Altar.
*Only gain stack from Implosion after the pull step.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Attack Wave
skills.description: Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer and sends a shockwave forward that erupts 3 times, each time dealing 270-520 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the fan-shaped area and slowing them by 20%/40%/60% for 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*The wave travel at the same speed with his Sacred Hammer.
**It is possible for a unit to be hit by multiple waves.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Sacred Hammer
skills.description:
Tigreal charges in a target direction, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge.
Used Again: Tigreal can cast this skill again within 4 seconds, dealing 280-380 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts when the skill is first cast.
*Tigreal can blink by using the battle spell, Flicker, during this skill.
*The knockback will control enemies for the full duration if they do not use CC immune.
**If an enemy is hit by the end of this ability, they will be briefly knockbacked and stunned in position instead.
**Which means the total duration can be reduced by resilience if stunned.
*Death removes the second phase.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Implosion
skills.description:
Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, stunning and pulling nearby enemies to him for 2 seconds while dealing 270-430 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects. The second part of the channeling cannot be interrupted except by Suppression.
skills.notes:
*Tigreal can blink by using the battle spell, Flicker, during this skill.
*The skill executes in 3 steps.
**Delay step. Tigreal applies a weak pull which doesn't count as knockback. It now applies stun, and it goes into cooldown if cancelled.
**Pull step. Tigreal pulls enemies towards him. It doesn't stun yet, but it immobilizes. When ultimate is cancelled in this step, it goes into cooldown.
**Stun. Tigreal stuns his enemies for 2s while dealing damage.
*Can pull through obstacles. If the enemy does not pass by the obstacle, they will be displaced next to Tigreal at the time of stun.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Pursuit
skills.description: After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: The range of Pursuit can be increased by Malefic Gun and its passive Malefic Energy.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Groundsplitter
skills.description: Alucard jumps to the target area and slashes, dealing 270-370 (+80pd% Extra Physical Attack) to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Whirling Smash
skills.description: Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345-570 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Fission Wave
skills.description:
Passive: Alucard permanently gains 10%-30% extra Hybrid Lifesteal.
Active: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10-20. Alucard gains 10-20 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6 seconds.
Use Again: Alucard releases a powerful shockwave in the target direction, dealing 400-700 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.
skills.calc: ${\rm total\ CD\ reduction} = (skill\ CD\ - CD\ reduction\ attribute%) - 50%$
skills.notes:
*Fission Wave goes into cooldown on the first cast.
*Despite the Fission Wave's Active description, Alucard can still gain the buff even if there are no enemies in the target direction during the initial cast.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Shadow Combo
skills.description:
Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra True Damage equal to 50 plus 5 (+2.5% Total Magic Power)% of their lost HP (up to 2000 True Damage against creeps).
If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*"Attack," according to the skill description, only refers to Karina's attack from basic attacks and skills.
*Marks applied by basic attacks cannot be stacked by Endless Battle's Unique Passive–Endless Strike.
*Shadow Combo deals up to 10000 True Damage to enemy heroes.
*Shadow Combo marks are invisible on minions.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Dance of Blades
skills.description:
Karina enters the Dance of Blades state for 3.5 seconds, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects 100-200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4 seconds).
Karina's Basic Attack within the duration deals 150-255 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, slows the target by 45% for 1 second, and is guaranteed critical strike. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades state early.
skills.notes:
*Enhanced basic attack does not have splash damage.
*Dance of Blades' cooldown will not start when it is still active.
*Karina launches a spinning slash when attacked in melee. This is purely visual.
*The damage reflection effect's cooldown is affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Dance of Death
skills.description: Karina launces a spinning slash, dealing 375-600 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Shadow Assault
skills.description:
Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing 350-750 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, applying a Shadow Mark to them, and leaving a Shadowform behind them. The Shadow Mark and Shadowform both last 5 seconds. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset.
Use Again: Karina dashes back to the Shadowform's location, dealing 150-250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Tai Chi
skills.description:
Akai gains a 25 (+5% Total HP) shield for 4 seconds on each skill cast and can marks enemy heroes and Creeps hit by his skills.
Akai's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+5% Total HP) extra Physical Damage to mark enemies.
skills.notes: *The duration and absorption of the shield are refreshed upon skill casting, but they cannot be stacked.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Headbutt
skills.description:
Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the away. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knocks them airborne for 0.5 seconds and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once.
Akai can cast Headbutt during Heavy Spin to quickly adjust his position.
skills.notes: *Despite its description, Headbutt's "charge" is technically a blink.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Body Slam
skills.description: Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing 270-420 (+6% Total HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Heavy Spin
skills.description:
Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4 seconds, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing 200-450 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemies heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process.
Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed to 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression and Morph effects.
skills.notes:
*When canceling this skill, it does not trigger Tai Chi, but it does count as casting a skill for passives (such "Thunderbolt" from Thunder Belt).
*Akai can use Heavy Spin again to cancel it 0.5 seconds after the first cast.
*Heavy Spin damage is reduced to 50% when hitting the same target.
*This skill also stuns enemies on each collision.[how long?]
*Entering or leaving Yin's My Turn cancel this ability.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Wasteland Force
skills.description:
If no damage is taken within 5 seconds, Franco gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% Max HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force (up to 10 stacks).
Franco will consume all Wasteland Force stacks on his next skill cast to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.
skills.notes: *If the stack has been consumed while the passive is active, Franco has to receive damage or the stack won't start accumulating again.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Iron Hook
skills.description: Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400-650 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage dragging them to Franco.
skills.notes:
*The hook will pull to Franco's current position, which can be extended or repositioned by Flicker.
*The hook first applies stun, then the pulling effect.
**When the hook hits a target, it plays a different sound and lingers briefly before returning.
**Some abilities providing CC Immune may fail to remove the pulling effect. e.g. Soul Sever, An Eye for An Eye.
*Fully affect invisible and concealed enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Fury Shock
skills.description: Franco lashes out, dealing Physical Damage equal to 300–450 plus 4% of his Max HP to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Bloody Hunt
skills.description: Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8 seconds and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: *Ability ends prematurely when being crowd controlled.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Shark Bite
skills.description:
Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of stack each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal Physical Damage equal to (+95% Total Physical Attack) plus 4 (+0.4 × Hero Level) of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies.
(Percent damage dealt based on Max HP Damage Cap against Creeps: 200 (+20 × Hero Level). (see Patch Notes 1.7.82 Balance Adjustment))

levelScaling.label: Damage dealt based on enemy's Max HP
Enemy's Max HP Damage Cap against Creeps

skills.notes:
*Bane's enhanced basic attacks deals splash damage around him.
*Stack(s) lasts for 8 seconds. Its timer resets when it is until consumed by Bane's next enhanced Basic Attack.
*Only the (+100% Total Physical Attack) portion of his enhanced basic attack can critically strike.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Crab Claw Cannon
skills.description:
Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150-350 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and then 150%–200% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10 (+10% Total Magic Power)% for 1 second.
Every 100 Physical Attack that Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.
skills.calc: ${\rm Skill\ 1\ CD} = \Bigl\{\bigl[8.4 - (0.4 \times hero\ lv.)\bigr] \times (1 - CD\ reduction)\Bigr\} \times \bigl[ 1 -(physical\ attack \times 0.08%)\bigr]$
skills.notes: *Crab Claw Cannon's cooldown reduction is linear to Bane's Total Physical Attack and not stepwise at every 100 points of Total Physical Attack that Bane possesses.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ale
skills.description:
Bane chugs his ale, recovering 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) plus 5-10 (+1.5% Total Magic Power)% of his lost HP and gaining 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds.
Use Again: Bane spits venom in the target direction, dealing 140-340 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage  (scales up to 200% with charging time) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Every 100 Magic Power Bane possesses additionally reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%.
skills.calc:
$\mathrm{total\ skill\ damage} = skill\ damage \times [1 + (0.2 \times charging\ time)]$
${\rm Skill\ 1\ CD} = \Bigl\{\bigl[8.1 - (0.6 \times hero\ lv.)\bigr] \times (1 - CD\ reduction)\Bigr\} \times \bigl[ 1 -(magic\ power \times 0.07%)\bigr]$
skills.notes:
*Ale's cooldown reduction is linear to Bane's Total Magic Power and not stepwise at every 100 points of Total Magic Power that Bane possesses.
*Bane can fully charge the skill for 2.5 seconds, and can overcharge for another 2 seconds.
*Cooldown starts when the skill ends.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Deadly Catch
skills.description:
Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in a target direction, dealing 700-1100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, knocking them airborne for 0.6 seconds, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3 seconds).
This skill deals 40% of damage to turrets.
skills.notes:
*Deadly Catch also applies knockback effect.
*Turrets are not affected by Deadly Catch's item effects.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mecha Legs
terms:
Extra ATK Speed
*Stack(s) lasts for 5 seconds. Its timer resets when it is until consumed by Bruno's next enhanced Basic Attack or skill damage.
skills.description:
Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks).
Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Volley Shot
skills.description:
Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, dealing 100-225 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, slowing them by 30%, and speeding up 30% for 0.5 seconds.
The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of Slide by 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Stack(s) lasts for 5 seconds. Its timer resets when it is until consumed by Bruno's next enhanced Basic Attack.
*The Powerball can only be retrieved from the ground for two seconds or will disappear otherwise.
*If the target unit is killed before the powerball reaches it, the powerball will disappear, hence will not bounce back and land on the ground to be picked up.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Slide
skills.description: Bruno slides forward, briefly stunning enemies along the way, and gaining a Powerball at the end of the dash.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Worldie
skills.description:
Bruno kicks an Energy Ball at a target hero, 200-400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. It knocks them back to the edge of Bruno's attack range, stuns them for 0.5 seconds, and slows them by 80% for 2 seconds.
The Energy Ball then bounces among enemy units (up to 10 times), prioritizing enemy heroes. Each bounce deals 100-300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Double Shot
skills.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.
skills.notes:
*Enhanced Basic Attack Range: 7.
*Single-target attack effects such as Azure Blade's Unique Passive - Judgement or Marskman Talent Weakness Finder prioritizes the targeted enemy of this enhanced basic attack.
*The enhanced basic attack can stack multiple Thunder Belt's Unique Passive - Thunderbolt stacks within a single attack.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.description:
Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250-400 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.
The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullet will take [11%–16%] damage after the first bullet.
skills.notes:
*This skill has reduced foreswing time by 50% and reduced backswing time by 20%. (Patch Notes 1.9.32)
*The 3rd to 5th deal 5% of the initial damage.
*This skill's attacks prioritize enemy heroes the most.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Trapping Recoil
skills.description:
Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140-240 (+30% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds.
Succesfuly hitting and enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.
skills.notes: *The dashing speed is 20% increased.(Patch Notes 1.9.32)

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Grenade Bombardment
skills.description:
Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes in the first enemy hit, dealing 280-400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds.
Clint gains a grenade recharge every 10–5 seconds (up to 3).
skills.notes: *This skill has reduced foreswing time and backswing time by 33%. (Patch Notes 1.9.32)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Divine Resurrection
skills.description:
At regular intervals, Rafaela can use a special skill to instantly resurrect a fallen allied hero after a brief channeling. The resurrected allied hero will respawn at the base and is granted increased Movement Speed.
This skill's cooldown is determined by both its base cooldown and the remaining respawn time of the revived hero. It is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.
skills.notes:
*The cooldown is increased to 500% of the remaining cooldown of the revived ally.
*Max cooldown is capped at 240 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Light of Retribution
skills.description: Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies With Light of Retribution, dealing them 225-500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 5 seconds will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).
skills.calc: ${\rm total\ skill\ DMG} = \bigl[ 170 + (55 \times skill\ lv.) + 25%\ total\ magic\ power \bigr] + (20% \times no.\ of\ stacks),\ where\ 0 \leq no.\ of\ stacks \leq 3$
skills.notes:
*This skill's attacks prioritize enemy heroes the most.
*The skill's stack applies a mark that is only visible to enemy heroes but is invisible from Rafaela's enemies' perspective.
**It counts as a debuff and can be removed by skills such as Purify.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Holy Healing
skills.description:
Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, restoring 100-125 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP to nearby allied heroes, plus and additional 150-250 (+45% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. Also increases Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1 seconds.
Every 20 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus, up to 80%.

levelScaling.label: Magic Power, Total Movement Speed Increase

skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ movement\ SPD} = 30% + (0.05% \times magic\ power),\ where\ magic\ power \leq 1000$

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Holy Baptism
skills.description: Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light in the target direction, dealing 460-660 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Superconductor
skills.description: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor for 5 seconds on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Forked Lightning
skills.description:
Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275-500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within.
When hitting targets affected by Superconductor. Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target. gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1 second.
The lightning chain deals 10-20 (+4% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage over time and an additional 275-500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces the skill's cooldown by 50%.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ball Lightning
skills.description:
Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their Magic Defense by 10-25 for 1.8 seconds, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and stunning them for 1 second.
If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the Magic Defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Thunder's Wrath
skills.description:
Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing 600-1000 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing 300-500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst centered on the Superconductor target after a short delay, dealing 300-550 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Dragon Flurry
skills.description:
After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP.
Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Spear Flip
skills.description: Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250-350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: *Spear Flip is a variation of airborne control effect, with an addition of lifting the enemy over Zilong's back.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Spear Strike
skills.description:
Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250-450 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 15–30 for 2 seconds.
The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.
skills.notes: *Extended Triggering Time: The skill cooldown also resets if a Minion dies within 0.5 seconds Zilong deals damage to them. (see Patch Notes 1.8.08)

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Supreme Warrior
skills.description: Zilong removes all slow Effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35%–55% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5 seconds. For the duration, he can trigger Dragon Furry after every 2 Basic Attacks (instead of the previous 3).

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: The Oriental Fighters
skills.description: A team will gain higher movement speed boost with more Oriental Fighters in the battlefield.

levelScaling.label: Extra Fixed-value Movement Speed for each Oriental Fighter Present

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Air Superiority
skills.description: During fight, Fanny deals 10%–20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed[speed unknown]) and applies a stack of mark to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced[amount unknown] if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.[duration unknown]

levelScaling.label: Energy Gain Per Prey Mark Stack

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Tornado Strike
skills.description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275-525 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Steel Cable
skills.description:
Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy runs out. Each successive cast reduces the skill's energy cost by 2.
Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.
skills.notes:
*Tornado Strike must be learned to trigger it from Steel Cable.
*"Obstacles" includes: the walls of a map, terrains, summoned constructs (e.g Grock's Guardian's Barrier), turrets, and the border of Yin's domain through My Turn.
*During flight:
**Fanny cannot manually cast the skill Tornado Strike or basic attack.
**The first Tornado Strike from Steel Cable costs energy and the subsequent attacks will not.
**Each Tornado Strike for each Steel Cable cast is limited to one per target. Even though it appears to be an AOE, if Fanny initiates an additional Tornado Strike and opponents who have already received damage intersects with Fanny or the additional Tornado Strike, neither will damage the already damaged opponents. If a Tornado Strike hits more than one opponent, the limit is shared by all of them. i.e. To successfully attack the same target twice while in flight with Tornado Strike, Fanny must use another Steel Cable.
*Fanny is vulnerable for approximately 0.7 seconds during the first steel cable cast, which, during the delay, the player is unable to control Fanny, including moving her via left joystick, casting basic attacks and casting her skills until the cable grapples successfully or if it fails and retracts back to Fanny. If at least one steel cable grapples succesfully, Steel Cable can be casted, with its energy cost reduced and no delay, consecutively within 2 seconds, this duration can be refreshed indefinitely as long Steel Cable grapples an obstacle within this duration.
**Additionally, during the two seconds consecutive cast, Steel Cable cannot be disabled by immobilized.
*Tornado Strike from Steel Cable can still be triggered to targets who are invisible.
*Her flight can only be interrupted by hitting an opposing obstacle, controlled by airborne, suppressed and displacement effect and the skill Cut Throat. All of the deployed cables will go back to Fanny if she is interrupted.
* According to Death Replay, the Tornado Strike triggered by Steel Cable (if conditions are met) is considered damage dealt by the skill Steel Cable.
* The speed of following cables, if they are destined to grapple, are much faster than the initial cast. This allows the player to have more control of Fanny's direction.
* Tornado Strike animation and special effects from Steel Cable are slightly visually different from Tornado Strike.
skills.quote: No way I'm going on foot!

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Cut Throat
skills.description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400-650 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Each stack of mark of the target increases  this damage by 30%.

levelScaling.label: Extra Damage Per Prey Mark Stack

skills.notes: *Casting this skill will make deployed cables retract towards Fanny.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Malefic Gun
skills.description: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 130% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.
skills.calc: ${\rm total\ DMG} = initial\ DMG \times \bigl[ 100% + (5% \times distance\ projectile\ traveled)\bigr]$
skills.notes: *Damage increase only includes damage from basic attacks and skills.
skills.quote: Target locked. Fire!

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Malefic Bomb
skills.description:
Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200-400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can critically strike).
Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3 seconds, and she gains 60% Movement Speed that decays over 1.2 seconds. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

levelScaling.label: Total Basic Attack and Void Projectile Range
Total Basic Attack and Void Projectile Range (with Malefic Gun equipped)

skills.calc: ${\rm total\ range} = 4.3 + (0.6 \times Destruction\ Rush\ lv.) + \bigl[1.6 - (0.2 \times Destruction\ Rush\ lv.)\bigr],\ where\ 0 \leq Destruction\ Rush\ lv. \leq 3$
skills.notes: *Upon hitting an enemy with this skill, Layla gains 1.6 - (0.2 × Destruction Rush level) Basic Attack Range (1.6 / 1.4 / 1.2 / 1).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Void Projectile
skills.description: Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy that explodes on hit, dealing 170-320 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area and applying Magic Mark on them for 3 seconds. When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100-200 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Destruction Rush
skills.description:
Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500-800 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.
Passive: The range of Layla's Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6–1.8 units. Her sight range is also slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.

levelScaling.label: Basic Attack Range Per Destruction Rush Level

skills.notes: *This skill's actual range is slightly wider than the skill range indicates.[verification needed]

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Rage Incarnate
skills.description:
When Minotaur uses a skill, he will gain Motivation  for 3 seconds and heal himself for 5 (+1 × Hero Level)% of damage dealt by enemy heroes.
These effects are doubled in Enraged state.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Despair Stomp
skills.description:
Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 280-355 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will be slowed by 40% while enhancing his Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal (+3% Total HP) extra Physical Damage for 2 seconds.
Enraged: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by (+3% Total HP) Physical Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Motivation Roar
skills.description:
Minotaur motivates himself and nearby most wounded hero, restoring 220-320 (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for them and healing himself based on his [8%][verification needed] HP.
Enraged: Minotaur heals himself and nearby allies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Minoan Fury
skills.description:
Minotaur enters Enraged State and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180-300 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slow them by 60% while the final hit deals 200-300 (+85% Total Physical Attack) True Damage, while knocks targets airborne for 0.8 seconds. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.
The Enraged state lasts 12 seconds and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.
skills.quote: Rage grants me the power of destruction!

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Noumenon Energy Core
skills.description:
Every 2.5 seconds, the Noumenon Energy Core grants a 50 (+10 × Hero Level) shield to Lolita and nearby allies.
This shield can stack up to 6 times and lasts 30 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Power Charge
skills.description: Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4 seconds will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 300-550 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. This damage is doubled against Minions.
skills.notes: Despite its name, "Power Charge" is technically a blink skill, that can go through obstacles.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Guardian's Reflection
terms: * Guardian's Reflection can be canceled by enhanced basic attack and Noumenon Blast; it can be interrupted by high-level control effects.
skills.description:
Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and Projectiles in the direction of the shield for 3 seconds. The shield will break after taking 1500-3000 (+15% Total HP) damage.
The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected.
skills.notes:
*Lolita can move with her Skill 1 while her Skill 2 is active. (Patch Notes 1.8.02 (Advanced Server))
*Reflected ranged Basic Attacks and Projectiles are Lolita's attacks but their damage is based on the attributes of the ones who cast those attacks. (Patch Notes 1.8.06 (Advanced Server))
*Since the shield is not a Health attribute, the damage that scales with enemy's HP will be ignored by Guardian's Reflection.
*Projectiles can only be reflected one by two opposing Lolitas mirroring each other with Guardian's Reflection active.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zfmd75RLDn4&ab_channel=Hororochan NEW LOLITA SHIELD VS ALL PROJECTILE SKILLS
skills.quote: Right back at you!

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Noumenon Blast
skills.description:
Lolita begins charging for 2 seconds while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 50%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 500-900 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2 seconds (the damage and stun duration are based on the charge time).
Use Again: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.
skills.calc: ${\rm total\ physical\ DMG} =  \Bigl\{\bigl[300 + (skill\ lv. \times 200)\bigr] +  100%\ physical\ ATK \Bigr\} \times charging\ time,\ where\ 0 \leq charging\ time \leq 2.0$
skills.notes:
*Lolita can cancel this skill after 0.5 seconds of charging.
*If Lolita is interrupted by a CC skill while channelling her Ultimate, she will immediately cast it. The damage and stun duration will be based on the channelling time when she's interrupted. (Patch Notes 1.8.16 (Advanced Server))
*The animation is visible to enemies even if she is in the bush or concealed

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
skills.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of mark on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6 seconds and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

levelScaling.label: Damage Increase Per Shadow Mark Stack

skills.notes: *Hayabusa's basic attacks and non-ultimate skills can only apply Shadow Marks.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
skills.description:
Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 150-250 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take only 30% of the damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-Minion enemy hit.
Passive: Hayabusa permanently gains 3%–18% Spell Vamp.
skills.notes:
*This skill can only stack up to 2 Shadow Marks.
*The weapons used in this skill describing as "returning " is incorrect because the weapon is, in fact, a .

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
skills.description:
Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130-180 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.
Use Again: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken by 1 second. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130-180 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy.
skills.notes:
*The shadow that attached to the target can be removed with any CC Removal sources.
*Despite the very fast animation, Khufra's Bouncing Ball can block the dash towards each shadow.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
skills.description:
Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 140 (+75% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
The attacks prioritize enemies with mark and each will consume a mark to deal 45-85 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage. Does not apply Shadow Mark.
skills.notes:
*When the target becomes untargetable or moves a certain distance away from Hayabusa and no other valid targets are nearby, Hayabusa loses untargetability prematurely and wastes the remaining attacks.
*Hayabusa continuously moves side-to-side of the target and can freely cast Battle Spells.
*Despite not having Mobility tag, this ability is disabled in Minsitthar's King's Calling.
skills.quote: I, will be Akakage.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Power of Einherjar
skills.description:
Freya gains 1 Sacred Orb with each Basic Attack (up to 6 Sacred Orbs). Consuming 1 Sacred Orb grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack (max 6 stacks).
Sacred Orbs gradually recover when out of combat.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Leap of Faith
skills.description: Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining 500-900 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield and dealing 200-300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Valkyrie Slash
skills.description:
Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing 150-300 total-50 and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5 seconds. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Sacred Orbs per cast.
This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Valkyrie Descent
skills.description:
Freya selects a target area and dives down as a Valkyrie (gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reducion), dealing 300-550 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 40% slow to enemies in her path and at the landing point for 2 seconds.
Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 12 seconds, during which her Basic Attacks deal 30-60 extra damage (extra damage cannot Crit) and she recovers 60-120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) HP per Basic Attack, and her Basic Attacks deal splash damage.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mystic Favor
skills.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with Basic Attacks or skills within a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional 140 (+60% Total Magic Power) True Damage and slow them by 20% for 1 second (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Mystic Projectile
skills.description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 270-495 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Mystic Injunction
skills.description: Gord create an energy field in the target area, dealing 55-105 (+16% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.3 second to enemies within (up to 13 times).

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Mystic Gush
skills.description:
Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 110-210 (+32% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit every 0.2 seconds (up to 16 times).
The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.
skills.notes:
*Gord is stationary within the skill's duration.
*This skill can only be interrupted by airborne, frozen, suppressed or transformed crowd control effects.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Assassin Instinct
skills.description:
If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1 second, she will enter Camouflage state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while silencing the target for 0.25 seconds.
Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the Camouflage state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1 second.
Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.
skills.notes: *Her basic attack range is also increased to 3.8 units during Camouflage state.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Claw Dash
skills.description:
Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250-350 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path.
After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: Natalia releases a Smoke Bomb at her location, slowing enemies within by 25%–75% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4 seconds.
skills.quote: No one beats me in my own game.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: The Hunt
skills.description:
Passive: Natalia gains 15%–45% extra Crit Chance.
Active: Natalia immediately enters Assassin Instinct state. Natalia can store up to 2 charges of her
Ultimate and each charge has a recharge time of 30 seconds. Creep kills will reduce the current remaining recharge time 50% of the full recharge time.
skills.notes: *The cooldown of this skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Yin Yang Gathering
skills.description: Upon retrieving the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a 450 (+80% Total Magic Power) shield, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, and slows them by 60% for 1 second. Cooldown 4.5 seconds.
skills.notes: *There is a mistake in the skill description, the shield duration is not 4.5 seconds but 5 seconds and the cooldown of the skill mentioned is true which is 4.5 seconds. Meaning Kagura can infinitely get the shield 0.5 seconds before it depletes. But the shield cannot stack.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
skills.description:
Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365-590 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 second. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away.
This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.
skills.notes:
*The umbrella reveals the entire bush that it nests inside, including concealed enemies and traps.
*There is an error in the skill description, even though it says (+105% Total Magic Power), it shows (+104% Total Magic Power). This error can be detected by getting 100 Magic Power.
*The line that connects between Kagura and the umbrella is visible to Kagura only.
*If Kagura dies while the umbrella is currently ordered to move, the order and its ability effect is nullified.
*The umbrella automatically returns to Kagura if the distance exceeds 8 unit.
**Kagura maintains the distance with the umbrella when entering or leaving Yin's My Turn.
* Kagura can move the umbrella within a distance that is inversely relative to the distance between her and the umbrella. The total of such distance is the exceeding range.
* The model of Kagura when without umbrella and the animation change when Kagura orders the umbrella to move is visible to everyone.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
skills.description: Kagura removes all debuffs on her and dashes in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.
skills.notes:
*Kagura gain Control Immunity during the dash. (0.65 seconds)
*This skill cannot remove suppressed CC effect, but the blink will still be successfully casted.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
skills.description: Kagura teleports to the Seimei Umbrella's location and retrieves it, dealing 300-400 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the nearby enemies.
skills.notes: *The dash range is 3.8 unit.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Yin Yang Overturn
skills.description: Kagura invokes the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing 250-420 (+95% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 second.
skills.quote: Don't get too close to my Seimei Umbrella.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Yin Yang Overturn
skills.description: Kagura invokes the power of the Seimei Umbrella, resetting the cooldown of , dealing 235-355 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies around the Umbrella, and slowing them by 60%. After 1.5 seconds, enemy heroes around the Umbrella will be pulled toward it and dealt 480-720 (+155% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
skills.notes:
*This ability has two phases:
**The umbrella first slows and damages nearby enemies. Kagura's animation changes.
**The umbrella pulls nearby enemies inwards and damages a second time.
**The delay and finishing animation of the umbrella is visible to everyone, but is only visible to enemies if they have sight of the umbrella.
*If Kagura retrieves the umbrella before the second phase and does not release it, the damage and pull effect centers at Kagura.
**Therefore this ability can pull enemies over a great distance with Flicker or other allied abilities.
skills.quote: Don't get too close to my Seimei Umbrella.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Only Fast
skills.description: After travelling 5 units, Chou's deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit), briefly slows the target by 80% and reduces their Physical Defense by 10(+1*Hero Level) for 3s (up to 2 stacks).

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Jeet Kune Do
skills.description:
Chou strikes in the target direction, dealing 180 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before it goes on coldown. On the 3rd cast, Chou also knocks enemies hit airborne.
Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd cast resets the cooldown of Shunpo.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Shunpo
skills.description: Chou charges in the target direction gaining Control Immunity and a 200 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage shield.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: The Way of Dragon
skills.description:
Chou strikes the target enemy hero with a roundhouse kick at the target enemy hero, dealing them 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back.
Cast this skill again to chase up the target, dealing a total of 480 (+220% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Simian God
skills.description:
Enemies hit by Sun and his Doppelgangers will have their Physical Defense reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 25% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage.
Sun and his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 50 extra damage to Creeps.
skills.notes: *Sun can only receive HP through his doppelgangers' basic attacks.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Endless Variety
skills.description:
Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 200-400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Upon hitting an enemy hero or Creep, or reaching the maximum range, the Golden Staff morphs into a Doppelganger that lasts 5 seconds and inherits 40%–55% of Sun's attributes (and a portion of his Attack Effects).
Endless Variety and Swift Exchange are learned and upgraded together and share the same cooldown.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Swift Exchange
skills.description:
Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 200-400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Rotary Impact
skills.description:
Alpha unleashes an energy wave in the target direction, dealing 100-200 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 1 second.
Beta then strafes enemies along the same path, dealing 60-120 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Force Swing
skills.description:
After a short delay, Alpha swings his blade in the target direction, dealing 250-500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and recovering 100-200 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) HP for each enemy hit.
Beta then strafes enemies in the same area, dealing 60-120 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage.

skills.description:
Beta dives into target location, dealing 100-200 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1 second. Alpha then leaps towards the same location, knocking enemies in his path airborne and carrying them to the landing location. Alpha then slams down, dealing 250-500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Beta then strafes enemies in the same area 5 times, dealing 15-30 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage.

skills.heading: Passive

skills.description:
Ruby gains 6%-20% Spell Vamp (based on level) and inherits 125% Spell Vamp Ratio  (Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal).
After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location, gaining 7.5 (+1.5 × Hero Level) Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) for 4 seconds. (stacks up to 3 times).

**When using aimed skill, "front" would be the direction of the skill is facing.
**When using skill 2, "front" would be the direction Ruby is facing before using the skill.
*Disabled by root.

skills.name: Don't Run, Wolf King!
skills.description: Ruby swings her scythe herself twice, each swing dealing 60-185 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5 seconds, and slowly pulling them toward her.

skills.name: I'm Offended!
skills.description: Ruby sweeps scythe in the target direction, dealing 200-480 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Heavenly Vow
skills.description:
Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow and glaive according to his distance from the target.
Weapon Mastery: After each weapon switch, the next two Basic Attacks will gain extra Attack Speed, dealing 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively, and gain 15% Movement Speed for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*The attack range of glaive is 1.9 unit.
*The differentiation range is indicated by a red ring around Yi Sun-shin. His current weapon is displayed below the health bar, with glaive on the left and longbow on the right.
*The animation is visible to Yi Sun-shin only.
*The glaive attack range is unaffected by Malefic Gun.
*Whether the last attack is considered ranged or melee is determined upon attacking, not upon hitting or landing.
**Similarly, Yi Sun-Shin gains Enhanced basic attack right after attacking.
*When there are enhanced basic attack(s) left, there is a glow in his weapon. The enhanced basic attack plays a different sound in both types.
*The enhanced basic attack lasts 5 seconds.
*The next attack type to trigger Weapon Mastery persists death.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Traceless
skills.description:
Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing 150-300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and becoming immune to control effects for 1 second.
Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2

skills.description:
Tap: Yi Sun-shin slashes swiftly with his glaive, dealing 240-340 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Yi Sun-shin shoots a powerful arrow, dealing  240-340 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target. The arrow's damage scales with the hold time, up to 200%.
Yi Sun-shin gains Weapon Mastery immediately when this skill is used.
skills.notes:
*The tap/hold differentiation time is appr. 0.25 seconds.
*The arrow damages enemies slightly longer than the indicator range.
*When the arrow hits an enemy, even unsighted, an impact sound is played.
*The arrow starts at 1.9 unit, and max range is approximately 7.6 unit.

skills.heading: Ultimate

skills.description:
Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle ship and gains sight of the whole map for 5 seconds. The turtle ship lasts for up to 15 seconds, during which Yi Sun-shin gains 70% burst Movement Speed (decay to 20% over 2 seconds).
When cast again, Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle ship to ram towards the target area, dealing 160-320 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning enemy units in the central area for 0.8 seconds. Then Yi Sun-shin commands the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon shots on a larger area, each dealing 160-320 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 30%.
Yi Sun-shin gains Weapon Mastery effect immediately when this skill is used.
skills.notes:
Global Reveal
*Cooldown begins as soon as the ability is first cast.
*Ignores untargetable enemies.
*Despite the description, Yi Sun-shin only gains Weapon Mastery on the second cast.
*Fully reveal units inside and outside of Yin's My Turn.
*Yi Sun-shin is still credited with an assist if an enemy is revealed but not damaged by this ability.
*The speed bonus decays by 12.5% each 0.5 seconds, Yi Sun-shin gains 70%/57.5%/45%/32.5%/20% bonus Movement Speed within 0.5/1/1.5/2/2.5 after cast.
Turtle Ship

*Damage is dealt three times over 2 seconds, with an interval of 0.75s.

skills.description:
After a short delay, Moskov throws the Spear of Destruction in the target direction, dealing 340-500 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them dealing 10% Physical Damage to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage are slowed by 50% for 1 second (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3 seconds).
When the Spear of Destruction hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of Abyss Walker
Use Again: Moskov casts Abyss Walker from the shadow's location (shares he same cooldown as the normal skill.
skills.notes:
*Abyss Walker of this skill shares the same properties as the normal one.
**This means the attack speed boost is based on Skill 1's level. Therefore it is possible to use the 2nd phase of Ultimate skill without learning Skill 1.
*An overlay of camera is shown tracking the spear and its shadow.

skills.heading: Passive

skills.name: Electromagnetic Waves
skills.description:
Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 80-180 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage taken from the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps.
Johnson can cast Basic Attacks and skills for the duration.

levelScaling.label: Damage Increase Per Enemy's Subsequent Damage Taken

skills.calc: ${\rm total\ skill\ DMG\ against\ Creeps} = \Bigl\{\bigl[ 60 + (20 \times skill\ lv.) + 60%\ total\ magic\ power \bigr] + 60% \Bigr\}+ (15% \times no.\ of\ stacks),\ where\ 0 \leq no.\ of\ stacks \leq 3$
skills.notes:
*Electromagnetic Waves can deal up to 8 times within the duration. The interval in between damage is undetermined.
*This skill can only be interrupted by high- and ultimate-level control effects.
*The damage increase applied to an enemy counts as a debuff and can be removed by skills such as Purify.

skills.description: Hold the "Nitrous" skill to increase speed for up to 5 seconds, the acceleration stopping immediately once released.

skills.heading: Ultimate

The car will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or obstacle, dealing 300-400 (+240% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage–450-600 (+360% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. stunning them for 0.5–1 second (scales with the car's speed before impact),[speed unknown] and creating an electrified zone at the location. The zone continuously deals 60-80 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies within. While in car state, tap Brake to stop immediately or hold Nitrous to continuously gain speed for up to 5 seconds. Johnson's location will be
revealed to the enemy for 3 seconds when casting this skill.
Passive: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%–30%.

levelScaling.label: Skill Duration
levelScaling.raw: ≈2 hours, or until he bumps into something

skills.notes:

* It is possible to carry up to 2 passengers at a time, if Angela possesses Johnson or his passenger with Heartguard.
* Johnson can't carry Hanzo's body but his Hanekage.
*This skill can only be interrupted by suppression.

Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Hunter's Steps
skills.description: Roger gains 20%–40% Movement Speed and 20%–40% Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds.

skills.name: Bloodthirsty Howl
skills.description: Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15–1.4 times for 5 seconds. Within this duration, he gains 50% Movement Speed if an enemy hero below 40% HP is within his vision.

skills.description: Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150-300 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing enemies by 90% for 0.8 seconds. Passive: In Wolf form, Roger gains 20–65 Physical and Magic Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Lightwheel Mark
skills.description: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of Lightwheel Marks, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing True Damage equal to 6%-8% of the target's Max HP to them (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

skills.heading: Skill 1

skills.description: Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250-375 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150-200 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Phantom Step
skills.description:
Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150-275 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark on them.
When in Dual Wield state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Speedy Lightwheel
skills.description: Karrie enters Dual Wield state for 6s, during which she gains 20% Movement Speed and throws two lightwheels with each Basic Attack, each dealing 50-70% Basic Attack damage annd inheriting a portion of Attack Effects.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Steel Bones
skills.description:
Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 100). For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100).
Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal extra Magic Damage and recover. The extra damage scales with his Rage, level, and Magic Power.
skills.calc:
$\begin{align}
{\mathrm enhanced\ basic\ ATK\ DMG} & = 100%\ total\ physical\ ATK + 200%\ total\ magic\ power\ + \Bigl\{total\ rage \times \bigl[10 + (0.2 \times hero\ lv.) \bigr]\Bigr\} \\
healing\ effect & = 8 \times rage \\
{\mathrm where}\ 25 & \geq total\ rage \geq 100\\
\end{align}$
Source: User blog:Chrodotme/Gatotkaca enhanced basic attack formula
skills.notes:
*For each Gatotkaca's 1 lost HP increases his extra physical defense by 0.02 (for a maximum of 100 Physical Defense if he has at least 5000 lost HP.)
*Rage begins to deplete after approximately 3 seconds of Gatotkaca leaving in combat (i.e. not taking or dealing damage), with 10 Rage depleted every 0.5 seconds.
*Rage is used in multiples of 5, and will otherwise be rounded to the nearest multiple of 5. Example: having 38 Rage will output a damage as if having 40 Rage, while having 7 Rage will output a damage as if having 5 Rage.
**While these formulas are highly approximate, Rage generation can be inconsistent, resulting in same Rage but varied enhanced basic attack damage dealt.
*The heal is static and follows the rounding rule of Rage before it's calculated.
*Gatotkaca will perform a short dash to the target when dealing enhanced basic attack. (Patch Notes 1.7.82)

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Blast Iron Fist
skills.description: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200-300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100-150 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second and be slowed by 30%.
skills.notes: *"Sustained Damage" deals every 0.5 seconds and can deal up to 7 times.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies on the path to attack him and deal 200-300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 1.5 seconds. The sprint distance scales with the channel time. Canceling the Skill reduces 50% of the remaining Cooldown.
skills.notes: *Gatotkaca can fully charge the skill for approximately 1⅙ seconds, and can overcharge for approx. another 3.75 seconds.
skills.quote: Impregnable!

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Avatar of the Guardian
skills.description:
Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500-1000 (+300% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1 second. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center.
The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.
skills.notes: *This skill has control immunity and his descending animation makes Gatotkaca untargetable.
skills.quote: A leap holds the world in awe.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Magic Master
skills.description: Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attack to deal 60 (+50%Total Physical Attack)(+60%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. His attacks reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 for 3 seconds on hit (up to 10 stacks).
skills.notes: *Reduces enemys's Magic defense by 20 at max stacks.

skills.name: Poker Trick
skills.description: Harley throws 3-5 waves of cards in the target direction, each dealing 130-210 (+25%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and granting him 10% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds on hit (up to 5-10 stacks). Enemies hit more than 3 times will take less damage from subsequent hits.
skills.notes: *Increases Attack Speed by 50%-100% at max stacks.

skills.name: Space Escape
skills.description:
Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his place, increasing his Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
enhanced Use again within 4 seconds to return where the hat is and lose the speed boost.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Deadly Magic
skills.description: Harley casts a magic ring of fire at the target enemy hero (can be blocked by other heroes), dealing them 200-400 (+60%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The magic ring stays around the enemy for 4 seconds, during which Harley can hit the magic ring to damage the enemy with his skills. The magic ring will explode at the end of the duration, dealing 100-200 (+30%Total Magic Power) plus 50% of the enemy's damage taken within the duration as Magic Damage.
skills.quote: A single spark can start a praine fire

skills.heading: Buff

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Jungle Heart
