skills.notes: *Debuff only applies to non-minion enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Force of the Queen
skills.description: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing 200-350 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Heavy Crossbow
skills.description: Irithel order Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10 seconds. For the duration, she gains 30 extra Movement Speed and her Basic Attacks shoot enhanced crossbow bolts, dealing 120 (+60-80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also accumulates faster for the duration.[amount unknown]
skills.notes: *Triggers basic attack effects on each enemy hero hit by the explosion.
skills.quote: No arrow is shot in vain.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Bastion of Stone
skills.description:
Grock gains a Shield equal to 10% of his Max HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal Physical Damage equal to 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the target's Max HP (capped at 300 (+20 × Hero Level) against non-hero units). This effect has a 18-12 seconds cooldown (decreases with level), which reduces by 200% when near terrain.
Grock's skills cannot be interrupted and gains 30 (+6 × Hero Level)% extra Physical Defense while the Shield is active.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Mighty Swing
skills.description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240-440 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked into the obstacle, launched airborne, and take extra Physical Damage equal to 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of their Max HP (capped at 300 (+20 × Hero Level) against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Earthen Rampart
skills.description:
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100-200 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies towards him.
Use Again: Cancel the wall early.
skills.notes: *Placing a wall near a nearby unit (including himself) will displace them while disrupting their skills, whether it is an ally or an enemy and even if they are immune to crowd control. Because the displacing effect is not counted as a control effect, but rather as a result of the way obstacles work, any units who can manage to place themselves on the obstacle's way will automatically be moved on the valid ground (except when flying over or ignores an obstacle until the duration ends) to avoid becoming stuck. The same effect applies to Badang's Fist Break.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Tectonic Charge
skills.description: Grock charges forward, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1 second and deals (+300% Total Physical Attack) 650-1050. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.
skills.quote: The brave fear nothing.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Warmonger
skills.description:
When Argus' blade reaches 100 rage[amount unknown]. He will launch a Demonic Slash with his next Basic Attack, dealing 120 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 140 HP. This attack ignores 30% of the target's Physical Defense
Argus' Demonic Blade gains 5 Malice Energy per second, and each of his Basic Attacks grants 25 Malice Energy. (critical strikes grant an additional 25 energy)
The Energy cap is 200. Each Demonic Slash consumes 100 Energy.
skills.notes:
*Warmonger costs 100 Malice Energy (rage).
*Damage dealt from equipment Unique Passives and talents cannot charge Malice Energy.
*Warmonger's demonic slash can ignore turret defenses as well
*Argus can gain malice energy from hitting turrets

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Demonic Grip
skills.description:
Argus streches out a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125-250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero or creep hit, stunning them for 0.7 seconds and pulling him and the target towards the other, then the target is slowed by 40% for 2s.
If no enemy is hit, Argus pulls himself toward the hand's destination instead. Use Again: Argus dashes and strikes in the target direction, dealing 175-300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Meteoric Sword
skills.description:
After a short delay, Argus thrusts his Demonic Blade in the target direction, dealing 60-180 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. The charge time decreases as Attack Speed increases.
Argus Fighter
If an enemy hero is hit, he immediately gains 100 Malice Energy and becomes enhanced for 3s.
While enhanced, he gains 30-55% Attack Speed, and Demonic Slash restores 50 Malice Energy.
Meteoric Sword counts as a Basic Attack, can trigger Attack Effects, and can Crit.
skills.notes:
* Meteoric Sword counts as a mobility skill rendering Argus unable to use it under immobilize effects.
* As a mobility skill, it is disabled by rooted.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Eternal Evil
skills.description: Argus draws his Meteoric Sword and removes all debuffs (excluding Suppression) on himself, dealing 150-300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage  and gaining Death Immunity for 4s. When the state ends, he converts all damage dealt to heroes during this duration into HP. Passive: If Argus takes fatal damage while Eternal Evil is not on cooldown, Eternal Evil triggers automatically but only grants Death Immunity for 3s.
skills.notes:
*Health regeneration based on damage dealt is not affected by Argus' Healing Effect and Healing Received.
*Basic attacks cannot convert HP when dealing damage to shields.
*Damage dealt to non hero units cannot be converted to HP
skills.quote: Battlefield is my playground and I think nothing of life and death.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Lakeshore Ambience
skills.description: After each skill cast, Odette's next Basic Attack or skill will cast a sound wave that rebounds between her and enemies, each bounce dealing 144~200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
skills.notes:
*Lakeshore Ambience only benefits 50% of Magic Lifesteal.
*This skill stacks up to 3 times.
**Stack(s) lasts for 8 seconds; time resets by consuming it.
*Base Damage increases with hero's level.
*Sound waves can bounce up to 4 times.
*Lightning Truncheon's effect will only be actived on the second bounce.
*This skill is a md and only benefits from skill effects.

*Still bounce to and from but does not damage enemies untargetability.
**Still bounce to and from Odette.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Avian Authority
skills.description: Odette concentrates energy to summon a swan to attack enemies, dealing 300-550 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30%. Lasts 2 seconds.
skills.notes: *Avian Authority only benefits 50% of Magic Lifesteal.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Blue Nova
skills.description: Odette releases a set of magic energy balls forward, dealing 250-400 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy hit and cc them for 1.5 seconds. Another energy ball will then spawn and attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing 250-400 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and cc them for 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes: *Blue Nova only benefits 50% of Magic Lifesteal.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Swan Song
skills.description:
Odette gathers energy and began channeling, gaining a 1200-1800 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield, and dealing 2000-3000 (+750% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total to enemies within the area for 5 seconds. (She deals damage every 0.5s). Odette can move freely during the channeling but with 40% slower movement speed and she cannot cast other skills during that time.
Use Again: within 5s to immediately cancel the channeling.
Odette's channeling can only be interrupted if she was controlled by High lvl CC Effects. E.g: Suppression, Airborne, Transform, Frozen Petrify or etc...

*Swan Song only benefits 25% of Spell Vamp.

*This skill is only interrupted by high crowd control effects, namely airborne, frozen, transformed, petrified or Suppressed
*The shield still lingers shortly after the ability ends.
*Battle Spells, Items and Recall can be used during the duration.
*Yin's My Turn cancels this ability upon entering and exitting.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Soul Cutter
skills.description: Each time Lancelot [blinks or] charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4 seconds, up to 30%.
skills.notes:
*Additional damage dealt includes all types of damage from any sources.
*Aside from Lancelot's own abilities, he also gains 1 stack of Soul Cutter caused by the Cyclone Eye's dash, Flicker, and Mathilda's Guiding Wind.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Puncture
skills.description:
Lancelot charges in a designated direction, dealing 100-250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and applying a mark to the first unmarked enemy hit. The Sword Mark lasts 3 seconds.
If Lancelot successfully applies a mark to an enemy, the cooldown of this will reset.
skills.notes: *Puncture first applies Sword Mark, then the damage. Meaning if an unmarked enemy dies from Puncture, the cooldown is reset.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Thorned Rose
skills.description:
Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 225-400 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (damage reduced [to pd] when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable and invincible during this process.[how long?] Enemies in the center of the area will take all 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5 seconds. The slow effect can stack.
This skill only benefits from 50% of Lancelot's Spell Vamp.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Phantom Execution
skills.description: After a short period[how long?] of charging, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He is invincible throughout the process.[how long?]
skills.quote: I become one with the sword.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Young Again
skills.description: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and turns to egg form, in which he can continue to move around and gains a new set of skills. He cannot be targeted in egg form and will revive after a period of time.
skills.notes:
*Diggie provides vision on egg form.
*Diggie will receive 75 extra movement speed during egg form.
*Item unique passives are disabled on egg form.
*There will be a 2-second delay to fully control Diggie after death or revival.
**Diggie will be vulnerable to attacks 1 second after reviving.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Auto Alarm Bomb
skills.description:
Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location. The alarm will then remain stationary for 25 seconds or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals 500-600 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 30%.
Diggie gains 2 stacks of stack each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. Diggie loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in the egg form.
Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

levelScaling.label: Extra Skill Damage Per Dangerous Sparks Stack

skills.calc:
$\begin{align}
& {\rm total\ skill\ DMG} = \bigl[(480 + 20 \times skill\ lv.) + 100%\ magic\ power\bigr]\times \bigl[100% + (1% \times no.\ of\ Dangerous\ Sparks\ stacks )\bigr] \\
& {\rm where}\ 0 \leq no.\ of\ Dangerous\ Sparks\ stacks \leq 60
\end{align}$
skills.notes:
*Stacking up Dangerous Sparks for each egg form skills has 1 second cooldown.
*When thrown into an enemy unit, the owl alarm detonates immediately rather than chasing the enemy as a ward.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Disdain
skills.description: Diggie displays serious disdain for the enemy, dealing a small amount of damage to surrounding enemies while venting anger.
skills.notes: *Disdain deals 5 True Damage and can deal up to 6 times.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Reverse Time
skills.description:
Diggie marks a target enemy hero for 4 seconds and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing 150-400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing it by 80%.
If the enemy moves out of the circle , the pull will be triggered early.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Egg Dance
skills.description:
Diggie happily dance his hometown jig, dealing a small amount of damage to enemies.
calc           =
skills.notes: *Egg Dance deals 5 True Damage and can deal up to 10 times.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Time Journey
skills.description: Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them 650-880 (+300% Total Magic Power) shield and Control Immunity for 3 seconds. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Victory Prayer
skills.description: Diggie rolls on the ground, praying for the enemy's base to explode immediately. They say it's impossible to happen.
skills.notes: *Victory Prayer deals 5 True Damage and can deal up to 12 times.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Thickened Blood
skills.description:
Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana he possesses.
When out of Mana, Hylos can use his HP for skill casts.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Law and Order
skills.description:
Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3 seconds to deal 300-550 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target, knock back and stun them for 1 second.
The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and ends after the next Basic Attack.
skills.notes: *The enhanced basic attack range is increased to 2.5 (1.25 times increase.)

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ring of Punishment
skills.description:
Hylos releases the Ring of Punishment, dealing 100-300 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4%–6% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5%–15% for 2.5 seconds (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the Ring of Punishment by 5–20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30–150 Mana per second when it's active.
Use Again; Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.
skills.calc: ${\mathrm total\ skill\ DMG} = \Bigl\{ \bigl[ 70 + (30 \times skill\ lv.) + 20%\ total\ magic\ power \bigr] + \bigl[ 5% + (3% \times skill\ lv.) \bigr] \Bigr\} \times no.\ of\ stacks$
skills.notes: *The skill lasts until Hylos runs out of Mana.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Glorious Pathway
skills.description:
Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement by 75% for 1 second. The pathway lasts 6 seconds.
When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3% of his Max HP} per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the
pathway will be slowed by 25%.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Decimation
skills.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.
skills.calc: $\mathrm{total\ basic\ ATK\ DMG} = 115 + 20%\ extra\ ATK\ SPD + 20%\ magic\ power$
skills.notes: *Unlike the normal one, frenzied Nightmaric Spawn enjoys 100% of Zhask's Attributes and its Death Ray deals extra 60 Magic Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Nightmaric Spawn
skills.description:
Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that Inherits 55%–100% of his Attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, Magic Power). Nightmaric Spawn will automatically attack nearby enemies by firing a Death Ray at the target, dealing 55 (+20% Extra Attack Speed) (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30% for 0.6 seconds. If Zhask is too far away from Nightmaric Spawn, it will disappear.
Death Ray is considered as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
Fusion Enhanced: The damage of Nightmaric Spawn is increased to 180%, and it can be repositioned.

levelScaling.label: Attack Speed Inherited by Nightmaric Spawn

skills.notes:
*Nightmaric Spawn also benefits from Zhask's current buffs and debuffs, but not on standard/tier 3 talents.
*Nightmaric Spawn can use Lifesteal to replenish its own HP but it won't heal Zhask.
*Its basic attacks and Death Ray are considered as melee attacks.
*Its attacks benefit from Golden Staff's Unique Passive - Endless Strike, but it cannot stack them up by attacking.
* The spawn will give an unknown amount of EXP and gold when slain.
* Casting Dominator's Descent resets the cooldown of Nightmaric Spawn.
*The disable duration of Skill 1 after the enhanced Nightmaric Spawn dies or disappears is 2 seconds. (Patch Notes 1.9.06)

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Mind Eater
skills.description:
Zhask fires a penetrating mental missile in the designated direction, dealing 300-540 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, Nightmaric Spawn will attack enemies by Mind Eater for 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun for 0.5 seconds.
Fusion Enhanced: Increases the damage dealt by Mind eater by  540-975 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
skills.notes: *The enhanced skill damage is considered as Zhask's attack. If Zhask gets off the Enhanced Nightmaric Spawn, the Spawn's skill will turn into a regular one.

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Hive Clones
skills.description:
Zhask releases a swarm (6) of Hive Clones in the targeted direction. The clones will explode and deal 55-100 (+18% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on contact, reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1 second.
If Hive Clones find no target, they will burrow into the ground and ambush enemies passing by.
Fusion Enhanced: Zhask releases several (15) swarms of Hive Clones.
Subsequent damage dealt to the same target decays to 20%.

levelScaling.label: Decay Ratio per subsequent hit (Fusion Enhanced)

skills.notes: *The enhanced skill damage is considered as Zhask's. If Zhask gets off the Enhanced Nightmaric Spawn, the Spawn's skill will turn into a regular one.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Dominator's Descent
skills.description:
Zhask selects a designated position to summon Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra of them. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period.
Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off the Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.
skills.calc: $\mathrm{total\ basic\ ATK\ DMG} = 99 + 36%\ extra\ ATK\ SPD + 36%\ magic\ power$
skills.notes:
*This skill is a blink.
*Dominator's Descent lasts for 10 seconds.
**This skill and Nightmaric Spawn is disabled for an unknown time after Nightmaric Spawn loses the enhancement from the Ultimate, disappeared or killed.
*Cooldown starts when the skill has been casted.
*During the brief animation period when his spawn is disappearing, whether it's dead or just out of range, Zhask cannot use this skill.
*Zhask is untargetable during the fusion period.
**Furthermore, the damage dealt and received and the buffs and debuffs received during the period are exclusive to the enhanced Nightmaric Spawn and not Zhask.
*The game's camera height increases within the skill's duration.
*This skill can be cancelled during the animation.
*If Zhask currently has no spawn present when casting this skill, he will spawn one at the desired position instead. Summoning a spawn does not cost mana.
*Zhask can still fuse to the enhanced Nightmaric Spawn when Skill 1 has yet to be learned (i.e. is at level 0). However, the enhanced spawn will not turn to a regular one when the skill ends and will disappear instead.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Shadow of Styx
skills.description:
Helcurt remains in the Prowler state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating (+30% Total Physical Attack) HP if he has not dealt any damage.
He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4 seconds upon being spotted and leaves Prowler state 0.75 second later.
Any hero killed after hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10 seconds. Helcurt Conceals himself while within the dark fog.
skills.notes:
*In the description, Helcurt's "Conceal" grants him Invisibility. The only other hero to possess an Conceal skill is Miya.
*The sound effect when losing the state is audible to all nearby units.
skills.quote: He who hides in the shadow.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Hidden Terror
skills.description:
Passive: When Helcurt is in Prowler state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast
Active: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals 150-300 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Deadly Stinger
skills.description:
Passive: Helcurt gains one Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in Prowler state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored.
Active: Helcurt fires all Deadly Stingers forward, each dealing 180-280 (+42% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies (Minions and Creeps only take 70% of the damage)
Deadly Stinger counts as a Basic Attack, but it cannot Crit.
skills.notes: *This skill cannot trigger the attack effect stacking part of Golden Staff's Unique Passive, Endless Strike.
skills.quote: He who awakes in the slaughter.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Dark Night Falls
skills.description:
Helcurt summons the Dark Night, reducing all enemies' sight range and making them lose sight of their allies for 3s. During Dark Night, Helcurt gains 40% Movement Speed.
The Dark Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.
skills.notes:
*Does not affect enemy turrets.
*Does not affect units inside Yin's My Turn.
*Enemies' attack and abilities are not restricted by vision
*Is not consider as an assist if an enemy hero is killed within the duration without any Helcurt's damage.
skills.quote: He who resurrects in the night.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Spiritual Unity
skills.description: Every 8 seconds, Verri enters the Hunting state and assists Pharsa on her next attack against an enemy hero, dealing 8% extra Magic Damage equal to the target's Max HP (+1% for every 200 Magic Power owned) and slowing them by 60% for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*If Pharsa uses Wings by Wings immediately when Verri is flying towards the target, neither damage nor effect is applied to the target while the passive still goes on cooldown.
*Verri is also unsighted if Pharsa is concealed.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Curse of Crow
skills.description:
Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300-425 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and marking them for 4 seconds.
Pharsa's subsequent attack against marked enemies will consume the mark and stun them for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Affected enemies are revealed.
*The subsequent attack in the description only consider the following:
**Pharsa's basic attack
**Spiritual Unity
**Energy Impact
**Feathered Air Strike
*Being hit again by the ability reapplies the debuff.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Energy Impact
skills.description: Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475-700 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Feathered Air Strike
skills.description:
Passive: Each level up of this skill reduces the Spiritual Unity's interval by 1 second.
Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8 seconds and bombards the target location, dealing 530-870 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within the area. This skill can be cast up to 4 times within the duration.
skills.notes:
*The ability has an estimate range of 9.5 and hitbox of 1.9.
*Pharsa can cast any other abilities, battle spells and equipments, except for Wings by Wings and Recall without canceling this ability.
*The casting of the ability is also the first cast.

skills.heading: Special
skills.name: Wings by Wings
skills.description: Pharsa turns into mist and wraps herself around Verri, gaining 150% extra Movement Speed (decaying over time) and the ability to fly over terrain. This state lasts up to 5 seconds or until she uses a Basic Attack or skills, or is controlled.
skills.notes: *The camera height raises within the skill channeling.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Lethal Shot
skills.description:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5 seconds, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) True Damage (20% extra damage against minions).
Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.
Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her Lethal Shot doubles the amount of energy restored. The cooldown of Lethal Shot will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.
skills.notes:
*Instead, Lethal Shot inflicts physical damage on turrets.
*Instead of reducing Lesley's base critical damage to 140%, Lesley's total critical damage is reduced by 60%.
*The additional critical chance applies only to the enhanced basic attack.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Master of Camouflage
skills.description:
Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85–135 extra Physical Attack.
The state lasts 3 seconds or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.
skills.notes: *Cooldown starts after Master of Camouflage ends.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Tactical Grenade
skills.description:
Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while slightly jumping back, dealing 150-300 50 to enemies in a cone and knocking them back.
Lesley can cast this skill during the Ultimate Snipe to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Ultimate Snipe
skills.description:
Lesley [gains vision to nearby enemies and can lock] onto the target enemy hero and fires 4 Lethal Bullets in succession, each dealing 250-350 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+enemy's 5% Lost HP) Physical Damage and restoring 10 energy on hit. The Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.
If this skill is interrupted, each remaining Bullet reduces the skill cooldown by 10%.
Passive: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 5%–15%.
skills.notes:
*Lesley can aim for up to 8 seconds.
*Firing Lethal Bullets lasts up to 3.6 seconds (or earlier if canceled).
**Each Lethal Bullet is fired for approximately every 0.9 seconds.
*Cooldown starts right upon cast.
*Lesley will recoil after firing a Lethal Bullet; the recoil is not a blink.
*Camera height will be raised throughout the skill duration.
*Lesley will stop firing Lethal Bullets if the locked enemy goes too far.
*You can hold the skill to choose the target before firing. You can also choose to cancel the skill without shooting it at all (it will still go on cooldown).
*If the skill is canceled without shooting any, Lesley is not revealed to the enemy.
*The aim range is 11 unit, and max range is 15 unit.
**The indicator is shown on Lesley's minimap when holding the skill, and the skill does not activate if there are no enemy hero within range.
**All enemies within range are revealed.

skills.heading: Buff
skills.name: Lesley buff
skills.description: Increases both HP by 10 when battling with Harley[.]

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mecha Suppression
skills.description: Jawhead's attacks apply a stack of Mecha Suppression on hit (up to 10 stacks). Each stack lasts 3 seconds and increases the damage of Jawhead's Basic Attacks to the enemy by 8%.

levelScaling.label: Basic Attack Damage Increase Per Stack

skills.notes:
*Only applies to non-minion enemies.
*Jawhead's attacks also refresh the duration of the stacks.
*"Attacks" that apply Mecha Suppression stacks only refer to Jawhead's basic attack and skill damage dealt.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Smart Missiles
skills.description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5 seconds, each missile dealing 135-260 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ejector
skills.description:
Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 250-600 (+180% Total Physical Attack) shield for S seconds.
Use Again: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300-500 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Can used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Unstoppable Force
skills.description: Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350-600 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning them.[duration unknown] Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of the damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.
skills.notes:
*This ability has three phases:
**Jawhead begins to channel the charge. If interrupted at this step, the ability does not go on cooldown.
**Jawhead travels to the target.
**Upon hitting the target, Jawhead loses CC immune and nearby enemy is knocked back.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Smart Heart
skills.description: Angela gains 7.5% extra Movement Speed for 4 seconds each time she casts a skill (up to 30%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Love Waves
skills.description:
Angela sends Love Waves in the target direction, dealing 170-320 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly,[duration needed] and applying a stack of mark to them (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3 seconds.
The Love Waves also restore 150-200 (+75% Total Magic Power) HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill and the recharge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.

levelScaling.label: Damage Increase Per Lover's Mark Stacks
Slow Effect Per Lover's Mark Stacks

skills.calc: ${\rm total\ skill\ DMG} = \bigl[ 140 + (30 \times skill\ lv.) + 80%\ total\ magic\ power \bigr] + (20% \times no.\ of\ Lover\text{'}s\ Mark\ stacks)$
skills.notes:
*With Assisted Aiming Mode enabled, Angela can cast Love Waves at nearby allied heroes if there's no enemy around her. (Added on Patch Notes 1.7.94.)
*Lover's Mark cannot be applied to minions.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Puppet-on-a-String
skills.description:
Angela launches a Puppet String at the target enemy, dealing 300-450 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gradually slowing them up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3 seconds, they'll be immobilized for 1.5 seconds and dealt 450-675 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Each stack of mark increases the final damage by 20%.
skills.calc:
${\rm final\ skill\ DMG} = \bigl[ 405 + (45 \times skill\ lv.) + 60%\ total\ magic\ power \bigr] + (20% \times no.\ of\ Lover\text{'}s\ Mark\ stacks)$
${\rm total\ movement\ SPD} = initial\ Movement\ SPD \times \left( 100 - \frac {4 \times skill\ duration} {15} \right)$

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Heartguard
skills.description:
Angela begins channeling [for 2 seconds], applying a 1000-2000 (+200-300% Total Magic Power) shield that lasts 6 seconds to the target allied hero regardless of distance. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 12 seconds, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost.
Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.
skills.notes:
*During the attaching state, Angela can cast this skill again to detach herself from the allied hero by blinking to the designated location away from the attached hero.
*Cooldown starts after casting the skill.
*The channeling phase can be interrupted by crowd control (that can interrupt skills) and displacement effects.
*Angela is untargetable during the Attaching State and cannot use any equipments or battle spells
*The effect persists if target ally becomes untargetable, such as Ling, Lunox or Hanzo.
*Cannot cast on ally inside Yin's domain nor allies outside of it if she is inside the domain, nor update their current health.
**An ally being pulled into Yin's domain will force Angela to pop out.
*Despite not having Mobility tag, this ability is disabled in Minsitthar's King's Calling.
**Angela can neither leave the attached ally when the ally is in Minsitthar's King's Calling

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Dagger Specialist
skills.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's max HP and restore 50 (+25% Total Magic Power) HP to himself.
skills.calc:
$\rm Enhanced \ basic \ attack \ DMG = \bigl(100% \times phyical \ attack \bigr) + \bigl[(3 \times no. \ runes)% \times lost \ HP_{target}\bigr]$
where $\rm lost \ HP_{target} = total \ HP_{target} - current \ HP_{target}$
skills.notes: *When Gusion gains a rune, his Basic Attack will be converted into Magic Basic Attack, dealing Magic Damage. But cannot critically strike.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Sword Spike
skills.description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200-300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.
Use Again}: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200-300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.
skills.notes:
*The second cast of Sword Spike has a limited range at an unknown distance. Hence, the player cannot use this skill again if Gusion is too far away from the marked target.
*This skill can be used again within 4 seconds. The second cast of Sword Spike does not cost mana, however.
*Gusion is not immune to crowd control during the dash of the second cast.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
skills.description:
Gusion throws a volley of [five] daggers in the target direction, each dealing 110-210 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2 seconds (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).
Use Again: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65-115 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.
skills.notes: *Cooldown starts when the duration of Shadowblade Slaughter ends.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Incandescence
skills.description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldown of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaugther was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.
Use Again: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target location.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts after the first cast of Incandescence.
*Incandescence be used again within 8 seconds after the initial cast.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Ashing
skills.description:
Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 0.6% of their Max HP per second for 4s.
At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage euqal to 6% of the target's Max HP to the enemy and stunning them for 1s (the same target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.)

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Burst Fireball
skills.description:
Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235-410 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The lingering flame on the ground will explode after 1s, dealing 118-205 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage
Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s and can hold up to 2 fireball charges. Hitting an enemy hero or Legend Creep with this skill wil immediately restore a fireball charge, while hitting a Minion will restore 50% of the recharge time.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Searing Torrent
skills.description:
Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200-300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them to the end of its path.
Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a fire wall at the end of its path that lasts 4s and deals 80-120 (+24% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second. Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Vengeance Flame
skills.description:
Valir removes all debuffs on himself and conjures 4 Vengeance Flames that last 9s. Each of his subsequent skillls consumes 1 Vengeance Flam to deal 30% extra base damage. The effects of both Burst Fireball and Searing Torrent can be enhanced.
Meanwhile, Valir gains 40% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Asura's Wrath
skills.description:
Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4 seconds.
He gains (6*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Asura Aura
skills.description: Martis cc and deals 350-650 (+130% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slow them by 40% for 2 seconds.
skills.notes:
*This skill makes Martis move forward a little, thus it counts as a blink skill despite not having blink tag.
*This skill is disabled while inside Minsitthar's ultimate.
*This skill enables Phoveus' ultimate.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Mortal Coil
skills.description:
Martis blink in the target direction three times, each time dealing 225-300 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick.
Use Again: Martis blink in the target direction, dealing 300-400 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and cc.
Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.
skills.notes:
*'s cooldown starts after casting the 1st or 2nd phase of the skill.
*'s 1st phase will trigger 3 stacks of , but only 1 stack on Brute Force Breastplate's Unique Passive Brute Force.
*Interruption: This skill can only be cc during charging.
*Exception immune: This skill is not immune to cc.
*This skill can be cc.
*Upon casting, there will be a slight delay before the first slash occurs that does a quick cc effect to all opponents infront and beside Martis.
**This is then immediately followed up by another slash that only does damage to all opponents infront and beside Martis.
**After the second slash, there will be another slight delay before the last slash occurs that does a quick cc effect to all opponents near Martis.
*The second phase of the skill immediately cc all opponents away from Martis upon making contact on his body.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Decimation
skills.description:
Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing 700-1100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%).
If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10 seconds and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5 seconds. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).
skills.notes:
*When an enemy Hero's HP drops below 40%, a enhanced will appear beneath them.
*There are two animations for his ultimate: he stabs the enemy with his blade after dashing in the first attempt; he jumps and stabs the enemy from above with his pair of blades in subsequent slays. Both of the animation does not differ in-game.
*If Martis successfully decimates a Hero equipped with Immortality, Skill Cooldown Reset and Movement Speed Bonus is still applied, able to recast the skill once more when the target Hero resurrected by the Unique Passive Immortal.
**The bonuses are also applied by decimating Heroes resurrected from 's .
*Decimation's cooldown only starts upon eliminating, or attempted to eliminate an enemy Hero with this skill.
*This skill can be interrupted by Crowd Control effects during dashing.
*This skill can be cc.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Radiance
skills.description: Uranus absorbs the energy generated by incoming attacks to strengthen theirself, regenerating a certain amount of HP every 0.8s. Each stack lasts 10s. When at max stacks (20), Uranus regenerates 48-224 HP (scales with level).

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ionic Edge
skills.description:
Uranus releases two energy blades that orbit around them, dealing 155-255 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy targets and slowing them by 30% for 2s.
Each time this skill deals damage to a target, they will be marked with stack for 6s (max of 1 stack per target per cast). Each stack increases the damage of this skill by 40% (to a max of 320%). Each energy blade will only deal damage to the same target once.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Transcendent Ward
skills.description:
Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80-200 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, and 160-400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300-750 (+200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s.
The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300-750 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Consecration
skills.description:
Uranus unleashes the energy stored within their body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200-400 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time).
Uranus directly gains 5-15 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
skills.description: Hanabi's Basic Attacks and Skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies (the first bounce deals 40% of the damage, and subsequent bounces deal 85% of the previous). Bounces from her Basic Attacks inherit a portion of Attack Effects.
skills.calc:
$\begin{align}
{\mathrm basic\ ATK\ damage\ decay} & = 40% \times 85%^{x-1} \\
{\mathrm where}\ x & = no.\ of\ basic\ ATK\ bounces
\end{align}$
skills.notes:
*Can bounce multiple times on the same enemy.
*If an enemy dies, the bounce does not trigger.
*Basic attacks do not bounce to enemies with invisibility, but does bounce to concealed enemies within sight.
*Does not bounce to nearby enemies when attacking a turret, but does bounce to a turret when another enemy is hit.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
skills.description:
Passive: The secret Ninjutsu of the Scarlet Shadow makes Hanabi immune to control effects when she has a shield from any source.
Active: Hanabi gains a 300-600 (+40% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5 seconds. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% Movement Speed, 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of damage dealt will also be added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units). The shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.
skills.notes:
*Hanabi has the passive even without learning this ability.
*Only provides CC Immune on self and allied shields.
*Only prevent upcoming CC on Hanabi, does not remove ongoing debuffs nor immune to them.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
skills.description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 450-600 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1 second. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30-180 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on them with no damage decay.
skills.notes: *Fully bounce to concealed enemies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
skills.description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300-500 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8 seconds. After 1 second, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300-500 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decays 20% damage.
skills.notes: *If enemies hit are displaced away from the hitting position, the bloom damage only takes place at the position before displacement.
skills.quote: A sprout without flowers. A blossom without leaves.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Trouble Maker
skills.description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them. Each mark reduces the target's Movement Speed by 1%, stacking up to 20%.
skills.notes:
*A mark has a duration of approximately 2.1 seconds (approximately 2.4 seconds if it is fully stacked) and the duration time can be reset by dealing damage.
*Only Chang'e's basic attacks and skills can leave a mark.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Starmoon Shockwave
skills.description:
Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing 350-500 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5 seconds.
Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon will send 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Crescent Moon
skills.description:
Chang'e summons the Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent 300-500 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 10% Movement Speed (that lasts until the shield is destroyed). Each time Chang'e casts a skill, she also gains 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds. Crescent Moon also allows Chang'e's Basic Attacks to deal 20 (+35% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage 2 times.
Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attack and skills, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 0.2 seconds.
skills.notes:
*The enhanced basic attack crits.
*The shield from Crescent Moon stacks with other shield sources, but its value does not change.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Meteor Shower
skills.description:
Chang'e fires 30 meteors in the target direction over 4 seconds, each dealing 60 (+21% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to Minions and Creeps. Chang'e also gains 10% Movement Speed for the duration.
Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon also fires meteors along with Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.
skills.notes:
*The Crescent Moon can fire up to 60 meteors.
*Reveal enemies.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Wings of Lightning
skills.description: Kaja's skill damage applies Paralysis effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5 seconds.
skills.quote: "Every feather is an extension of judgment."

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ring of Order
skills.description:
Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him.
Enemies hit take 160-285 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and recover 78-138 HP to Kaja.
Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.
skills.quote: "Thunder draws the line, and from it, order is born."

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Soaring Wings
skills.description:
Kaja dashes to the target area, gaining Control Immunity during the dash. On arrival, he deals 250-425 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, knocking back and stunning nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, then enters the Soaring state.
The Soaring state lasts 6.6 seconds. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% Movement Speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use Basic Attacks while moving, dealing 100 (+25% Total Magic Power) (+2% target's Max HP Magic Damage) to surrounding enemies.
Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings is reduced to 4 seconds (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Hitting a hero or creep extends the Soaring state by 2.6 seconds.
skills.quote: "Born of Nazar's defiance, he flew through thunderstorms and challenged the very heavens."

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Divine Binding
skills.description:
Kaja hurls a Primal Lightning Laso at the target area. After a 0.5 seconds delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area take 360-600 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are trapped for 2.5 seconds.
While active, Kaja can drag the lasso, shrinking its radius and pulling enemies at the boundary along with him (does not interrupt their skills).
skills.notes:
*Can't be removed by anti-CC effects, including Purify.
*This skill can be escaped only before Kaja drops his lasso.
skills.quote: "The judge never leaves; his thunder strikes those who prey on the weak."

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Symbiosis
skills.description: Selena can switch freely between her two forms. Elven Form: Selena applies "Abyssal Mark" with her skills. The mark can stack up to 2 times. When "Abyssal Trap" hits an enemy, it immediately adds an "Abyssal Mark". Abyssal Form: All damage will consume 1 stack of "Abyssal Mark" to deal 225 (+15 × Hero Level) (+40% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage. "Abyssal Mark" deals 285% extra damage to non-hero units.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Abyssal Trap
skills.description: Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk in a designated location. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches the location and slow them by 50%. After 3 seconds, the Abyssal Devil deals 350-550 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy and other nearby enemies and slows them by 50% for 1 second. The Abyssal Devil lasts up to 60 seconds. Up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time. Each extra Abyssal Devil increases the final damage by 50%.
skills.notes:
*The Abyssal Devils grant vision to the surrounding area.
*Damage increase is up to 150%.
skills.quote: The iron will of the Abyss befalls.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Soul Eater
skills.description: Selena strengthen her claws with the power of the Abyss, causing the next basic attack to deal extra 200-350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, while granting a Shield that absorbs 300-400 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield
skills.notes: *Enchanced Basic Attack can Crit.
skills.quote: The iron will of the Abyss befalls.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Abyssal Arrow
skills.description: Selena fires magic arrows in a designated direction, dealing 250-400 (+20% Total Magic Power) to 500-800 (+40% Total Magic Power) to the first enemy hero hit and stunning it for 0.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds. Stun duration and damage increase with the distance that the arrows travel. The arrow absorbs Abyssal Trap as it travels and hence will apply effects of "Abyssal Traps" to the enemy target upon hit. If an enemy is stunned for 0.9 second or longer, Selena's Movement Speed will be increased by 40% for 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Garotte
skills.description: Selena charges in a designated direction, dealing 150-350 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way. If this damage triggers "Abyssal Mark" effect, its CD resets immediately.
skills.notes: *Despite being a magic skill, Garotte does not trigger Magic Lifesteal but only triggers Spell Vamp.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Primal Darkness
skills.description:
Selena enters Abyssal Form and increases her Movement Speed by 30% for 0.8 seconds. Immediately resets the CD of "Soul Eater" and "Garotte". Abyssal Form: Selena gains new skills. Her Basic Attack will deal (+25% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage.
Passive: Selena gains 5-20 extra Magic Power.
skills.notes: *Her basic attack's extra damage only applies to one target; multiple targets hit will receive her basic physical damage.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Blessing of the Moon Goddess
skills.description:
Selena enters Elven Form and increases her Movement Speed for 30%. Lasts 0.8 seconds. Immediately reset the CD of "Abyssal Trap" and "Abyssal Arrow".
Passive: Selena gains 5-20 extra Magic Power.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Contract: Transform
skills.description:
After every 2 attacks, Aldous gains a 500 (+3 × Contract Soul Steal stack count) Shield for 3 seconds on his next Basic Attack.
This effect can only be triggered once every 5 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Contract: Soul Steal
skills.description:
Aldous unleashes his inner energy to enhance his next Basic Attack to kill enemies and absorb their soul each stack gives to deal Physical Damage equal to 200-450 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage plus 5 times the number of Soul Steal stacks.
If this attack kills an [Lord/Turtle/]enemy hero/[enemy turret/]Siege Minion/other-non hero unit, Aldous will gain [12/12/10/10/10/4] stacks of Soul Steal (up to 650 stacks).
The enhanced Basic Attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to Minions and Creeps. Aldous gets extra 5/2 stack) when a nearby enemy Siege Minion/other non-hero unit dies.
skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ physical\ damage} = 5 \times no.\ of\ stacks$
skills.notes:
*The enhanced basic attack lasts for 5 seconds or until it is consumed.
*Cooldown starts upon casting the skill, but the skill cannot be used again until the enhanced basic attack is consumed or expired.
*Aldous charges towards a target when attacking using his enhanced basic attack.
*The enhanced basic attack's base damage and extra damage do not critically strike.
*Gain stack when dying enemies have Immortality available.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Contract: Explosion
skills.description: Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction and 20% extra Movement Speed for 2 seconds or until manual cancellation. He then deals 100-200 (+20% Total Physical Attack)–200-400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5–1 second(s) (scales with defensive stance duration).
skills.calc:
$\rm{base\ damage} = \bigl[80 + (20 \times skill\ level) \bigr] + \bigl[(40 + 10 \times skill\ level) \times skill\ duration \bigr]$
${\rm physical\ bonus} = 20% + (10% \times skill\ duration)$
${\rm stun\ duration} = 0.5 s + (0.25 s \times skill\ duration)$
${\rm where} = 0s \leq skill\ duration \leq 2s$

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Contract: Chase Fate
skills.description:
Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5 seconds. During this time, if Aldous uses this skill again, he can dash toward an enemy hero [of choice]. When Aldous hits that enemy hero, he will deal 400-750 (+target's 8% Total HP) Physical Damage and knock back the target for 1 second. (Aldous can interrupt target's Recall [and Arrival] during the dash.)
[Use this skill once again to cancel the dash, and will blink to the designated direction instead.]
skills.notes:
*With the perfect timing, it is possible to interrupt Aldous from dashing using Grock's Guardian's Barrier or Yin's My Turn.
*The dash can only be interrupted by suppressed.
*He can freely use equipments and battle spells.
*Inside Yin's domain, he cannot lock on enemies outside and ongoing travel is cancelled.
**Likewise, he cannot select targets inside the domain, and does not pursue further when arriving in the target's last location.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Battle Side-by-side
skills.description: Dexter launches an extra attack each time Claude's Basic Attack lands, dealing 20 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the same target. Dexter's Basic Attack can also trigger Claude's attack effects with 30% effectiveness.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Art of Thievery
skills.description:
Claude attacks enemies in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 160-285 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Movement Speed by 20% and Attack Speed by 10%.
For each target hit, Claude gains 3% extra Movement Speed and Attack Speed (doubled if the target is an enemy hero, up to 5 stacks) for 6 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Battle Mirror Image
skills.description:
Claude leaves a mirror image of Dexter at a designated location. Dexter’s mirror image automatically attacks enemies. Lasts 5.5 seconds. Claude can activate this skill again to switch places with the mirror image.
Dexter's Basic Attack deals 20 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and can trigger Claude's attack effects.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts after summoning the mirror image.
*Claude can switch places, with a duration for 3 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Blazing Duet
skills.description: Claude and Dexter rapidly fire at the enemies nearby over 3 seconds, dealing 100-130 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to up to two targets each time they shoot. This skill benefits from Claude's Basic Attack effects and grants him a shield that can absorb 20 (+3% Total Physical Attack) damage.
skills.notes:
* The targeting description of this skill is misleading, Claude and Dexter can fire two individual shots on two enemy targets, when nearby, simultaneously and is not strictly on two targets when more is present. When there are more than 2 enemy targets, Claude and Dexter fires two individual shots at random. Splitting the damage dealt by chance.
* The skill only targets enemies who are visible. Which targets can evade the skill using stealth.
* This skill can only be interrupted by high-level crowd control effects (e.g cc, cc, cc, cc, etc).

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Windtalk
skills.description: Vale gains 1 stack of stack each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Wind Blade
skills.description: Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area. each dealing 250-450 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Windblow
skills.description: Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing 300-400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1 second (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, t will remain for 1.6 seconds while continuously dealing a total of 200-400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in range.
skills.notes:
*The sustained damage deals 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for each hit, and can deal up to 4 times.
*The sustained damage does not trigger damage effects.
*During the cast delay, you can use Flicker to reposition the source of the whirlwind.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Windstorm
skills.description:
Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of [150-300 (+30% Total Magic Power)] Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1.6 seconds, the windstorm will explode, dealing 900-1400 (+240% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.
skills.notes: *The sustained damage deals 25 / 37.5 / 50 (+5% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for each hit, and can deal up to 6 times.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: The Oath Keeper
skills.description:
Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. When this energy reach 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores 100 (+10 × Hero Level) (+15% Extra HP) HP.
Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage.
Mounted State: Each Oath Keeper energy gain is increased by 200%.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Momentum
skills.description:
Leomord begins channeling [for 1 second], slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500-800 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (scales with channel time)[calculation needed] and slowing them by 40% for 1 second.
Leomord can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling and immdiately perform the thrust.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Phantom Stomp
skills.description: Barbiel leaps forward, dealing 325-600 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemy units in the landing area in front of him, while slowing them by 40% for 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Decimation Assault
skills.description: Leomord charges towards a designated direction, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Phantom Charge
skills.description: Barbiel charges forward in a designated direction, and knocks back all enemies on the path, dealing 300-500 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: *Despite its name, "Phantom Charge" is technically a blink skill.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Phantom Steed
skills.description:
Leomord summons Barbiel to rush to him, dealing [template:Sscale base=100-300; total-pa=40] to all enemies in its path.
If Barbiel comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2 seconds.
Mounted State: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains extra 70 Movement Speed and 30–110 Physical & Magic Defense. This lasts 10 seconds.
skills.notes: *Enemies will be knocked back by charging Barbiel and will be displaced to the side of the AOE.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Dreamland Twist
skills.description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.
When Lunox uses Power of Order, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for every 1% Magic Penetration.
When Lunox uses Power of Chaos, she gains 0.5% Magic Penetration for every 1% of Spell Vamp.
skills.notes:
*Despite the description, Lunox's percentage magic penetration with 1 Order stack is indeed subtracted and converted into spell vamp and vice versa with 1 Chaos stack.
*Only percentage Magic Penetration is converted. Net value Magic Penetration, such as from Rupture, Genius Wand or Arcane Boots is not converted.
*Upon death, Lunox loses the current stack of Order and Chaos.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Starlight Pulse
skills.description:
Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200-350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each restoring and recovering 75-100 (+30% Total Magic Power) HP. The HP restored is doubled when hitting enemy heroes.
Grants one stack of Power of Order after use.
skills.notes:
*Both skills 1 and 2 share the same cooldown and skill level. Levelling up one ability levels another.
*Has the range of 4.5 unit.
*If a target dies before a starlight reaches, the starlight will not return, result in no heal.
*Lunox fully benefits from returning starlights even when untargetable.
*Fully bounce to unsighted, concealed or invisible enemies, but not untargetable enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Chaos Assault
skills.description:
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at an enemy, dealing Magic Damage equal to 250-350 (+120% Total Magic Power) (+target's 2.5%-5% Total HP) (1.5%–3% of Max HP against Creeps).
Grants one stack of Power of Chaos after use.
skills.notes:
*Both skills 1 and 2 share the same cooldown and skill level.
*Has the range of 5 unit, similar to her attack range.
**The animation is slightly further than the effective range.
*Fully affect unsighted enemy, such as in a bush, invisible or in concealed.
*When affected by Power of Chaos Darkening, this ability is neither affected by cooldown reduction, cooldown speed nor costs any mana.

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Cosmic Fission
skills.description: When Lunox uses the power of Order and Chaos, she will deal 300-500 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the targets along the way and slow them by 40% for 2 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Has the range of 5 unit, beginning slightly behind Lunox.
*The ability first displays the animation and sound, then the cooldown, damage and effect gradually in a rectangular area, which in some cases when being controlled during the cast delay, only the animation is displayed.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Order & Chaos
skills.description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.
When Lunox uses Power of Order, she gains Brilliance and becomes invincible while dealing continuous damage to nearby enemies.
When Lunox uses Power of Chaos, she gains Darkening and can blink in a target direction and greatly reduces the cooldown of Chaos Assault for a brief period.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Power of Order: Brilliance
skills.description: Lunox extends the Light Barrier, becomes invincible for 2.5 seconds, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed while dealing 100-140 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies.
skills.notes:
*Brilliance and Darkening have separate cooldown timer.
*Has the radius of 3.2 unit.
*Retribution and items like Winter Crown can be used during the process.
*Does not remove any ongoing control effects or impending buff, such as Cyclone Eye, but removes Power of Chaos Darkening, does not pass through obstacles.
*Lunox disappears on the minimap for the duration.
*Lunox is still attackable by creeps, minions, Lord and Turtle.
*The remaining invincible time is visible to both allies and enemies.
*The first pulse takes effect right upon cast. Result in total 6 damage pulses.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Power of Chaos: Darkening
skills.description:
Lunox blinks in the target direction, dealing 250-450 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, slowing them by 30% for 4 seconds.
For the next 4s, Lunox enhances her Power of Chaos to greatly reduce the cooldown of Chaos Assault (unaffected by CD Reduction). When casting Chaos Assault while the Darkening State is still active, Mana will not be reduced.
skills.notes:
*Brilliance and Darkening have separate cooldown timer.
*The dash has the distance of 3.5 unit, the slow and damage effect has the distance of 3.2 unit.
*The cast range of Chaos Assault becomes visible for the duration.
*The cooldown of Chaos Assault is set to 0.3 seconds and is not affected by cooldown reduction and cooldown speed for the duration.
*Chaos Assault does not cost mana for the duration.
*The duration begins as soon as the ability is cast, which means if the landing is interrupted, the damage and slow effect of this skill does not take effect.
*The remaining duration is visible to both allies and enemies.
*If Lunox has neither Order or Chaos stack upon learning ultimate, this ultimate is selected by default.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Ame No Habakiri
skills.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
skills.description:
This skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600-800 (+120%-160% Extra Physical Attack), recovers 10%~20% HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Soul Snatch
skills.description: Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing 300-400 (+60%-80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and its surrounding units after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases the damage by 20% (surrounding units are not affect by this bonus). When the target has max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu, it deals additional damage equal to 15 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP (this damage ignores of 30% of the target's Physical Defense) and recovers 30% HP for Hanzo.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
skills.description:
Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals 90-140 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Black Mist
skills.description:
Hanekage dashes in the target direction, briefly knocking enemies in his path airborne for 0.4 seconds and leaving dark mist in the area he passes through (recovers 200 Energy when hitting an enemy hero). The mist deals 135-210 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit.)
The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40%.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
skills.description:
Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position.
While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, and Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed.
Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 16% HP and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Ninjutsu Flee: Return
skills.description: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and exits the Hanekage form.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Deadly Thorns
skills.description:
For every 50 damage inflicted upon Belerick, he has a 25% chance to shoot the nearest enemy unit, dealing Magic Damage equal to 55 (+5 × Hero Level) plus 1.8% of his Max HP (scales with level). In each 0.4 seconds, this attack can be triggered once only.
His HP obtained from Equipment and Emblems is increased by 30%.
skills.notes:
*This skill gets spell vamp without being reduced, unlike magic lifesteal.
*With enough distance, the thorns cannot reach the enemy, e.g., Layla's max range with 3 points in ult.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ancient Seed
skills.description: Belerick releases vines in a designated direction, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on the path and slow them down by 25%. Meanwhile, he leaves Ancient Seed on the path, and after 1 second, these seeds will deal 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on the path and taunt them for 1.2 seconds. To minions, 80% extra damage will be dealt.
skills.notes:
*If Belerick dies, taunted enemies still move towards Belerick, but do not attack.
*When Belerick uses Winter Crown, the taunted enemies keeps attacking, but no damage is dealt. Fully trigger Deadly Thorns

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Nature's Strike
skills.description:
Belerick increases his Movement Speed by 80% and strengthens his next Basic Attack. (The Movement Speed gain will decay in 2 seconds.)
This enhanced Basic Attack deals 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows the target by 60% for 1.4 seconds. Belerick also regenerates HP equal to 240 plus 10% of his lost HP.
Each time Deadly Thorns is triggered, reduce the cooldown of this skill by 1s.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Wrath of Dryad
skills.description: Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area 4 times and taunting them for 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*If Belerick dies, taunted enemies still move towards Belerick, but do not attack.
*When Belerick uses Winter Crown, the taunted enemies keeps attacking, but no damage is dealt. Fully trigger Deadly Thorns.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Aerial Dominance
skills.description:
Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack deals (+22%% Total Physical Attack) (+27%% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Hitting enemy heroes/non-hero units restores 6/3 Starlium. At max Starlium, Kimmy's Basic Attacks are enhanced to deal (+27%% Total Physical Attack) (+32%% Total Magic Power) damage and pierce through targets.
Kimmy doesn't stop moving while shooting and no longer benefits from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed she gains is converted to 1 Magic Power.
skills.notes:
*If no Starlium is gained within 7 seconds, the Starlium begins to deplete.
*Due to this passive Kimmy cannot use Manual Targeting.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Anti-Grav Thruster
skills.description: Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to Slow Effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 90% Movement Speed for 1 second. During the flight, she fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 20 (+25%% Total Physical Attack) (+30%% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds.
skills.notes: *Chemical Bolts ignore invisible, concealed and unsighted enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Starlium Beam
skills.description:
Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction that immobilizes enemies in its path and deals 300 (+50%% Total Physical Attack) (+60%% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 2 seconds.
Gain 20 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Traction Pulse
skills.description:
Kimmy charges and fires a Traction Pulse in a target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes to deal 200 (+60%% Total Physical Attack) (+72%% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 75%.
After 1 second, the field contracts, pulling all enemy heroes to its center and dealing 15% of their current HP as Magic Damage. Gain 40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown begins as soon as the ability is cast.
*Kimmy can hold the ability for 3 seconds.
* The HP based damage on the second part of this ability will not trigger Wishing Lantern's passive

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Grand Lord Lava
skills.description: Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a 10%-60% chance (based on Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55 (+8 × Hero Level) (+60% Total Physical Attack) True Damage. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy will increase Thamuz's Lava Rage. When without Scythes, Thamuz gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy
skills.notes:
*Lava Energy deals skill damage.
*The enhanced basic attack allows Thamuz to dash to the target's location. Note that attacks triggered by Rage are not counted as a dash, despite having the same visual effect.
*The enhanced basic attack range is 3.0

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Molten Scythes
skills.description:
Thamuz tosses Scythes in the target direction. After travelling for a certain distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120-270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45-80 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5 seconds.
After leaving Thamuz for [≈5 seconds] or a certain distance, the Scythes will return to Thamuz and drag enemies in their path to him. Thamuz can approach the Scythes or cast the skill again to retrieve them.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts after retrieving the Scythes.
*The Scythes do not stop upon hitting minions (added on Patch Notes 1.6.84).
*Thamuz cannot cast the 2nd phase of Molten Scythes for approximately 0.2 seconds after casting the same skill.
*Retrieving the scythes by tapping again the skill is not considered as a skill cast.
*Thamuz can use this skill while under CC effects, including Suppression.
*Unlike his passive, the enhanced basic attack gained from retrieving the scythes is considered a movement ability, meaning Phoveus can benefit from it through Demonic Force.
*Pulling a target stuns them for approximately 0.1 seconds, which is enough to interrupt certain channeled abilities, such as Feathered Air Strike.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Chasm Trample
skills.description:
Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230-355 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2 seconds upon landing.
If the scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.
skills.notes: *Chasm Trample follows the same logic as certain 'jump' abilities such as Guinevere's Spatial Migration, meaning it can reach a longer distance when used at a maximum distance behind a wall.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Cauterant Inferno
skills.description:
Thamuz spouts the lava stored in his body, dealing 300-480 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Inferno around him. The Cauterant Inferno lasts 9 seconds and deals 30-60 (+10% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies in the area.
Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800-1200 (+50% Extra HP) extra Max HP, heals himself by the same amount, and increases his Attack Speed by 60%-100%. He also recovers 1.5%-2.5% Max HP each time he deals damage with Basic Attacks or his Scythes.
skills.notes:
*The attack speed increase is multiplied to the total attack speed.
*Healing during dealing damage with skills and basic attacks does not include sustained damage from Molten Scythes and Cauterant Inferno.
*Although unspecified on the skill's description, Thamuz gains full rage from Grand Lord Lava on cast.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Key Insight
skills.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Synchro Fission
skills.description: Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom will then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing 236-376 (+84% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemy units on the path.
