When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, dealing 590-940 (+210% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enmies in the explosion area.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Chrono Dash
skills.description: Harith dashes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals Magic power from enemy heroes, generates a shield that absorbs at least 185-310 (+140% Total Magic Power) damage and enhances his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals 225-350 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's enhanced Basic Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Zaman Force
skills.description:
Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force. When the multidimensional rift appears, the cooldown of Chrono Dash is  reduced by 4 seconds. The rift initially slows enemy heroes in the area by 70% and will continuously slows enemy heroes by 35% afterwards.
If Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he will absorb the energy within and reduce the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1 seconds and Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.
Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.
skills.notes: *The Rift has the length of 12 unit.
skills.quote: They say geniuses recognize one another!, a quote from Harley.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mark of the King
skills.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of mark, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all Mark of the King stacks, dealing 400 (+6% Total HP) Physical Damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds while healing Minsitthar for 400 (+6% Total HP) HP. Can only trigger once every 6 seconds on the same target.
skills.notes:
*Extra damage counts as skill damage.
*It can trigger Brave Smite.
*The stun is triggered by attacking a target with 5 marks, not when the 5th mark is placed on the target.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Spear of Glory
skills.description: Minsitthar thrusts forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing 175-300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6 seconds. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls back the spear, dealing 175-300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies along the way and dragging enemy heroes hit to him.
skills.notes:
*The spear pulls enemies into Minsitthar's current position, allowing them to be pulled sideways or further away with Flicker.
**Enemies hit by the tip of the spear and suffering the stun effect are able to be pulled from any distance, regardless of how far Minsitthar is displaced from his original cast location.
***Enemies not stunned by the initial cast but laying within the path of the spear will only be pulled if they remain within the area when it happens, allowing them to escape should the AOE of the skill be displaced.
*The pull component of this skill can be immediately cancelled into his King's Calling or Shield Assault, provided they were queued in advance after casting.
**Cancelling into King's Calling will allow the skill to pull sideways or further away, similar to combining with Flicker
***Both of these can be combined to allow for extremely long pulls. However, it requires precision timing, and Flicker must be cast after King's Calling's blink animation is triggered, as the former cancels the latter if cast too early. Casting Flicker too late will also cause enemies to only be pulled to the edge of the Ultimate's radius.
**Cancelling into Shield Assault casts the skill at the exact moment an enemy would enter the range of the second skill without displacements, allowing Minsitthar to more quickly rack up stacks of Mark of the King.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Shield Assault
skills.description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100-200 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2 seconds). Meanwhile, he enters Phalanx state for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken from the front by 25%–50% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100-200 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit.
skills.notes:
*Minsitthar's cannot change the direction he's facing during Phalanx state.
* While in this stance, Minsitthar's Basic Attacks will have increased attack rate. (Patch Notes 1.7.68).
* Minsitthar's enhanced Basic Attack can deal damage to turrets.
* Casting other skills immediately ends Phalanx state.
* This state can only be interrupted with suppressed.
* Phalanx state's basic attack uses a separate damage formula compared to his regular basic attacks. It is NOT an extra damage component added on top of his regular basic attack damage, but rather a secondary type of basic attack entirely.
** Due to it's low scaling, attaining high amounts of Physical Attack will allow regular basic attacks to out-damage those from Phalanx State.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: King's Calling
skills.description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field for (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.
skills.notes:
*Despite its description, casting King's Calling technically "blinks", not "charges."
*Royal Guards are invincible.
* Royal Guards will apply one Mark of the King per attack.
* Royal Guards' basic attacks can trigger 40% Minsitthar's attack effects.
** Despite this, they will not trigger emblem talents with basic attack trigger requirements such as Quantum Charge, Concussive Blast, and Weakness Finder, nor will they trigger them for Minsitthar, but they will still trigger Focusing Mark
*They internally benefit from attack speed, but their attack rate is fixed (one (1) attack every 0.93 seconds). This means that they can only attack up to five times regardless of attack speed.
**However, they can benefit from Golden Staff, which allows them to get the equivalent of two (2) additional basic attacks via the "Endless Strike" passive, this also conveniently allows the Royal Guards to apply triple the amount of Mark of the King stacks on the hit that triggers this passive.
*They benefit from critical chance but they cannot reduce the cooldown time of Windtalker's Unique Passive "Typhoon" (by either critical chance attribute or by attacking, making the passive only available on their first attack).
*They cannot trigger Azure Blade and items whose one of the component items are Azure Blade due to their inability to cast skills.
* The Guards will attack any enemies within its attack range but prioritizes enemies within the field.
* Royal Guards do not benefit from penetration attribute items.
** Royal Guards can gain penetration from War Axe's passive.
* Royal Guards will trigger Thunder Belt's "Thunderbolt" passive AOE individually, but will not grant its stacks of permanent hybrid defense onto Minsitthar
Mobility Disable Component:
* Enemy abilities with the Mobility tag in their description is disabled.
* Purify and other Crowd control immunity abilities will not free enemies from root while they remain within the AOE of this skill, even by becoming untargetable.
** An exception to this would be if an ability that would be cancelled by this skill was already mid-cast when the AOE is summoned, such as the charging component of Lancelot's Phantom Execution and/or Benedetta's Alecto Final Blow, in which case they would still fire off without issue, potentially allowing them to escape.
* For more details, see root.
skills.quote: Where will I be?

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Thalassophobia
skills.description: Kadita gains the Blessing of the Ocean every 30 seconds. The Blessing is triggered when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts 4 seconds, allowing her to recover 65% of the HP Lost within the duration afterward.
skills.notes: *This skill formerly reduced the Attack Speed of the enemy that was hit by Kadita by 60%.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Ocean Ode
skills.description:
Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250-450 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.
Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.
skills.notes:
*If Kadita is suppressed or uses Winter Crown, the remaining effect persists, but she cannot stop at will.
*Formerly named "Ocean Oddity."

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Breath of the Ocean
skills.description:
After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350-550 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1 second.
Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.
skills.notes: *The delay is 0.8 seconds. If casted to stop Ocean Ode, the delay is reduced to 0.6 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Rough Waves
skills.description:
Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each dealing 270-330 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180-220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.
When diving underground, Kadita cannot be interrupted (excluding Suppression).
When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.
skills.notes:
*The delay is 0.5 seconds. (After the buff in Patch Note 1.9.91).
*When Kadita successfully dives underground, this skill removes all existing debuffs, crowd controls, and damage over time on Kadita.
*She can freely use equipments and battle spells. Using Winter Crown will maker her unable to move.
*She is still affected by Cyclone Eye.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Vicious Retrieval
skills.description: Every 4 seconds, Faramis's next skill against enemy heroes and summoned objects generates a soul fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) HP and gain 2 extra Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed soul fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance[how much?] to drop soul fragments.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Shadow Stampede
skills.description:
Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3 seconds, gaining 70% extra Movement Speed, 25 extra Physical and Magic Defense, 20% cooldown reduction of this skill, and the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes that come into contact with Faramis in this state are dealt 250-400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applied with a mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250-400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Use again to leave the Shadow state early and drags marked enemies toward him.
The range of soul fragment absorption is increased while this skill is active.
skills.notes: *Entering and leaving Yin's My Turn cancel this ability.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Ghost Bursters
skills.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330-480 (+144% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200-300 (+72% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (splits up to 2 times on enemy hero hits and 1 time on non-enemy hero hits).

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Nether Realm
skills.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the Nether Realm for 6s, making affected allied hero (including himself) enter the Specter state and granting them 400-800 plus 10 (+5% Total Magic Power)% extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When Specter state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1s. An allied hero's Specter state ends when they leave the Nether Realm.
skills.notes:
*Replace Faramis and affected allies' health bar for the duration.
*The bonus health is affected by healing amplification or reduction.
*The shield from abilities and items are hidden and unaffected by damage when bonus health remains.
*Affected units are untargetable during Resurrection state.
*The extra health makes the effect of this ability always take priority over on-death effects, such as Nana's Molina's Gift or Immortality.
*The effect ends prematurely if Faramis' bonus health depletes.
*A unit can only benefit once per this ability cast.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Chivalry Fist
skills.description:
After every 4 Basic Attacks, Badang's next Basic Attack deals 50 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) extra pd to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (minions and creeps are stunned directly).
Fist Wind generated by Badang's skills can also trigger this effect.
skills.notes:
*  can trigger  effects like Demon Hunter Sword, Feather of Heaven and benefit from Lifesteal as it is separate from the original basic attack.
** It however cannot Crit and be triggered twice by Golden Staff.
* Heroes knocked back to a wall are actually stunned for 2 seconds. This is also the case for Minions and Creeps hit.
* The Dashing speed of the 5th  scales to Badang's Attack Speed.
* Heroes knocked back are moved a distance equal to the position of Badang and the edge of his  range.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Fist Wind
skills.description:
Badang unleashes a gust of Fist Wind in the target direction, dealing 125-225 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The Fist Wind will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100-175 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Fist Wind can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 Chivalry Fist stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 Fist Wind charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.
skills.notes:
*  can't crit or benefit from Spell Vamp, but it will trigger other Basic attack effects.
** The explosion damage does however, trigger Spell Vamp.
**  triggers on-hit effects such as Blade of the Heptaseas' Ambush and Endless Battle's Divine Justice on-cast.
* The  effect included is regarded as skill damage.
** It can trigger effects like Antique Cuirass' Deter and benefits from Spell Vamp.
* Heroes knocked back to a wall are actually stunned for 2 seconds. This is also the case for Minions and Creeps hit.
* It can damage turrets if casted inside their range but the damage dealt is based on  not 's stats.
* Heroes knocked back are moved a distance equal to the position of Badang and the edge of his  range.
* 's only explodes once even if passing through multiple obstacles,
* Heroes, Minions, and Creeps hit by 's projectile right before it dissipates only takes damage and slow, but are not knocked back nor inflicted with  damage.
** This could be the reason why  couldn't deal damage to turrets outside their range despite able to outrange them.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Fist Break
skills.description:
Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230-330 Physical Damage to enemies in his path while gaining a 350-600 shield that lasts 5 seconds. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knock back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4 seconds behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130-180 Physical Damage.
Use Again: Badang removes the obstacle he created.
skills.notes:
* Badang will only create an obstacle if he encounters Heroes on his way.
** He will pass through 's illusion, 's Dopplegangers or 's original body when  is active.
* Heroes knocked back are moved a distance equal to the position of Badang and the edge of his  range but a bit farther than usual.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Fist Crack
skills.description:
Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60-120 Physical Damage to enemies hit 9 times over 2.5 seconds (can trigger attack effects). The Fist Wind generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30-60 Physical Damage to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.
skills.notes:
* Blade of the Heptaseas's Unique Passive Ambush triggers on the first hit of this skill.
* Endless Battle's Divine Justice and other passive effects alike will trigger on the first hit of this skill only if Badang has already casted another skill prior.
**This skill can only be cancelled/interrupted by Suppression during throwing.
* The  effect included is regarded as skill damage.
** It can trigger effects like Antique Cuirass' Deter and benefits from Spell Vamp.
* Heroes knocked back to a wall are actually stunned for 2 seconds. This is also the case for Minions and Creeps hit.
* It can damage turrets once if casted inside their range but the damage dealt is based on  not 's stats.
* Heroes knocked back are moved to the edge of 's skill range rather than a set distance.
* Heroes, Minions, and Creeps are only knocked back/stunned at the start of , this includes .
* 's Fist Winds only explodes once even if passing through multiple obstacles,
* Heroes, Minions, and Creeps hit by 's Fist Winds right at its very edge only takes damage, but are not knocked back/stunned nor inflicted with  damage.
* Since  is only triggered once at start of , this could be the the reason why  couldn't continuesly damage turrets with .
skills.quote: Fight to protect and persist for benevolence.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Spell Curse
skills.description:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 12 seconds, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range [Cast Range: 4.9] and deals [(+120% Total Physical Attack) (+target's 6% Max HP) Magic Damage]. Also slows the target by 30% for 1.5 seconds and heals Khufra by 8% of his Max HP on hit.
Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4 seconds.
skills.notes:
*The range of Spell Curse can be increased by Malefic Gun and its passive Malefic Energy.
*The skill description erroneously identified Esmeralda as the one who cursed Khufra.
*The curse was inflicted by Eslora, Esmeralda's ancestor, according to the heroes' respective stories.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Tyrant's Revenge
skills.description: Khufra pulls the bandage on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing  50–100 plus 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP Physical Damage to all enemy units on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering a first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50–100 plus 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP  Physical Damage to enemies nearby and then knocking them in the air for up to 1.1 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Tyrant's Revenge goes into cooldown when Khufra starts to charge.
**The cooldown is reduced to 50% once Khufra manually canceled the skill.
*This skill can be charged up to 1.5 seconds and can be overcharged for another 3 seconds.
* The blink distance and the airborne duration scales with the channel time.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Bouncing Ball
skills.description: Khufra uses bandage to wrap himself into a magic bouncing ball, increasing his own Physical & Magic Defense by 30%–100&. Enemies trying to use blink skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.[duration needed] Each time the magic bouncing ball hits the ground, it will deal Magic Damage equal to 50–100 plus 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and slow them by 80%. Lasts 0.2 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Bouncing Ball cannot disable Flicker battle spell. (Patch Notes 1.5.30 (Advanced Server))
* This skill can only be interrupted by airborne, frozen, suppressed or transformed crowd control effects.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Tyrant's Rage
skills.description: Khufra pulls back all enemy targets around him toward his front, dealing 300-600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them down for 1.25–1.75 seconds. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra Physical Damage equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.
skills.notes: *Cooldown starts after Khufra casts the skill.
skills.quote: Let those who comply with me thrive and those who resist me perish.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Capriccio
skills.description:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons have a staring Energy cap of 800. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Each Minion / Creep kill will permanently increase the Energy cap of Granger's Gun and Cannon by 6 / 6, and instantly restore their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Every kill or assist on an enemy hero will permanently increase their Energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% Energy.
Every 1% CD Reduction Granger gains is converted into 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy Cost is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions.
skills.notes: *Demonic Energy Cost is technically not an energy as it is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions from the purple buff and the energy is omitted on his stats as seen on Granger's Story Page in-game.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Rhapsody
skills.description:
Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing 60-120 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last bullet is guaranteed to Crit. Each bullet deals an additional 70 damage to Creeps and Minions. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 15%.
Granger stops firing when he runs out Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.
skills.notes: *Granger can cast Rondo throughout the duration of this skill, but he cannot change the direction he's facing.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Rondo
skills.description:
Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15%-25% Energy for his Gun.
Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 second.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Death Sonata
skills.description:
Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150-300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be slowed and revealed for a brief duration. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.
skills.notes: *Bullet passes through creeps and minions and deals the same damage to them.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Super Magic
skills.description:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies.
Guinevere deals (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks and accumulates Super Magic each time she deals damage. When she's fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage on hit and restoring 80 (+Guinevere's 8% Lost HP) HP. Enemies hit by Guinevere's enhanced Basic Attack, Energy Wave, or Spatial Migration are marked for 5 seconds. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.
skills.notes:
*Damage increase only applies to Guinevere's skills and basic attack.
*Guinevere accumulates 34 Super Magic from basic attacks.
*Enhanced Basic Attack range is 4 units.
*Applying marks is not affected by Golden Staff Unique Passive - Endless Strike. (see Patch Notes 1.6.66)
*The enhanced basic attack will slightly knock back enemies if they're airborne.
*The initial Airborne duration of the Mark lasts for 0.4 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Energy Wave
skills.description:
Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300-525 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.2 seconds.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Guinevere accumulates 34 Super Magic each time she deals damage.
*The skill range is 6.35 units long

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Spatial Migration
skills.description:
Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250-400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage [,stunning enemies within it for 1 second]. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1 second and take 125-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage.
After cast, Guinevere can reactivate the skill in 5 seconds to blink toward the target direction [while invisible for 0.5 seconds] and leave an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and will explode in 1.5 seconds, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.
skills.notes:
*Guinevere accumulates 34 Super Magic each time she deals damage.
*The skill range is 5.3 units far.
**Phase 2 of Spatial Migration does not accumulate Super Magic.
*This skill was formerly named "Magic Thump".
*Guinevere will not be affected by Immobilize and Stun if the skill is already casted.
*Guinevere can land much further than she is supposed to by using Flicker.
*The illusion does not restore Super Magic for Guinevere when struck by turrets.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Violet Requiem
skills.description: Guinevere creates a force field around her [for 2 seconds], attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2 seconds, dealing 880-1320 (+385% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total. If the enemy hit is already airborne, they will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times. Guinevere is immune to Crowd Control while casting this skill.
skills.notes:
*Each attack deals 80 / 100 / 120 (+35% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
*Guinevere accumulates 10 Super Magic each time she deals damage.
*The skill range is 4.15 units wide
*Each airborne hits lasts for 0.44 seconds.
*Each attack lands every 0.1818... seconds meaning the final total damage outcome is a bit lower than described.
skills.quote: Violet Requiem, where is my dear friend?

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Starmoon Casket
skills.description:
Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 100 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.[amount/conversion rate unknown]
skills.notes:
*Frostmoon's shield to enemies is a debuff, therefore, healing increases (e.g. "Bless" from Oracle) and healing reductions will not be applied to those, and it can also be removed by effects such as Purify.
*Frostmoon's shield for enemies can be stacked up, which is unlimited and lasts for 5 seconds. Its duration is reset by inflicting damage by Frostmoon.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Frostmoon Shield
skills.description: Esmeralda gains 500-1000 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 40% Movement Speed which rapidly decays over its duration for 4 seconds. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of her nearby enemies into her own shield,[amount unknown] capped at 50% of her Max HP.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Stardust Dance
skills.description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240-440 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 300-550 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of Frostmoon Shield is reduced by 1.5 seconds (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5 seconds reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% for 1.5 second.
skills.notes: * When an enemy hero and a creep are both hit, the cooldown reduction when hitting an enemy hero takes priority and they do not stack.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Falling Starmoon
skills.description:
Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range.
Use Again: Esmeralda casts the Stardust at the target location, dealing 350-650 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and then blinks to target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350-650 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*This skill can be charged up to 1.5 seconds and can be overcharged for another 3 seconds.
*If this skill is interrupted or manually cancelled, the mana cost will be refunded.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Body of Smith
skills.description: Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1 × Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost. He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed he's supposed to recieve into 1 extra Physical Attack.
skills.notes: *Reduction of Terizla's base Attack Speed will result to Physical Attack decrease.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Revenge Strike
skills.description: Terizla cracks the ground with his hammer and the fissure will spread out, dealing 300-450 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. After the fissure hits the first target, it will drill into the target and slow them by 30%. At the same time, Terizla's Movement Speed will be increased by 15-40% for 3.5 seconds. The fissure on target will then explode, dealing 300-450 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+enemy's 20% Lost HP) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: *This skill only deals up to 1000 Physical Damage no matter how critical is the enemy's HP.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Execution Strike
skills.description:
Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90-315 (+135% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third deals 225-450 (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds (the Slowing Effect can stack).
Deals only 80-100% damage to Minions.
skills.notes:
*2nd and 3rd Execution Strike can be casted within 4 seconds.
**Cooldown starts when the duration of the skill ends, or when the final phase has been casted.
**This skill can only be interrupted by Supression effects.
*Terizla can move briefly while casting, but will be momentarily unable to move when the skill is executed.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Penalty Zone
skills.description: Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300-600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne by 0.6 seconds. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25-45%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150-250 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Firaga Armor
skills.description:
X.Borg's [HP inherits (+20% Extra HP), and his Firaga Armor inherits (+120% Extra HP)] and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When the Armor is destroyed, X.Borg will disengage from it and roll in the direction of the Joystick (he is immune to damage [and control effects] in this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate [for 3 energy per second] while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restore it to 30% of his [Armor HP].
X.Borg's skills deal True Damage in Overheated state.
skills.notes:
*The HP Armor's "energy" is technically not an energy attribute since X.Borg's doesn't benefit from the purple buff and the energy is omitted on his stats.
*X.Borg's Basic Attack becomes ranged, Fire Missiles and Fire Stake are adjusted, and X.Borg becomes unable to cast Last Insanity during his Armorless State.
*X.Borg's state determines HP scaling (including Max HP, Lost HP, and Current HP) from abilities, battle spells, and equipment unique passives, as his HP and Armor HP cannot be combined during the scaling. His Armor HP can only be scaled in his Armored state, while HP can only be scaled during Armorless State.
*"Fire damage" refers only to damage dealt by X.Borg's basic attacks and skills.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Fire Missiles
skills.description:
X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25-100 (+60% Total Physical Attack) (+40% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 7 times over 2 seconds to enemies in range (75%–100% damage to Minions).
Armorless state: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.
skills.notes:
*Fire Missiles is not visible during stealth.
*This skill can only be interrupted by high- and ultimate-level control effects.
*Yin's My Turn cancels this ability upon entering and leaving.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Fire Stake
skills.description:
X.Borg shoots 5 Fire Stakes at the edge of the fan-shaped indicator and retrieves them after 1.7 seconds, each dealing 50-100 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and pulling the enemies in the path toward him. Firaga Supplies in the path will also be retrieved if touched by Fire Stakes.
Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts Fire Stake Launcher to increase its range and shorten the distance between Fire Stakes.
skills.notes: *Retrieving Fire Stakes apply a micro stun to enemies. (Patch Notes 1.7.58)

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Last Insanity
skills.description:
X.Borg charges forward in the target direction while rotating and spraying fire, dealing 90-110 (+130% Extra Physical Attack) (+90% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 12 times and slowing enemies by 25%. He stops upon running into an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3 seconds from the start of the skill, X.Borg's Firaga Armor will detonate, dealing [300-700 (+enemy's 15% Total HP) True Damage to nearby enemies]. If the Armor is destroyed before it can self-detonate, it will only deal 50% of the damage. When his Armor detonates, X.Borg will dash a short distance in the Joystick's direction and enter Armorless State while removing all debuffs from himself.
This skill cannot be used in the Armorless State.
Use Again: X.Borg stops spraying fire and immediately detonates his Firaga Armor.
skills.notes:
*X.Borg's movement speed during Last Insanity gradually decays.[amount needed]
*He gains control immunity within the skill duration.
*Yin's My Turn does not cancel this ability.
skills.quote: My hometown was once a beautiful place.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Cloud Walker
skills.description: Ling's superb Lightness Skill helps him leap among walls. When resting on the wall, He gains 4 Lightness Points per second when he's on a walland 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage. Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Critical Damage.
skills.notes:
*Ling cannot jump on the following walls:
**Badang's Fist Break, Grock's Guardian's Barrier
**The inner edge of Yin's My Turn
**Brawl wall
**1v1 wall
*Ling is fully visible to enemies and on minimap if sighted.
*Crowd controls will unperch Ling and put the ability on cooldown.
*Displacement, such as Cyclone Eye does not unperch Ling. Ling's joystick movement is limited in the wall on which he stands.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Finch Poise
skills.description:
Passive: Ling’s Critical Chance is permanently increased by 2.5%-12.5%.
Active: Ling casts his Lightness Skill, leaping onto the designated wall, entering half-stealth state, restoring Lightness Points more quickly and gaining 30% Movement Speed. If Ling receives damage, he will leave the half-stealth state. If he is controlled, he will fall onto the ground and be slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. When using this skill to jump from a wall to another, it will reset the Cooldown and refresh the half-stealth state.
skills.notes: *Ling's basic attack range is greatly increased while on a wall, and the next basic attack allows him to dash to an enemy hero on the ground.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Defiant Sword
skills.description:
Ling charges in a designated direction and stabs the nearby enemies at his destination, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If Ling casts this skill when he is on the wall, he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within a small area and slowing them down by 30% for 1.5 seconds. If this attack critically strikes, the enemies will be slowed by extra 45% for 0.75 seconds.
Defiant Sword is regarded as Basic Attack, can trigger attack effects.
skills.notes: *Ling is briefly untargetable for 0.75 seconds upon landing.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Tempest of Blades
skills.description:
Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds. He can move freely when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing 250-450 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area, knocking those in the center airborne for 1 second, slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5s afterwards and creating a Sword Field for 8 seconds.
Four Tempest of Blades will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4 seconds, reset the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and gain 25 Lightness points.
skills.notes:
*Swords last 8 seconds.
*This skill removes all existing debuffs, crowd controls, and damage over time on Ling,
** Cannot cast when being controlled.
*Ling can hold-spin the ultimate to change the formation in which the swords will land.
**The landing position of swords are visible to Ling before the ability finishes.
**A sword landing on a wall can be picked up if he uses Cloud Walker on the wall.
*Ling can freely use any equipments and abilities while being untargetable.
**Can be repositioned with Flicker.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: The Oriental Fighters
skills.description:
template:FULLPAGENAME will gain [1] movement speed boost [for each allied] Oriental [Fighter] in the battlefield.
(Original text: The Oriental Fighters: A team will gain higher movement speed boost with more Oriental Fighters in the battlefield.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Wrath of the Abyss
skills.description:
When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will enhance Burst Strike and Spectre Step.
After each 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth will release skill, dealing (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the circle and regenerating [50 + pd HP] (Circle Strike doesn't have ATK Effect). Each time he hits an enemy hero, the CD of Burst Strike and Spectre Step will be decreased by 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Circle Strike can critically strike and benefits from Physical Lifesteal.
*It counts as a skill and can benefit from skill effects.
*Circle Strike HP regeneration is halved against minions.
*Circle Strike deals same damage as regular basic attack against turrets.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Burst Strike
skills.description:
Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 200-450 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only pd on minions.)
skill: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals pd, and its slow effect is doubled.
skills.notes:
*Burst Strike - Abyss Enhanced costs 50 Rage.
*Dyrroth regens 10 Rage for each enemy hit of this skill.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Spectre Step
skills.description:
Dyrroth dashes in the designated direction. He will stop when he hits a [non-minion] target, dealing 230-355 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies. When he uses this skill again, he will lock onto a target and release a Fatal Strike, dealing [a total of] 345-570 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemy heroes or creeps hit by Fatal Strike will have their Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 4 seconds.
skill: Fatal Strike will deal pd, slow the target by an extra 90% [for 1 second] and reduce the target's Physical Defense by 60% [instead] for 4 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Spectre Step - Abyss Enhanced costs 50 Rage.
*Bumping into an enemy hero with phase 1 of this skill applies mini knockback effect.
*Phase 2 of this skill deals damage for 3 times, each dealing 115 / 130 / 145 / 160 / 175 / 190 (+40% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
*The skill goes into cooldown on the first cast.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Abysm Strike
skills.description: After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destrucive strike in the target direction (cannot be interrupted), dealing 650-1250 (+250% Extra Physical Attack) (+enemies' 20% Lost HP) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 55% for 0.8 seconds.
skills.notes: *Abysm Strike deals up to 1500 / 2000 / 2500 pd to non-hero units.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: Dyrroth BUFF
skills.description: If Silvanna is in the enemy's team, increases self's attack speed by 1%.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Angry Gloom
skills.description: Lylia gets power from Gloom, ms whenever she is within the area of Gloom. Additionally, every time Gloom is upgraded, her ms, stacking up to 4 times or ms for a maximum of ms.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Magic Shockwave
skills.description:
Lylia sends out Gloom in a line, dealing 250 to 500 6 (+100%Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the path and slow for 1.5 seconds.
If Gloom touches Shadow Energy, he will devour and detonate it.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Shadow Energy
skills.description:
Lylia condenses enhanced at a location, dealing 100 to 160 6 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slow for 0.5 seconds.
If enhanced is detonated by Gloom or Magic Shockwave, it will detonate to deal an additional 250 to 400 6 (+100% Magic Power) Magic Damage and turn the enhanced to Gloom for 8 seconds. During this time, Gloom can then detonate additional enhanced within his range, resetting his timer and moving to the enhanced's location in each instance.
Additionally, whenever Gloom detonates a enhanced within 8 seconds, the detonation damage is increased by 30%, stacking up to 4 times or 120%. If Gloom  detonates enhanced consecutively, this skill can deal a maximum of 250*2.2 to 375*2.2 6 (+220% Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Stores a charge of enhanced every 9 seconds, up to 5 charges. Recharge time is affected by cooldown reduction.
skills.notes:
*This skill is xp from Level 1 and can still be upgraded 6 times, but their stacks will start from 0 stacks instead of full stacks and must requires need more time to granting stack until full.
* enhanced provides vision to its surroundings as well as bushes when placed inside one.
* Lylia can summon up to enhanced at a time. If she summons another one, the first enhanced that she summoned will disappear.
* Lylia can summon as many Glooms as she likes provided that they aren't within another Gloom's range.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Black Shoes
skills.description:
Lylia blink to the Black Shoes' location 4 seconds ago and enhanced, 100%  of her HP and Mana to the previous state, and get an extra Heal. She also gains ms for 2 / 3 / 4 seconds.
Lylia will invulnerable while teleporting.
skills.notes: *Because her ultimate is based on 4 seconds ago, this means she can also lose her HP with her ultimate if her Health bar is damaged while being recorded and immediately healed and then use Black Shoes. This also applies the same to her mana regen.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Baxia Mark
skills.description:
Baxia activates the Baxia Mark permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15 (+1 Hero Level).
At the same time Baxia's will reduce the enemy hero's Shield and HP Regen by 40% for 4 seconds when hit by his skills.
skills.notes: *If the enemies are affected by the Life Drain Unique-Passive items,  can stack multiplicatively with equipment Unique Passive - Life Drain and can apply up to 65% Shield and HP Regen Reduction, not 80% as it does not stack using addition.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Baxia-Shield Unity
skills.description:
Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward [for 9 seconds]. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300-400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8 second and slightly knocking other nearby enemies back.
During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike down this hero, dealing 375-500 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the hit target for 1.5 seconds, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts when the skill ends.
* This skill can only be interrupted by airborne, suppressed, frozen or transformed crowd control effect.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Shield of Spirit
skills.description:
Baxia throws his shield forward that will disappear upon hitting an enemy hero or creeps, dealing 120-220 (+100% Total Magic Power) (+target's 5% Total HP) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, marking them for 5s,  and slowing them down by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep.
Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep us hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.
skills.calc: $\rm{Total\ Cooldown\ Time} = (CD\ Time - CD\ Reduction) - 15%$

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Tortoise's Puissance
skills.description: Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10 seconds while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40-50 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s. For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from Baxia Mark is increased to 200/230/260% (85).
skills.notes: *Cooldown starts when the skill ends.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: The Oriental Fighters
skills.description:
template:FULLPAGENAME will gain [1] movement speed boost [for each allied] Oriental [Fighter] in the battlefield.
(Original text: The Oriental Fighters: A team will gain higher movement speed boost with more Oriental Fighters in the battlefield.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Primal Pact
skills.description:
Bear's Blessing: Masha has 3 HP Bars, each inheriting 50% of her Equipment HP bonuses. When an HP bar is depleted, she removes control effects and blocks damage once. She gains Feral by dealing damage to enemy heroes or creeps. Feral converts into HP after leaving combat.
Power of Wildness: After Masha's skills deal damage to an enemy hero, she leaves Wound in a random direction. Her Basic Attacks can break the Wound and cause her to enter the Feral state.
Feral: Masha gains 15 (+1 × Hero Level)% Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed. Her next 3 Basic Attacks become fan-shaped claw strikes, dealing 3 (+0.3 × Hero Level) (+1% Extra Physical Attack)% of target Max HP extra Physical Damage to enemies in the area (extra damage does not apply to Turrets) and recovering 4 (+0.4 × Hero Level)% HP. It lasts 3 seconds.
Breaking a Wound again during the Feral state will refresh its duration. Up to 6 claw strikes can be stored.
skills.notes: *Abilities on equipment and battle spells that scales with HP only calculates the total HP, current HP or lost HP of Masha's current HP bar.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Feral Swipe
skills.description:
Masha releases energy foward, dealing 250-450 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.
If an enemy hero is hit, they are slowed by 50% for 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Claw Strike
skills.description:
Masha dashes in the target direction, dealing 120-240 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Whenever an HP bar is depleted, the cooldown of Claw Strike resets.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Savage Maul
skills.description: Masha charges toward an enemy hero, dealing 300-600 (+50% Extra HP) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1 second while knocking back nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Tiger Pace
skills.description:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weakness[es] exposed and position revealed for 5 seconds. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67 (+3 × Hero Level) Extra True Damage and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5 seconds.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.
skills.notes:
*Additional damage dealt to enemy heroes only includes damage from skills and Basic Attacks.
*Applies 3 Weaknesses visuals upon hitting an enemy Hero. The angle of Weaknesses' visuals is related to the angle between Wanwan and her opponent; First visual is always behind the target, while the other 2 visuals are positioned 60 degrees towards its left and right.
*Weaknesses exposed to enemies will immediately disappear after Wanwan dies.
*Wanwan gets 30% extra attack speed after getting a kill for an unknown duration.
*The dash after each attack is fully disabled by root and blocked by Khufra's Bouncing Ball, and trigger Phoveus' Demonic Force.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Swallow's Path
skills.description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 60 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by the Swallow Dagger twice are immobilized for 0.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Needles in Flowers
skills.description: Wanwan removes all control effects on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.
skills.notes: *This skill removes all debuffs (excluding suppressed) on Wanwan in general, not specifically limited to crowd controls.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Crossbow of Tang
skills.description:
Wanwan leaps into the air and fires arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5 seconds in rapid succession, dealing 60 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1 second (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan is untargetable and invincible for the duration and can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
Crossbow of Tang can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.
skills.calc: $\mathrm{Attack\ rate} = \frac {160 \times total\ attack\ speed} {99} + 2$
skills.notes:
*Tiger Pace is the one giving extra attack speed. Not her ultimate, Crossbow of Tang, despite being briefly mentioned in this ability. (See the notes of Tiger Pace.)
*Additional damage dealt to creeps includes all types of damage from any source.
*Wanwan can cast her ultimate while jumping (see Patch Notes 1.6.66).
*Wanwan is invincible throughout the duration of Crossbow of Tang.
*This skill removes all existing debuffs on Wanwan, however, it remains unusable while under the control of basic or higher-level crowd control effects.
*She can freely move through joystick, but cannot pass through obstacles in spite of her flying animation.
*This skill's base damage cannot be critical.
*The Attack Speed bonus from Inspire is not limited to 8 Basic Attacks for this skill.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: The Oriental Fighters
skills.description:
template:FULLPAGENAME will gain [1] movement speed boost [for each allied] Oriental [Fighter] in the battlefield.
(Original text: The Oriental Fighters: A team will gain higher movement speed boost with more Oriental Fighters in the battlefield.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Knightess' Resolve
skills.description:
Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5 seconds on hit, each mark reducing their Physical & Magic Defense by 3–6 (up to 5 stacks).
Silvanna deals 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.
skills.notes:
*md to enemy heroes only includes damage from skills and Basic Attacks.
*Visual marks do not display on minions and creeps, despite the fact that they can receive debuffs from this skill.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Cometic Lance
skills.description: Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Spiral Strangling
skills.description:
Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield. Each spin deals 165 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses.
The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions.
Spiral Strangling counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
skills.calc: ${\rm Total\ Spins} = 6 + \lfloor \frac{{\rm Total\ Attack\ Speed} - 1}{0.55} \rfloor$
skills.notes:
*There is a mistake in the skill description, it doesn't spin 1 additional time for every 50% of Extra Attack Speed. Instead, it spin 1 additional time for every 55% of Total Attack Speed above 100% or 1.00. So, theoretically it will spin 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 additional times for a Total Attack Speed of 1.55 / 2.1 / 2.65 / 3.2 / 3.75 / 4.3 / 4.85. Additional spins above 3 are not possible, unless with modifiers that can up the Attack Speed cap like Golden Staff or Inspire. Even so, the max number of spins is 11, not 13. This happens because the increase in the Attack Speed cap effect is very brief.
*Despite the skill counts as a non-Crit Basic Attack, it doesn't benefit from Golden Staff's passive – Endless Strike.
*This skill can be canceled manually by moving the joystick.
*Spiral Strangling is not visible during invisible on the bush.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Imperial Justice
skills.description:
Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5 seconds. (This skill cannot be interrupted)
Silvanna gains 100% [extra] Attack Speed and 40% [extra] Lifesteal when in the Circle.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: Silvanna BUFF
skills.description: If Dyrroth is in the enemy's team, increases self's attack speed by 1%.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Overflowing
skills.description:
Cecilion increases his Max Mana by 10 and restores the same amount of Mana his skill hits an enemy target. Cooldown: 1 second.
Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.
skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ mana} = 10 \times no.\ of\ stacks$
skills.notes: *Cecilion can gain up to 99999 Overflowing stacks, for which he can gain up to 999990 Extra Mana at full stacks.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Bat Impact
skills.description:
Cecilion orders a giant bat to dive in a designated direction, dealing 100-250 (+80% Total Magic Power) (+5% Total Mana) Magic Damage to enemies on the path. The giant bat will stay at its destination and launch another attack, dealing 200-500 (+160% Total Magic Power) (+10% Total Mana) Magic Damage to enemies and triggering Overflowing extra 1 time.
In 6 seconds, every time Cecilion casts this skill, the mana cost will be increased by 1.8 time(s) (capped at 4 times). While casting this skill, he also gains 30% Movement Speed for 1 second.
skills.notes: *This skill can trigger Overflowing for a maximum of 3 times in a single cast.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Sanguine Claws
skills.description: Cecilion summons a pair of claws in a designated location. After a short delay, the claws will move toward each other and cc enemies along the way to the center, dealing 200-300 (+45% Total Magic Power) (+1.2% Total Mana) Magic Damage and cc them for 1 second.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Bats Feast
skills.description:
Cecilion unleashes Blood Demon power [for 6 seconds], increasing his Movement Speed by 60% (decaying rapidly over 1.5 seconds) and gaining slow immunity. Meanwhile, he shoots 40 bolts of blood energy at the enemies nearby, each dealing 35-45 (+8% Total Magic Power) (+0.3% Total Mana) Magic Damage and slowing them by 3% (up to 30%) for 1 second.
Hitting an enemy heal him for 10 and 1% of his health.
skills.notes: *Cooldown starts after casting this skill.

skills.heading: Other
skills.name: Moonlit Waltz
skills.description:
When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can call her into a Vermil Shadow possessed by him [for 5 seconds], providing 220-500 shield (scales with Carmilla's level).
Carmilla can select a target place and land on there, gaining equal shield, dealing 220-500 Magic Damage (scales with her level) within the area of effect, and slowing them down by 30% for 1 second.
skills.calc:
${\rm shield} = 200 + (20 \times Carmilla\text{'}s\ level)$
${\rm magic\ damage} = 200 + (20 \times Carmilla\text{'}s\ level)$
skills.notes:
*Cecilion will be unable to use Moonlit Waltz if an allied Carmilla bought a Broken Heart in the Shop.
*Carmilla's non-Ultimate skills' cooldowns will reset after she casts this skill.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Vampire Pact
skills.description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 7–11 Physical Defense & Magic Defense (scales with level) from them. The stolen Physical and Magic Defense can stack up to 5 times and last 5 seconds. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Only Carmilla's basic attacks and skills can trigger Vampire Pact.
*Enemies can purify themselves to remove the invisible debuff from this skill.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Crimson Flower
skills.description:
Carmilla summons two Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5 seconds dealing 100-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 10% for 0.8 seconds (the slow effect stacks up to 50%). The circling speed of the Crimson Flowers also increases with each hit.[speed unknown]
Carmilla recovers 75-150 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting Minions).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Bloodbath
skills.description:
Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5 seconds.
Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150-300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.6 seconds. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).
skills.calc:
${\mathrm base\ damage} = \bigl[120 + (30 \times skill\ level) \bigr] + \bigl[100\% + (40\% \times skill\ duration) \bigr]$
${\mathrm magic\ bonus} = 120\% + (48\% \times skill\ duration)$
${\mathrm stun\ duration} = 0.32 \times skill\ duration$
${\mathrm where}\ 0 s \leq skill\ duration \leq 2.5 s$
skills.notes:
*Cooldown only starts when the skill was casted or expired.
*Bloodbath Energy can fully charge for 2.5 seconds, and can overcharge it for another 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Curse of Blood
skills.description:
Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8 seconds, enemies still within the area will take 450-750 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and will be immobilized for 1 seconds, slowed by 30% and linked for 5 seconds.
When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.[range unknown]

skills.heading: Other
skills.name: Vermeil Shadow
skills.description:
Cecilion summons Carmilla to become a Vermil [sic] Shadow as she wraps herself around him, granting him a 500 (+20 × Hero Level) shield.
Use Again: Carmilla leaves Cecilion and charges at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 500 (+20 × Hero Level) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The cooldowns of her Crimson Flower and Bloodbath will also reset.
skills.notes:
*This skill can only be used within 5 seconds, and then Carmilla will be immediately detached to Cecilion's body if it expired.
*During the Vermeil Shadow state, her active skills are replaced with "Vermeil Shadow" skill.
*Carmilla will be in untargetable state after becoming a Vermeil Shadow. Cecilion's death or casting this skill will end the state.
*Cecilion will be unable to use Moonlit Waltz if an allied Carmilla bought a Broken Heart in the Shop.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Frigid Breath
skills.description:
Atlas generates Frigid Breath around him for 5 seconds each time he casts a skill. Enemies who stay in the area over 1.5 seconds will have their Movement Speed slow until they are cc for 0.5 seconds.
Atlas gains 16-30 extra Physical Defense and Magic Defense when Frigid Breath is present.
skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ hybrid\ defense} = 15 + (1 \times hero\ level)$

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Annihilate
skills.description:
Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions. Each explosion deals 230-430 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.
Ejected State: If Atlas has ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both himself and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Perfect Match
skills.description:
Atlas enters Ejected State, gaining 30% Movement Speed and slow immunity. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by cc). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320-420 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby and cc them for 1 second.
Ejected State: Atlas and his Mecha share the HP and reduce damage reduction in this state.
skills.notes: *Some items does not work during ejected state. Golden Staff, Twin Blade, Blade of Heptaseas, Bruteforce Breastplate, War Axe (even with Cursed Helmet passive) does not work. Demon Hunter Sword additional damage is applied but Atlas doesn't gain the lifesteal stack. Corrosion Scythe slow is applied but Atlas doesn't gain the attack speed stack.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Fatal Links
skills.description:
Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by cc), dealing 225-475 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.
Use this skill again while channeling: Atlas will cc on the designated location, dealing 360-760 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Use this skill in Ejected State: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% slow effect.
skills.notes:
*Atlas only chains heroes that are in range before he starts channeling. Heroes that walks into range while he is already channeling will not be chained.
*Holding the skill starts the channeling and releasing it triggers the second phase. This means that you cannot cancel this skill and you can't check its range.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: We Are Friends
skills.description: Popol's good care allows Kupa to recover 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds. When Kupa is down, Popol can pray for 3 seconds to bring it back to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30 seconds. After launching 3 consecutive attacks on the enemy, Kupa will enhance Popol's next attack, allowing him to deal (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on hit. Kupa has 2500 (+1200% Total Physical Attack) HP and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and equipment effects (excluding those of active, jungling, and roaming equipment).
skills.notes:
*Despite being considered as a hero alongside Popol, Kupa is a summoned unit accompanied by the hero Popol, due to the fact that he summons it to be resurrected. *If Popol dies, Kupa also die with him. *Kupa possesses attributes held in common by heroes and creeps. Known properties are shown below:
Hero-like properties Creep-like properties
  • Kupa can be targeted by hero skills and battle spells that specifically targets heroes (except "Attach" skills like Heartguard and Grab, Grab, and Contract: Chase Fate as these skills can only target Popol).
  • It cannot be targeted by Hanzo's skill Ninjutsu: Demon Feast.
  • Kupa can increase his damage with Focusing Mark.
    		•
  • Kupa receives full damage from Retribution and damage from jungling footwear Unique Passive Hunter.
  • It does not receive shield from Lolita's Noumenon Energy Core.
  • Valentina does not gain HP regen nor EXP (with her passive Primal Force) when dealing damage to Kupa.
  • Minsitthar cannot pull Kupa with Spear of Glory.
    		•

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
skills.description: Popol throws a spear at the target for 80-170 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and orders Kupa to bite them, dealing 100-190 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and following up with attacks for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa strikes ferociously, cc the target for 1 second with 3 rapid bites.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: I Need You, Kupa!
skills.description: Popol prays for Kupa's return on the battlefield. Kupa will return if this skill is not interrupted in 3 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Kupa, Help!
skills.description: Popol summons Kupa to protect him, gaining a 240-330 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield while dealing 240-330 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for [template:fd 0.5] seconds. Kupa will assist Popol in battle for 3 seconds. Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa darts back to protect its master and knocks nearby enemies cc for [template:fd 0.2] seconds. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: I Need You, Kupa!
skills.description: Popol prays for Kupa's return on the battlefield. Kupa will return if this skill is not interrupted in 3 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Popol's Surprise
skills.description: Popol sets a trap which will detonate after a short delay to the enemy that steps on it, dealing 70-100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, cc it for 1 second, and creating a frost zone for 4 seconds, slow of enemies within the zone by 20%. Popol can store up to 3 traps at a time and gains 1 charge per 22-16 seconds. Up to 3 traps can be set, each lasting 60 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: We Are Angry!
skills.description:
Popol and Kupa enter the state for 12 seconds:
Popol and Kupa both gain 15% extra Movement Speed and increase their Attack Speed to 1.3 times. Kupa turns into the Alpha Wolf Form, gains 1500-3500 HP, and enhances its other skills. Also fully restores its HP.
skills.notes: *The attack speed increase is multiplied to the total attack speed, instead of adding it as extra attack speed.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Cursing Touch
skills.description: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes every time he deals Physical damage to them. Sha Residue erupts upon reaching 5 stacks a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4 seconds to deal Physical Damage equal to 20 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) (+target's 2.5% Lost HP) to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When Sha Residue erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed by 3 seconds.
skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ movement\ SPD} = (-0.15 \times time) + 30%$
skills.notes:
*Upon eruption of Sha Residue, it will slowly fly towards Yu Zhong and only after he makes contact with it will he gain its buffs.
*The damage of each stack is updated on Yu Zhong's current health and max health, not all upon cast.
*Every time Sha Essence is fully charged, Yu Zhong will receive the bonus Movement Speed even if he still has that bonus while it is decaying, resetting its duration.
*Golden Staff's unique passive Endless Strike can now affect applied Sha Residue stacks on basic attack.
*Even upon Yu Zhong's death, the remaining Sha Residue will continue to deal damage to the opponent(s).
*Does not count on damage from battle spells, such as Petrify or secondary effects such as Lethal Ignition emblem.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Dragon Tail
skills.description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220-400 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.
skills.notes:
*In Dragonoid Form, the area-of-effect of this skill is wider than default form.
*The animation is hidden if Yu Zhong is not sighted by enemy.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Soul Grip
skills.description:
Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150-300 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1 second.
Upon target hit, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced [for 5 seconds], dealing 108-216 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage [and (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage behind the target]. (Upon multiple target hit, Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue multiple times with the enhanced Basic Attack, dealing up to 200% damage.)
skills.notes:
*The enhanced basic attack range is increased to 4.2 (2⅓ times increase.)
*In Dragonoid Form, the skill will be instead unleashed within a cone instead of a straight trajectory.
**Unlike in human form where the Dragon Soul has to travel towards its target location. The skill instantly damages every enemy in a fan shape while in Dragonoid Form.
*Upon successfully performing the enhanced Basic Attack, enemy heroes behind the main target cannot be marked with Sha Residue nor the attack benefits from Lifesteal.
*The enhanced Basic Attack can lock onto invisible and concealed enemy, as long as they are within range.

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Furious Dive
skills.description:
Yu Zhong leaps towards the designated area with his full strength, dealing 180-270 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He is able to dash one more time in the movement direction.
After a short delay, enemies within the area of effect will be knocked airborne for 0.8 seconds and take 180-270 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) additional Physical Damage.
skills.notes:
*In Dragonoid Form, the area-of-effect of this skill is wider than default form.
*The additional dash's speed scales with Attack Speed.
*The additional dash has an unknown duration. It can be delayed by simply doing anything besides moving the movement stick.
skills.quote: I once passed on this technique to a girl.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Black Dragon Form
skills.description:
After channeling for 0.6 seconds, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7 seconds, he cannot use any skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in this path while dealing gains 180-310 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He also gains 1000-2000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Max HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form.
Upon exiting the Black Dragon form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Knockback effect only takes effect once on the same target.
*When suppressed while in Black Dragon Form, the crowd control effect still applies but Yu Zhong will neither be reverted into his human form nor to his Dragonoid Form.
*Upon exiting his Black Dragon Form and transforming into his Dragonoid Form, Yu Zhong will be untargetable at that moment right until his Dragonoid form transformation is complete.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Duality
skills.description:
Luo Yi's skills create mark on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6 seconds.
Sigils opposite attributes will trigger Yin-Yang Reaction when they are within a certain distance,[how much?] dealing 365 (+20 × Hero Level) (+190% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the marked [enemy heroes], stunning them for 1 second, and pulling them toward each other .
Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy [hero], she gains 300 (+10 × Hero Level) (+150% Total Magic Power) shield (up to 3 stacks) and 30% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Dispersion
skills.description:
Luo Yi casts the energy of Yin/Yang in the target direction, dealing 210-410 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and those behind in a cone. Enemy heroes hit are marked with mark.
Luo Yi stores up to 4 Dispersion charges and gains 1 charge every 8 seconds. She also gains 1 charge each time Yin-Yang Reaction is triggered.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.
skills.notes: *The state of this skill starts as yang by default, this skill shifts as yang when Luo Yi dies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Rotation
skills.description:
Luo Yi summons Fire of Yang/Aqua of Yin at a target location, dealing 250-350 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds.
Fire of Yang/Aqua of Yin then remains at the location for 6 seconds, dealing 50-70 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.7 seconds. It can also trigger Yin-Yang Reaction with mark of opposite attributes.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.
skills.notes:
*The state of this skill starts as yang by default, this skill shifts as yang when Luo Yi dies.
*The remaining duration indicator is visible to both enemies and allies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Diversion
skills.description:
Active: Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks target location (within 20 units) as its destination. After 3 seconds delay, allied heroes (including herself) within the Circle will be teleported to the location.
Passive: Luo Yi’s Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6%–10%.
skills.notes:
*When its center is cast into a bush, the Teleport Circle on the battlefield and minimap is concealed from enemies. The circle also provides vision around the area.
*Allies' channeling abilities are not interrupted. Allies affected by untargetability, such as under Winter Crown are also teleported.
*Allies teleported to an unsighted bush is instantly not exposed to nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Elapsed Daytime
skills.description:
When holding down the Basic Attack button, Benedetta enters the state and charges up Sword Intent. If the Basic Attack button released after the Sword Intent is fully charged, Benedetta will use Swordout Slash in the direction she's facing and dash forward, dealing (+215% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on the path (counts as Skill Damage and is reduced to 50% on Minions and Creeps)
Benedetta can only use Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is fully charged and she is in Swordout state by holding down the Basic Attack button.
Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.
skills.notes:
*Has the distance of 3.8 unit.
*Despite the description, Elapse Daytime's damage is in fact, basic attack damage, and triggers attack effects but cannot critically strike.
*All enemies hit along the dash will be affected by attack effects such as Thunder Belt or Blade of the Heptaseas, and the damage can trigger or be blocked by Tigreal's Fearless.
*Holding down and canceling the Swordout State is considered a skill cast.
*While Benedetta is in the Swordout State, she approximately gains 66.667 points of Sword Intent per second, and becomes full at 100 on 1.5 seconds of activation. She can overcharge the skill for another 3 seconds.
*Each time Benedetta deals damage with skills or basic attacks, she receives 33 points of Sword Intent.
*Benedetta will gradually lose 10 Sword Intent every second if she is unable to replenish it within 4 seconds.
*The sound and animation of charging and maxing out Sword Intent is audible and visible to everyone.
**The current amount of Sword Intent, is only visible to Benedetta, excluding even audience.
**The landing point, which is briefly indicated at maxing out Sword Intent is also only revealed to Benedetta.
**The damage area is a little further than the landing point, and can be extended by using Flicker amid.
*Damage effect from emblem and items, such as Lethal Ignition, does not charge Sword Intent.
*When being rooted in Minsitthar's King's Calling, Sword Intent can neither be charged nor release when full.
**If Sword Intent is currently overcharged, it is instantly set to 100 and begins depleting.
*Death resets Sword Intent.
*Due to this passive, Benedetta cannot use Manual Targeting Mode.
*Since holding basic attack button uses a different cast time, you can tap other buttons (excluding her abilities), use emotes or buy items during the delay of other skills while holding the basic attack button.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Phantom Slash
skills.description:
Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 200-360 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5 seconds.
Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 75-175 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to pd.)
skills.notes:
*Benedetta dashes backward 1.9 unit then forward 3.8 unit with this ability.
**This means it triggers Phoveus's Demonic Force twice.
*The second slash can be interrupted by CC effects, by hitting an obstacle, or miss the target area if Benedetta is displaced, uses Flicker or is moved by Cylone Eye.
