**If the backward dash is obstructed by an obstacle, the front slash will be further.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: An Eye for An Eye
skills.description:
Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8 seconds. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing 300-450 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full Sword Intent. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*The stunning effect applies to all target hit in the area of effect.
*Slowing, rooted, disarmed, and pulling effects alone does not trigger this skill's stunning effect despite the fact that these aforementioned effects are considered a control effect by definition.
*This ability does not remove any ongoing control effects, nor evade Suppression, nor continuous CC effect such as Melissa's Go Away!, but the damage and stun effect is still applied to the dash.
*The dash is executed after the CC immune, so it cannot be used to escape certain abilities like Silvanna's Imperial Justice or Cici's Curtain Call.
*Sword Intent is full only if the damage taken is higher than 0. Which means some effects might prevent An Eye for An Eye from gaining Sword Intent.
**eg. When enemy Martis deals physical damage while An Eye for An Eye and Wind of Nature are simultaneously activated, the latter will prevent gaining Sword Intent.
*Since Marcel's Golden Hour is not a cc effect, it cannot be parried.
*Sometimes the voice line when Benedetta fends off damage is falsely played even when she fails to block damage.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Alecto: Final Blow
skills.description: Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay,[duration needed] detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5 seconds, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of 1560-2080 (+1105% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and slows them by 50%.
skills.notes:
*The range is approximately 7.5 unit.
*Benedetta is untargetable for 0.33 seconds.
*The skill deals 120 / 140 / 160 (+85% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each 0.2 second interval to all enemies along the path, and can deal up to 13 times.
**The first damage instance begins after she arrives at the other end.
*Sword Intent is fully charged right after successful casting.
*Does not go on cooldown if interrupted during the cast delay.
*Flicker and any other ability order is queued after finishing dash.
*Petrify will be applied to all enemies along the dash with proper timing.
*Benedetta can freely use equipments and battle spells when being untargetable, however the effect is only applied after arriving at the other end of the path.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Sand Walk
skills.description: Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. After Desert Power is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (cannot critically strike), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*This effect can trigger item effects such as Blade of the Heptaseas' passive - "Ambush".
*Increase Khaleed's attack range to 5.
*Khaleed maxes out full 100 Desert Power at (approximately) an accumulated moving distance of 20 unit.
**It is advised to move circularly to increase the accumulation speed.
**He begins to lose Desert Power after 3 seconds of not maintaining, and depletion since full takes approxinately 6.5 seconds or 15 Desert Power per second.
*Khaleed does not gain Desert Power when he blinks or teleports away. Aside from joystick movement or movement from his abilities, he also gains Desert Power when knockbacked a significant distance or affected by Cyclone Eye.
*Death removes all Desert Power.
*The range of Desert Power can be increased with the Malefic Gun passive Malefic Energy.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Desert Tornado
skills.description:
Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 200-525 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row.
This skill deals 50%-75% damage to Minions and Creeps.
skills.notes:
*Each phase of this ability is only initiated when there is a movement order from joystick.
*Khaleed can use basic attack while standing in place, or use other abilities without canceling this ability.
*Trigger item effects, such as Thunder Belt.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Quicksand Guard
skills.description:
Khaleed protects himself with the power of the quicksand, restoring 60-135 plus 5%-10% of his lost HP and 10 Desert Power every 0.5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 35%-50% for up to 4 seconds.
While channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%. This skill is a Focused Cast.
Any other controls will interrupt this skill.
skills.notes:
*Battle spells and Recall can be used without cancelling the ability.
*The remaining duration is visible to everyone having sight over him.
*The effect is hidden if Khaleed is not sighted.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Raging Sandstorm
skills.description:
Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100-250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process.
Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450-750 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1 second, and fully charge his Desert Power.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Big Guy
skills.description: Detona gains a stack of stack for 12 seconds each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Big Guy increases Detona's size, and grants 4–10 extra Hybrid Defense (scales with the level of Detona's Welcome) and 5% extra Resilience. At max stacks, Detona's Basic Attacks will be replaced with basic attack, which deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+3.5% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2 seconds, and refreshes the duration of Big Guy with each hit.
skills.notes:
*The stacks of Big Guy reduce gradually after the 12-second duration, with the Defense provided by each stack decreased for approximately 0.8 seconds. (Patch Notes 1.5.38)
*Big Guy stacks increase Detona's hitbox for an unknown radius.
*On previous iteration of Big Guy, Detona's 3D model grows but it now also includes Barats' as of Patch Notes/1.8.47.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: So-Called Teamwork
skills.description:
Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60-160 (+7% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120-320 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area.
The area of effect of So-Called Teamwork increases with the number of Big Guy stacks.[how much?]

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Missile "Expert"
skills.description:
Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100-175 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 40% for 1 second. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon
landing, dealing 100-175 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Detona's Welcome
skills.description:
After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120-200 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+1.2% Total HP) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2 seconds before spitting them out. If the target hits an enemy hero or a wall after being spit out, the target will cause an explosion, they and nearby enemies will take an additional 180-300 (+105% Total Physical Attack) (+1.8% Total HP) Physical Damage and be stunned for 1 second.
For the duration, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the channeling is canceled, 60% of the skill cooldown will be refunded.
Passive: Detona gains 4–10 stacks of stack upon respawn.
skills.notes: *The charge distance scales with the channel time; Detona can fully charge this skill for 1 second, and can overcharge for approximately another 2⅓ seconds.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Abyss Corrosion
skills.description:
With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attacks (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed. Each Basic Attack deals (+45 × Hero Level) (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2 seconds), and inflicts 1 stack of Mark on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks. [Marks applied last for 8 seconds.]
Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's pd and his Movement Speed by 5%.
skills.notes:
*Brody's basic attack interval is 50% of his total attack speed.
*Abyss Mark cannot be applied to creeps.
*This passive can be interrupted by Crowd control effects, or can be canceled by Brody's skills during the wind-up.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Abyss Impact
skills.description:
Brody launches a shock wave in the designated direction, dealing 150-550 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing the enemies by 30% for 1.2 seconds, and applying 1 stack of mark.
As the shock wave travels, for each enemy it hits, it deals an extra physical damage, inflicts extra 5% slow effect, and applies an additional stack of Abyss Mark, capped at 130% physical damage, 45% slow effect, and 4 stacks. This skill deals only physical damage to minions.
skills.notes: *Damage from this skill does not benefit from the damage increase of the Abyss Mark.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Corrosive Strike
skills.description:
Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing 200-350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, stunning the target for 0.8 seconds, and inflicting 1 stack of mark on the target.
Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Torn-Apart Memory
skills.description: Brody locks on all the targets within 8 yard(s), dealing 340-580 (+180% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them. If the target has an mark, all Abyss Marks will be reset, dealing 136-232 (+72% Extra Physical Attack) (+target's 4%-6% Lost HP) Physical Damage for each stack the target has.
skills.notes:
*"Damage per Stack" from this skill does not benefit from the damage increase of the Abyss Mark.
*Torn-Apart Memory cannot be interrupted, not even death.
skills.quote: Memories are nowhere to be placed. Everything is for me to protect.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Galactic Power
skills.description: Yve gains a stack of Galactic Power each time she hits an enemy hero with Void Blast or Void Crystal (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Galactic Power allows Yve to launch an extra attack on the next Real World Manipulation cast and increases the amount of shield gained by 5%.
skills.notes: Outdated

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Void Blast
skills.description:
Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 350-600 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area
Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decays over 1 second.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Void Crystal
skills.description:
Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220-420 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.
Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7 seconds, dealing 105-180 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45 seconds to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 6% for each hit after the first (up to 60%).
skills.notes:
*The window time for the second cast lasts up to 5 seconds.
*Void Crystal lasts 3 seconds after the direction is set.
*The length is 5.5 unit.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Real World Manipulation
skills.description:
Yve creates a Starfield that lasts [for] 15 seconds, gaining Displacement Immunity and a 400-800 (+120% Total Magic Power) shield. Within the duration, you can Tap or Slide the screen to launch up to 15 attacks.
Tap: Deals 340-540 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area.
Slide: Deals 65-125 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45 seconds to enemies in the target area for 2.7 seconds and slows them by 50%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield are immobilized for 0.8 seconds (only once against the same target). The Starfield will remain if Yve is controlled, expect for suppression.
skills.notes:
*The board has the size of 8x8 unit.
*Yve does not lose the ability when being crowd controlled. However the tap/slide order is not enacted in the mean time.
*Entering or leaving Yin's My Turn immediately cancel this ability.
*The shield lingers shortly after the ability ends.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Ancestral Guidance
skills.description: Mathilda gains stack while moving. When it is fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and granting her 80 Movement Speed that will decays over 2.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Soul Bloom
skills.description:
Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4 seconds, attracting wisps that as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps).
At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda cast this skill again, the wisps will seek the attack nearby enemies, each dealing 275-500 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and revealing the enemies' positions briefly.[duration needed] Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.
skills.notes:
*Has a radius of 5.3 unit.
*Fully affect concealed, invisible and unsighted targetable enemies in range.
**If the number of enemies in range is less than or equal to the number of attracted wisps, each enemy will be hit once, prioritize unsighted enemy heroes.
*If there are multiple enemies nearby, the wisps have a 20% chance of hitting the same target multiple times and guarantee to hit a new enemy hero target at least once each.[verification needed]

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Guiding Wind
skills.description:
Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 500-1000 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield and a 25% extra Movement Speed for 3 seconds. Allied heroes who come in contact with the field will receive 60% shield and Guiding Wind. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost.
When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda will not change her position.
Guiding Wind expires 2 seconds after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.
skills.notes:
*Allies' movement speed boost lasts 2 seconds. (Balance Adjustment Patch Notes 1.8.20)
*The ability lasts 5 seconds.
*The option to be guided is disabled if the ally is rooted.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Circling Eagle
skills.description:
Mathilda applies a mark to the target enemy hero and circles around the them for up to 3.5 seconds, during which her wisps will fly toward nearby enemy heroes, each  dealing 40 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Soul Bloom will prioritize the target with Soul Mark.
Within the duration, Mathilda can select an area to dash to. At the end of the duration, she'll dash at the target with mark, dealing 320-400 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while knocking enemies in her path airborne for 0.6 seconds and transferring the Soul Mark to the first enemy hero that she knocks airborne.
Mathilda gains control immunity and 400-600 (+160% Total Magic Power) shield for the skill duration.
skills.notes:
*Mathilda reveals the target and maintains a distance of 3.5 around her target. This state lasts up 4 seconds.
*Mathilda will immediately stops circling and dashes towards the location of the target if the target is too far away or it dies.
*In Yin's My Turn, she will circle around the center point instead but the damage and effect is still applied to Yin.
*Mathilda is not CC immune during the dash animation.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Champ Stance
skills.description:
After every 3 skill casts, Paquito enters Champ Stance, gaining an enhanced skill ignoring his current cooldowns. He gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds after casting the enhanced skill.
Paquito's Basic Attacks only deal (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ movement\ SPD} = (-0.24 \times time) + 60%$
skills.notes: *The current stack is visible to enemies, resets on death and his fist glows at max stack.
skills.quote: I had no one to depend on except myself.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Heavy Left Punch
skills.description:
Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210-360 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. He gains 150-500 (+110% Total Physical Attack) shield for 2.5 seconds if an enenmy hero is hit.
Champ Stance: The damage is increased to 350-600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, while the shield value is increased to shield. The regular and enhanced shields can stack.
skills.notes: * Champ Stance has slightly more range than what the skill range shows.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Jab
skills.description:
Paquito dashes in the target direction and throws a jab, dealing 150-450 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Paquito deals no damage to enemies in his path but will stop and throw the jab early upon colliding within an enemy hero or creep.
Champ Stance:The damage is increased to 240-720 (+240% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes:
* Upon stopping on a hero/creep or reaching its final dash distance, does damage on a rectangular shape starting from behind Paquito to a small square shape in front of him.
* It has a sizable hit box than Paquito's main body, meaning Paquito will immediately stop on a hero/creep even they are slightly right behind him or at his sides. Its size is about half of Paquito's Basic Attack range.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Knockout Strike
skills.description:
Paquito launches an elbow strike in the target direction, dealing 250-350 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocking them back. He then throws a haymaker, dealing 350-600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 1 second, as he darts backward.
Champ Stance: Instead of a haymaker, Paquito launches an uppercut after the elbow strike, 400-750 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.5 seconds.
skills.notes:
* Upon reaching the final dash distance, does damage and slowing/airborne on a rectangular shape starting from Paquito's back and a small square shape in front of him.
* While dashing, the skill has a hit box that is the size of Paquito's main body, meaning the actual cc size is smaller than when aiming the skill shows.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Stick, Stick
skills.description:
Enemies gain a stack of Sticky each time they're hit by Gloo's skills, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 5.
Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Slam, Slam
skills.description:
Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy.
At the final, a Goo is left behind that explodes after 3 seconds to deal 300-450 (+12% Extra HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1 second. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will explode immediately, reset the skill's cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5%-5% of Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if hits an enemy hero).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Spread, Spread
skills.description: Gloo splits into Goos, dealing 100-200 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5 seconds. While split, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies it touches, lasting 4 seconds. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge over to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a distance.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Grab, Grab
skills.description: Unlocked when any enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target enemy hero for up to 9 seconds, recovering 25%-30% of its Max HP. For the duration, its Basic Attacks are converted to deal 30-90 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+6% Extra HP) Magic Damage, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding damage from turrets) to its host. If the target dies while attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Gloo lingers on the host even when the host becomes untargetable.
*Gloo can freely use any battle spells and equipments while Mobility ones are disabled.
**Flicker, Arrival, Recall are disabled.
**Wind of Nature is not disabled but Winter Crown is disabled.
*When Nana's Molina's Gift is triggered, Gloo will be detached. However, its cooldown will not be reduced. However, when Aurora's Pride of Ice is triggered, Gloo will remain attached and will not exit his Ultimate form.
*When an attached enemy hero has Immortality active, Gloo will exit his ultimate and his cooldown be reduced.
skills.quote: One is all. (All is one.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mechanical Genius
skills.description:
Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower.
Renner Basic Attack - Longshot: Fire a powerful shot in the enemy's current direction, dealing (+360%-535% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first target hit (this shot can be dodged, or blocked by others. Deals pd to creeps).
Beatrix cannot crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack
skills.calc: ${\rm Basic\ attack\ damage} = 347.5% + (12.5% \times hero\ level)$
skills.notes: *She can only automatically fire an Outer Turret Shield whilst stationary.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mechanical Genius
skills.description:
Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower.
Bennett Basic Attack - Area Bombing: Choose a location to bombard, dealing (+180%-320% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in that area and slowing them by 30% for 0.5 second (Deals pd to creeps).
Beatrix cannot crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack
skills.calc: ${\rm Basic\ attack\ damage} = 170% + (10% \times hero\ level)$
skills.notes: *Area Bombing only benefits 50% of Physical Lifesteal.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mechanical Genius
skills.description:
Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower.
Wesker Basic Attack - Proximity Advantage: Fire 5 shots at the target, each one dealing (+125%-195% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (pd dealt to targets hit multiple times decays to pd. Deals pd to creeps).
Beatrix cannot crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack
skills.calc: ${\rm Basic\ attack\ damage} = 120% + (5% \times hero\ level)$
skills.notes:
*Proximity Advantage only benefits 50% of Physical Lifesteal.
*The decay ratio for the second shot is reduced to 70% Physical Damage. Decay ratio of the third and subsequent attacks remain unchanged as pd.
*Basic Attack Effects will be triggered up to 5 times per Proximity Advantage.
**Physical Damage from Demon Hunter Sword's Unique Passive Devour is reduced to 2% of the target's current HP per shot.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mechanical Genius
skills.description:
Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower.
Nibiru Basic Attack - Rapid Fire: Let loose a volley of 4 shots, each one dealing (+50%-67.5% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (Deals pd to creeps).
Beatrix cannot crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack.
skills.calc: ${\rm Basic\ attack\ damage} = 48.75% + (1.25% \times hero\ level)$
skills.notes:
*Basic Attack Effects will be triggered up to 4 times per Rapid Fire.
**Physical Damage from Demon Hunter Sword's Unique Passive Devour is reduced to 2% of the target's current HP per shot.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Masterful Gunner
skills.description:
Passive: Beatrix can carry 2 weapons at once, and increase her Physical Attack by 5–30.
enhanced Beatrix takes 0.6 second to swap her primary weapon with the secondary weapon she has slung over her back, gaining an all-new way to attack and Ultimate.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Tactical Reposition
skills.description: Beatrix: drops and rolls forward (Renner); leaps and nimbly forward (Bennett); rolls ahead sideways (Wesker); slides forward (Nibiru) and fully reloads her current weapon.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Renner's Apathy
skills.description:
Beatrix wields Renner calmly upon the battlefield, aiming at the enemy. When releasing the skill, she deals 700-1200 (+280% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit.
This skill gets 50% Physical Lifesteal, but is not affected by Spell Vamp.
Beatrix can aim up to 20 seconds.
skills.notes:
*This shot can be dodged or blocked by other heroes and creeps.
*The bullet penetrates through minions and deals the same Physical Damage.
*Renner's Apathy initially starts with the aim wobbling left to right until it settles down to the center.
*A laser sight attached turns on when activating this skill.
*It can be manually cancelled and the skill will not go on cooldown

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Bennett's Rage
skills.description:
Beatrix focuses her rage, and has Bennett rain down a bombardment in a set area 5 time(s). Each bombardment slows the target by 30% and deals 580-980 (+225% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (this damage decaying to 20% when hitting the same target multiple times, lasting 1 seconds.
This skill gets 25% Physical Lifesteal, but is not affected by Spell Vamp.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Wesker's Elation
skills.description:
Beatrix raises Wesker and fires off [ultra-bullets] that deal 295-445 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time they hit an enemy (the pd of successive hits on the same enemy decays by pd but falls no lower than pd).
This skill gets 50% Physical Lifesteal, but is not affected by Spell Vamp.
skills.notes: *The shots can be dodged, or blocked by others.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Nibiru's Passion
skills.description:
Beatrix squeezes the trigger to greet oncoming enemies with a 6-shot volley from Nibiru, inflicting 200-320 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to each hit.
This skill gets 25% Physical Lifesteal, but is not affected by Spell Vamp.
skills.notes: *This ability is a focused cast. If Beatrix is affected crowd control, or displaced by any means, or use Flicker, the ability is canceled.

skills.heading: Other
skills.name: Need Backup
skills.description:
Having escaped battle for 3 seconds, Beatrix can call for her butler Morgan to provide her with a backup weapons crate.
Beatrix must then choose two weapon from the crate to serve as her primary and secondary.
Her weapon selection is interrupted if she commits any action or is cc during this period.
skills.notes: *Selecting only one weapon before the skill is cancelled will switch her primary weapon but will keep the same secondary weapon she previously has.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Demonic Force
skills.description:
Phoveus' next Basic Attack allows him to charge at the enemy, knocking them back, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 4% of the enemy's Max HP, and gaining a Shield equal to 8% of his Max Hp. This effect has a 26-14 seconds cooldown (based on Infernal Pursuit level).
Astaros' Gaze: Whenever an enemy hero blink, dashes, or is displaced within 8 units of Phoveus, the cooldown of Demonic Force will be reduced by 20% and the cooldown of his other skills will be reduced by 0.5 second.
skills.notes:
*The enhanced basic attack has the range of 4 unit, with the indicator visible to everyone.
*The passive triggers even when the enemies farther than 8 unit dash into any point within 8 unit.
*The enhanced basic attack of Demonic Force can be increased by Malefic Gun and its passive Malefic Energy.
*Cyclone Eye effect on enemies triggers Demonic Force.
*Teleportation also triggers the passive, such as Luo Yi's Diversion, Moskov's Spear of Destruction or a unit enters Chip's Shortcut.
**However, the returning of Shortcut and Arrival do not.
*Death resets cooldown of Demonic Force.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Demonic Impact
skills.description:
Phoveus slams his monolith into the ground, dealing 200-500 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 70% for 0.5 second. If this skills hits an enemy, Phoveus' next Demonic Impact will leave behind an Astaros Eye.
Astaros Eye: Implodes after a short delay, dealing 100-250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Magic Damage to the enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Dark Wave
skills.description: Phoveus drops the stone and releases his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies airborne, dragging them along, and dealing 250-500 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Magic Damage.
skills.notes: *The ability can be repositioned with Flicker during the cast delay.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Infernal Pursuit
skills.description:
Passive: Demonic Force, Astaros Eye, and Dark Wave can apply Sinner's Mark to the enemy hero hit.
Active: Phoveus leaps into the air and smashes down with his monolith at the enemy hero with Sinner's Mark, dealing 250-500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) plus extra Physical Damage equal to 5% of the target's Max HP to enemies in the area while Phoveus recovers 50 plus 6% of his Lost HP.
The HP recovered is reduced by 80% when hitting multiple enemies.
skills.notes:
* This blink duration has control immunity.
* Upon casting the skill, Phoveus will be momentarily untargetable while traveling into the target.
** The duration scales on how far the target is from Phoveus.
** The untargetable effect ends the moment Phoveus is just above the target.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Theory of Everything
skills.description:
Natan gains a stack of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with a skill (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 2.5 seconds and grants 7.5% extra Attack Speed and 5% Movement Speed.
Natan's Basic Attacks projectiles will return to Natan after reaching the maximum range, dealing an extra 30 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way (inherits 60% of Natan's attack effects). Hitting an enemy refreshes Entanglement's duration.
skills.calc: ${\rm extra\ ATK\ SPD} = \bigl[(0.0053571 \times hero\ lv.) + 0.069643 \bigr] \times no.\ of \ Entanglement\ stacks$
skills.notes:
*Natan's basic attacks only benefit 80% of Natan's Physical and Magic Lifesteal.
*Damage is decreased by pd for Demon Hunter Sword-Unique Passive Devour when equipped.
skills.quote: Time is nothing more than a descriptor of space…

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Superposition
skills.description: Natan shoots a dense mass of energy, dealing 225-400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along its path.
skills.notes:
*
*Superposition only benefits 50% of Natan's Physical and Magic Lifesteal.
skills.quote: There is no "collapse".

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Interference!
skills.description:
Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor which carries enemies on contact along the path and deals 150-300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them.
The attractor explodes upon reaching the end, knocking back nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.1 second, and dealing 30-55 (+10% Total Physical Attack) (+12% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them.
skills.notes: *Interference! only benefits 50% of Natan's Physical and Magic Lifesteal.
skills.quote: There is only "decoherence".

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Entropy?
skills.description:
Natan summons a Reverse-Clone at a target location 6 units away that lasts 10s, inherits 35% / 37.5% / 40% of his attack attributes (and 35% of Natan's attack effects), and will copy his moves and attacks in reverse.
Use Again: Natan switches places with the Reverse-Clone. [Cooldown: 12 seconds.]
Each cast reduces other skills' remaining cooldown by 50%. The Reverse-Clone will disappear if Natan is too far away.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts after ending the ultimate.
*The reverse-clone starts at 6 unit away from Natan, face the same facing angle. The link turns red at 10 unit and breaks at 13 unit.
*Entropy? foreswing time has been reduced by 50%.
*Sub-ability of Entropy? is not affected by cooldown reduction.
skills.quote: Entropy can decrease.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Fighting Spirit
skills.description:
After dealing damage, Aulus adds a stack of Fighting Spirit to his axe per second for 4 seconds (up to 6 stacks). Each stack grants 7.5 (+0.5 × Hero Level)% Attack Speed. At max Fighting Spirit stacks, Aulus' Basic Attack is enhanced and gains Attack Range.
Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing (+75% Total Physical Attack)+(4 (+0.4 × Hero Level)% target's Max HP Physical Damage) to enemies in a line.
skills.notes: This effect shares the same amount of stacks and duration time with War Axe and Brute Force Breastplate

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Aulus, Charge!
skills.description:
Aulus starts accumulating Fighting Spirit, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5 seconds.
If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2 seconds, he will enter the Enraged state and gain Control Immunity
skills.notes: This skill is able to accumulate War Axe's "Fighting Spirit" if equipped.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: The Power of Axe
skills.description:
Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240-440 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.
Upon hitting an enemy, Aulus can cast this skill again to dash forward and smash the ground, dealing 240-440 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Cleaving Axe
skills.description:
Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 150-270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 450-810 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies a large area.
During this skill, Aulus gains 20-40% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.
skills.notes: Only the last strike has Control Immunity.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Invisible Armor
skills.description:
Aamon enters the Camouflage state each time he hits an enemy with a skill, during which he untargetable, restores 25 (+15% Total Magic Power) (+Aamon's 3% Lost HP) HP every 0.6 seconds, and gains 60% extra Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3.5 seconds.
Upon leaving the Camouflage state, Aamon immediately resets his Basic Attack's cooldown and Enhanced Basic Attack (Aamon) within the next 2.5 seconds. Each enhanced Basic Attack deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and reduces Aamon's skill cooldowns by 0.5 second. The first enhanced Basic Attack's damage is increased to md if Aamon leaves the Camouflage state actively.
skills.notes:
*While in Camouflage State his enhanced Basic Attack will be guided: blinking towards the target then initiating a Basic Attack.
*The enhanced basic attack has the range of 3
skills.quote: For generations, the Invisible Armor has been used as the symbol of the greatest power in House Paxley.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Soul Shards
skills.description:
Passive: Aamon charges his armor each time he casts a skill or hits an enemy with a skill or enhanced Basic Attack (Aamon). At 5 charges, Aamon throws [6] shards at the target on his next attack, each shard dealing 40-100 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The shards will then scatter around the target.
Active: Aamon throws a shard at a nearby enemy, dealing 150-300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
skills.notes:
*The shards dropped on the ground is visible to everyone.
*If the target of this ability dies or untargetable when the shard reaches, no effect takes place.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Slayer Shards
skills.description:
Aamon throws a shard forward, dealing 120-220 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first non-minion enemy hit and slowing them by 50% for 2 seconds. The shard will then return to Aamon immediately.
If the shard fails to hit an enemy, it will return to Aamon after a short delay and allow him to enter the Camouflage state.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Endless Shards
skills.description:
Aamon throws all shards at a designated enemy and slows them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. After a short delay, the shards will fly to the enemy's location again, each dealing 90-110 (+24% Total Magic Power)–150-180 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
The number of shards increases with Aamon's armor charges and the shards on the ground (8-25). The damage dealt increases with the target's lost HP, to the maximum when the target's HP is below 30%. The same target takes [50%] less damage from subsequent attacks.
skills.notes:
*The number of shards are updated next to the ability retroactively.
*The shards first travel to the target, then expands outwardly before converging, deals damage when expanding and converging to all enemies around, and follow the target as it moves.
*The target may avoid the damage by using Flicker or any mobility skill at the time of convergence.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Primal Force
skills.description:
Valentina gains 8–50 extra EXP each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2 seconds.
If the enemy hero's level isn't higher than Valentina's, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP. The EXP scales with Valentina's level.
skills.calc:
${\rm EXP\ received} = 12.5 + (2.5 \times hero\ level)$
${\rm HP\ regen} = damage\ dealt \times \bigl[30% + (2% \times hero\ level) \bigr]$
skills.notes:
*The Magic Damage dealt by Valentina's own skills only benefits 30% of her Magic Lifesteal.
*Fully gain EXP when the damage is from emblem, battle spells, basic attacks but not on non-minion enemies, such as summons.
*Damage from battle spells and equipment cannot be converted to HP.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.description:
Valentina casts Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing 340-665 (+185% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1 second.
Enemy heroes hit by Shadow Strike are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4 seconds and will be terrified for 1s when hit by Shadow Strike again within the duration (a unit can only be terrified once within 4 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Arcane Shade
skills.description: Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 125-225 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each. Valentina can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana). The cooldown of Shadow Strike is reduced by 1 second each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy.
skills.notes: *This skill can target hidden enemy units.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: I Am You
skills.description:
Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5 seconds and gains the ability to cast their Ultimate. Casting the enemy's Ultimate turns Valentina into the enemy hero's form and allows her to inherit their Basic Attack type for up to 12 seconds. Her regular skills remain unchanged, unless the enemy's Ultimate has a Morph effect.
The stolen Ultimate's level will be equal to Valentina's level and the cooldown will be 120%–100% of the target's cooldown (but not lower than 10 seconds). Valentina gains (+100% Total Magic Power) Physical Attack for the duration if the enemy is a Physical Damage hero. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts when the duration of this skill ends, or through manual cancellation.
*The target enemy will have a back-animation indicating that enemy Valentina is possessing their ability and has not yet used it. The indicator vanishes if the ability is used or cancelled.
*If Valentina turned into the enemy hero's form, neither of her nor the copied hero's voice lines will play.
*Siphoning an enemy hero can also copy their equipped skin and its skin effects.
*Regardless of the form of the target hero, Valentina can only copy the default/1st phase of the ultimates. (e.g., you can only copy Roger's Wolf Transformation―not Restore Human Form―even if he is in Wolf Form.)
*Ultimates that require activation from their non-Ultimates such as Wanwan's Crossbow of Tang and Fredrinn's Energy Eruption can be use immediately by Valentina.
**However, siphoning enemy Hilda also contains their respective stacks, strengthening the stolen Ultimate.
I am You
*For Phoveus, the ultimate is always greyed out, but when tapping the ultimate button, Valentina can switch to his form with the entire skill set.
*Valentina cannot inherit Attack Speed Ratio from a copied hero.
*BUFFs, stacks and summoned units that came from the copied hero will disappear as the skill duration ends or when Valentina manually cancels it. Valentina's death cancels the copy immediately, which also cancels in return.
*For Lukas, Valentina will copy the current availability of Unleash the beast as well as his current amount of Hero's Resolve and can normally gain it from her damage.
**I am You begins cooldown (from a maximum of 10 seconds) as soon as the ability is cast.
**Her attack range is set to 2.6 as Lukas.
*Physical Basic Attacks does not benefit from extra Physical Attack.
*When the description of the stolen Ultimate says "basic attack" or "skill," it only refers to the copied hero's basic attacks and skills (including non-Ultimates); thus, Valentina's skills are not included in the definition.
*For Leomord, Valentina gains all of his basic abilities before Phantom Steed reaches her, which grants her the set of enhanced abilities.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Overload
skills.description:
After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3 seconds, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to (+30% Total Magic Power) (+target's 4-8% Total HP) to up to 4 enemies.
Chain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.
skills.notes:
*Chain lightning counts as Skill Damage.
*When the first target of its/her chain lightning is not a nearby Turret, the Turret will not be included in the chain.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Earth Shatter
skills.description:
After a 0.75 seconds delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225–450 (+10% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to Minions and knocking them airborne for 1 second.
This skill won't be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Divine Retribution
skills.description: Edith exacts Divine Retribution on a target area, dealing 170–320 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. She then continues to deal 68–128 (+16% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 second over the next 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes: *Spell Vamp Ratio: 25%

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Onward
skills.description:
Edith controls Phylax to charge in a the target direction, dealing 90–140 (+3% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.
If Phylax hits an enemy hero during this process, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing 108 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.description: Edith fires a Lightning Bolt in a designated direction, dealing 150–300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8 seconds.
skills.notes: *Spell Vamp Ratio: 25%

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Primal Wrath
skills.description:
Passive: When inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath according to the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction).
Active: Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35–65 (+75% Total Physical Attack) (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Edith also gains new skills in this state.  When in flight, Edith gains 350–650 (+5% Total HP)–350–650(+20% Total HP) extra Shield, 50%–150% extra Attack Speed and 5%-20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on Wrath she accumulated, and converts each point of Extra Physical Defense and Extra Magic Defense into 3.5 Magic Power. The Flight state lasts up to 8–12 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Wrath begins to deplete after 5 seconds of Phylax not being in battle (i.e. not taking or dealing damage), with 10% of Wrath depleted every 0.5 seconds.
**Wrath persists after death and depletes nonetheless.
*Edith can end Primal Wrath prematurely by canceling it.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Dew
skills.description:
Dew's Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount.
After leaving combat for 5 seconds, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30 seconds cooldown), which will grant them a 100 (+70% Total Magic Power) shield each time they are healed by Floryn.
Floryn will never sell the Lantern.
skills.notes:
*Does not affect target ally's networth.
*The Lantern can be cast regardless of distance or even when death.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Sow
skills.description: Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at a target enemy, dealing 180-330 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their HP by 175-225 (+90% Total Magic Power).
skills.notes:
*Healing Fruits range has the same range as the cast range of this skill.
*Healing Fruits travel to the nearby allies in 0.6 seconds (ignores distance of its point of origin).
*If the target enemy dies before the ability hits, no heal takes effect.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Sprout
skills.description: Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 175-350 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds (and revealing their positions briefly).[duration needed]

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Bloom
skills.description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, recovering 250-450 (+100% Total Magic Power) HP to all allied heroes 2 times no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regen effects by 12% for 2 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Cannot affect ally inside Yin's My Turn nor allies outside if Floryn is inside.
*The effect only takes effect on allies alive at the time of casting.

skills.heading: Other
skills.name: Share
skills.description: Floryn shares the Lantern's power with an allied hero, slightly increasing their attributes. The ally that have the Shimmering Lantern granted will deal 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage extra on their next Basic Attack. Cooldown; 6s
skills.notes:
*The extra Attribute increase is 8% extra Adaptive Attack.
*Share's cooldown is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.
*Casting this skill does not give skill-based buffs like on Azure Blade and its successor items.
*The extra damage scales with the Physical Attack and Magic Power of the ally that was granted on, not Floryn's.
*The icon of this skill is based off of the now-removed Shimmering Lantern.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Leave It to Me
skills.description: If there are no nearby allies within 4 units, Yin's damage is pd to 120% and gains 8% Spell Vamp.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Charged Punch
skills.description:
Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3 seconds).
Yin can launch an enhanced Basic Attack that deals 25-100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage within the duration. Upon hitting an enemy with the enhanced Basic Attack, Yin will throw another charged punch forward, dealing 360-560 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the path.
Successfully throwing a charged punch cooldown reduction by 35%.
skills.notes:
*Attack Speed affects the dashing speed and casting speed of Charged Punch's initial Basic Attack but not the second one.
*The initial attack is considered as Basic Attack, the succeeding attack is dealt as skill damage.
**The enhanced Basic Attack can crit.
***It is also the one that cooldown reduction by 35%.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Frenzy Strike
skills.description:
Lieh smashes an area ahead up to 9 times, each smash dealing 130-180 (+110% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 0.2 second.
Lieh is control immunity for the duration, while the smashing speed will gradually increase. The first half of the attacks will automatically lock onto nearby enemies, while the latter half cannot change directions.
Lieh can move or cast other skills during the latter half to cancel the skill early.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Instant Blast
skills.description:
Yin dashes forward, leaving [Golden Rings] behind while dealing 75-150 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4 seconds if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1 second, [Golden Rings] will catch up with Yin, dealing 150-300 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and cc them for 1 second.
skills.notes:
*Rings left behind by Yin before entering Lieh's domain will be dragged inside at the same distance behind Yin and will try to catch up to Lieh.
*Instant Blast's extra 30% Damage Reduction does not stack with Instant Blast (Lieh)'s damage reduction but its duration will be reset instead.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Instant Blast
skills.description:
Lieh strikes a flying kick forward, leaving a [Golden Rings] behind while dealing 75-150 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. Enemies hit will also be cc slightly. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4 seconds if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1 second, Golden Rings will catch up with Lieh, dealing 150-300 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and cc them for 1.25 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Rings left behind by Lieh just before exiting his domain will be dragged outside at the same distance where in first dragged the target before catching up to Yin.
*Instant Blast (Lieh)'s extra 30% Damage Reduction does not stack with Instant Blast's damage reduction but its duration will be reset instead.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: My Turn
skills.description:
After a short delay Yin cc an enemy (excluding summoned unit) into his domain for up to 8 seconds and turns into form. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills.
Lieh has stronger skills and gains 50-80 Physical & Magic Defense that lasts for 8 seconds.
The domain will end early if any of the two hero is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll restore 20% Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8 seconds.
If Yin fails to pull his target into his domain, the skill will enter a 3 second cooldown.
skills.notes:
*Pulling an enemy inside Lieh's domain has a slight casting delay.
*For interaction detail, please refer to My Turn Interaction section below.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: Forsaken Light
skills.description:
Since there are other Forsaken Light members on [[template:FULLPAGENAME]'s] team, [his] Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed and Critical Damage are increased [by 1/1/1%/1%, respectively].
(Original text: Forsaken Light: Since all the Forsaken Light members are present, your Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed, and Crit Damage are  increased.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Doll Buster
skills.description:
"My tailor shop excels at "fixing" dolls and "fixing" dolls. Am I right?, Muddles?"
(Melissa deals 125% damage to minions, creeps and summoned units.)
skills.notes: *Additional damage dealt to summoned units and minions includes all types of damage from battle spells, talents, equipment, skills, and basic attacks.
skills.quote: Uh-oh, Melissa's taken apart another bunch of dolls!

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Falling!
skills.description:
"Watch me slide forward and increase my Attack Speed for 3 seconds—Ah, that was just boring…"
"Muddles, go that way!"
"Cuddles, come here!"
(The skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time Melissa damages the enemy by attacking Muddles.)
skills.quote: Melissa is falling… In your dreams!

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Eyes on You!
skills.description:
"The plan's like this: Throw Muddles out to hold the bad guys, and then… I come on stage!"
"I puncture the bad guys, while Giggles hit Muddles to punish the bad guys! Hee, fantastic!"
(Muddles deals 250-400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on the first hit and links nearby [enemy heroes and summoned units] for up to 6 seconds. Linked enemies will be slowed by 60% that decays over 1.5 seconds and can break the link by moving out of the range. Muddles will return to Melissa early when she's too far away. When Muddles is present, you can tap the Attack Minion button to directly attack Muddles, though it cannot trigger the multi-hit damage.)
skills.notes:
*Dealing damage against linked enemies may vary according to their unit types. Damage against Link enemies that can be affected by her passive is : 75%.
*Cooldown begins instantly after cast.
*While in the air,  "Falling!" can be used to dash without moving Muddles.
*Muddles Applies on-hit effects and critical damage.
**Damage dealt by Muddles through the link is affected by the Damage Transfer Ratio.
**On-hit effects such as Weakness Finder, Corrosion, and DHS are not affected and retain full effectiveness.
***Effects that can only target 1 enemy such as Weakness finder will apply to the first enemy hit if attacking Muddles, else it would only affect the enemy being targeted by Melissa.
**Muddles can independently land Critical Hits from Melissa and will activate Critical dependent effects like Frenzy.
**Muddles also benefits from Physical Penetration and Magic Penetration.
*Muddles 'attack' is considered a basic attack from Melissa, and can apply effects suck as; Impulse, Endless Strike, Engulf, Retribution, Devour, and Corrosion. This also means that with Muddles attacking, she will use the Inspire buff quicker, scaling with the amount of enemies linked to Muddles.
skills.quote: Go, Muddles!

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Go Away!
skills.description:
"Cuddles, protect me! For 4 seconds, let no bad guys come close. Unless I say otherwise!"
(When activated, the field knocks back Melissa creates a dome that continuously damages and repels  enemies in the area and deals 500-900 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. It'll then continuously knock back enemies who attempt to enter the field. dealing 50-90 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them [by 60%]. The field will also interrupt the enemy's movement skills unless they're immune to control effects. The field will move with Melissa once, when she's about to move out of boundary.
Passive: Melissa's Physical & Magical Defense are increased by 3. (This effect is increased to 5 times when the skill is active.)
skills.notes:
*Has the diameter of 5.3.
*The first damage applies effects such as skill effects and Magic Penetration, but the continuous damage applies none.
*The Protective Field can be re-positioned twice, once through Dashing out of the field with "Falling!" and once through moving out naturally.
**If moving out naturally, twice, the field will remain in the second location until  "Falling!" is used, in which it will reform on top of Melissa.
*The extra damage ticks a total of 15 times if the target is pinned against the wall, for a total of 750/1050/1350 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Total damage including the base damage is 1250/1750/2250 (+250% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
*The ability follows when she is teleported.
*Leaving Yin's My Turn fully cancels this ability.
skills.quote: Do you know? Hugs will give you the courage to face the darkness.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: Forsaken Light
skills.description:
Since there are other Forsaken Light members on [[template:FULLPAGENAME]'s] team, [her] Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed and Critical Damage are increased [by 1/1/1%/1%, respectively].
(Original text: Forsaken Light: Since all the Forsaken Light members are present, your Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed, and Crit Damage are  increased.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Transcendence
skills.description:
Xavier enhances his subsequent skills each time his skill hits an enemy hero. Stage I: Increases Movement Speed by 50% when subsequent skills hit, decaying over 1.2 seconds. Stage II: Width of subsequent skills will be greatly increased. Stage III: Skill Cooldown reduced by 4 seconds (36 seconds for the Ultimate). At Stage III, Xavier enters the Transcendence state.
Transcendence: All of Xavier's skills are enhanced to Stage III state for 5 seconds (this duration is extend by 1 second each time Xavier's skill hits an enemy).

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Infinite Extension
skills.description:
Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480-650 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it passes through.
The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Mystic Field
skills.description:
Xavier conjures a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier will take 220-340 total-mp-65 and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2 seconds.
When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a forbidden field for 3 seconds, dealing 220-340 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and cc them for 1.2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Dawning Light
skills.description:
Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic that deals 600-1100 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies along its path.
Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence state and resets the state's duration.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: Forsaken Light
skills.description:
Since there are other Forsaken Light members on [[template:FULLPAGENAME]'s] team, [his] Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed and Critical Damage are increased [by 1/1/1%/1%, respectively].
(Original text: Forsaken Light: Since all the Forsaken Light members are present, your Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed, and Crit Damage are  increased.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Smith's Legacy
skills.description:
After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9–6 seconds cooldown (decreases with his level.
After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks within the next 5 seconds to deal 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and pull the target toward him. Casting another skill extends the duration.
Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5 seconds each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).
skills.notes:
*"Third skill" refers to the remaining unused skill, which is enhanced, not "Skill 3".
*A skill that has been casted will undergo a 5-second timer and casting second skill will reset the cooldown timer. If the timer ends after failing to cast the second or third skill, it will reset the skill(s) cooldown.
*If two different abilities are already cast and on cooldown, and the remaining ability which has not been learned is learned, such an ability will be enhanced and resets the cooldown timer of the other two abilities.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Scythe
skills.description:
Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 380-700 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.
The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Enhanced Scythe
skills.description: Julian hurls enhanced scythes in the target direction, dealing 380-700 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 50% for 1 second. Upon hitting a non-minion enemy or reaching the maximum distance, the scythes will continue to fly at a lower speed, dealing 65-185 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.3 seconds to nearby enemies (up to 9 times).

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Sword
skills.description: Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400-540 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Enhanced Sword
skills.description: Julian summons a large number of flying swords and dashes in the target direction, dealing 60-100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.1 seconds to enemies along the way (up to 9 times). Julian's untargetable and invisible during the dash. [After a short delay, he'll reappear at the farthest end.]

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Chain
skills.description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300-440 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Enhanced Chain
skills.description:
Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 40-60 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.2 seconds to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%.
Enemies that are still in the area at the end of the skill duration will take 250-370 extra Magic Damage and be knocked airborne for 0.8 seconds.
skills.notes: *Does not go on cooldown if being interrupted during the cast delay.

skills.heading: BUFF
skills.name: Forsaken Light
skills.description:
Since there are other Forsaken Light members on [[template:FULLPAGENAME]'s] team, [his] Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed and Critical Damage are increased [by 1/1/1%/1%, respectively].
(Original text: Forsaken Light: Since all the Forsaken Light members are present, your Max HP, Max Mana, Movement Speed, and Crit Damage are  increased.)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Crystalline Armor
skills.description:
Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5 seconds each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimate costs different numbers of Combo Points at different skill levels.
Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy, which decays after 5 seconds at a rate of 10% Max HP per second.
Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Piercing Strike
skills.description:
Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125 (+7% Total HP) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.[skill duration needed]
This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.
skills.notes: *Enhanced basic attack from Brave Assault and this skill cannot be stacked. The enhanced basic attack effect from this this skill will be replaced by Brave Assault's.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Brave Assault
skills.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3 seconds.[skill duration needed]
skills.notes: *Enhanced basic attack from Piercing Strike and this skill cannot be stacked. The enhanced basic attack effect from this this skill will be replaced by Piercing Strike's.

skills.heading: Ultimate 1
skills.name: Energy Eruption
skills.description:
Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1 second. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 Physical and Magic Defense for 3 seconds and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault by 75%.
This skill costs 1 Combo Point.
skills.notes:
*This skill is learned together with Appraiser's Wrath.
**Between Fredrinn's latter two skills, Valentina can only siphon and copy this skill with I Am You.

skills.heading: Ultimate 2
skills.name: Appraiser's Wrath
skills.description:
Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21%-35% of his Crystal Energy as Physical Damage to enemies in fan-shaped area after a short delay.[duration needed] Enemies in the center of the area take 175% [critical] damage.
This skill costs 3 Combo Points.
skills.notes:
*This skill is learned together with Energy Eruption.
*According to Advance Server Patch Notes 1.7.26 and 1.7.29, and Original Server Patch Notes 1.7.32, this skill is named as an "Ultimate".
*175% increased critical damage from this skill does not benefit from Critical Damage attribute.
*This skill cannot be interrupted. This doesn't mean that Fredrinn gains CC immunity. It means the hit will still be executed even if Fredrinn gets crowd controlled.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Humph, Joy's Angry!
skills.description:
Joy becomes Angry! each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Magic Damage and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the Leonin Crystal will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.
Joy's Basic Attack will deal
65 (+65% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Look, Leonin Crystal!
skills.description:
Joy summons a Leonin Crystal at the target location, dealing 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.
The Leonin Crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for her second skill, Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
skills.description:
Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8 seconds and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage shield that lasts 3s.
This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
skills.description:
Joy increases her Physical & Magic Defense by 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gains 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 4s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time to nearby enemies.
Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy! cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.
This skill unlocks when Joy acquires Beat Energy. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy will remove all debuffs on Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Star Trail
skills.description: Astral Spheres summoned by Novaria will continuously slow nearby enemies by 20% and grant vision of them [for 2 seconds].

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Astral Meteor
skills.description: Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at the target location. continuously dealing 75-150 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies [six times]. After 2 seconds, the sphere will explode, dealing 260-385 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+enemy's 4% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, and increasing Astral Sphere's slow effect to 2.5 times the original slow effect (50% slow).
skills.notes:
*The damage, excluding the final one, reveals enemies until they get out of the area of effect. The final damage reveals heroes for 2 seconds.
*The slow gradually increases over-time.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Astral Recall
skills.description:
Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at a distance and draws it towards her. At the same time, Novaria gains 80% Movement Speed (decays to 30% Movement Speed over time) and can pass through terrain.
When the Astral Sphere reaches Novaria, she can launch it in a target direction within 5 seconds. The sphere will explode when hitting an enemy hero, dealing 260-410 (+95% Total Magic Power) (+enemy's 5% Total HP) Magic Damage. The damage will increase based on the Astral Sphere's travel
distance (starting from when the sphere is summoned) up to 2.2 times (120%) the original.
skills.notes:
*Enemies will be revealed for a short amount of time[duration needed] when passed by the returning Astral Sphere. No eye mark if it doesn't hit them.
*The game camera zooms out during the skill duration.
*If Astral Recall ends when Novaria is inside the obstacle, she will be displaced to the nearest valid point.
*Novaria cannot go beyond the battlefield for an unspecified amount of distance within the skill duration.
*Novaria can recall during the skill duration, but it will be interrupted when she receives the Astral Sphere, or skill duration ends while she is inside an obstacle.
*Its damage increases by 15% for each unknown succeeding distance.[duration unknown]
*It deals up to 1000 / 1200 / 1400 / 1600 / 1800 / 2000 to non-hero units.
*Novaria speeds up by 60% when passing through obstacles.
*Novaria can get more stacks when passing through obstacles.
*Assisted Aiming Mode is disabled by default on this skill.
*Passing by obstacles increase speed once per cast time.
**When she passes by the obstacle, her model also has an embedding background.
**The inner edge of Yin's My Turn, destroyed turrets, Badang's Fist Break or Grock's Guardian's Barrier are also obstacles.
**Yin's My Turn does not prevent the retriving in any way.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Astral Echo
skills.description: Novaria scatters Astral Echo in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% (for approximately 0.8 seconds) while applying Astral Ring on them, increasing their hitbox by 2.5 times and revealing their surrounding area. This effect lasts 5 seconds.
skills.notes:
*Has the distance of 23 unit.
*Novaria gets an assist from an enemy marked by the Astral Ring.
*Hitbox does not increase enemy's ability range, such as Cursed Helmet.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Demon Gaze
skills.description:
Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will Mark enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s.
The eye will also automatically Mark a nearby enemy hero every 7s.
skills.notes:
*Demon Gaze is applied to enemies within 5.5 unit, even if Arlott is unsighted to them.
*Demon Gaze will only auto apply to, and in the following priority:
**Enemies without Mark.
**Targetable enemies.
**Visible enemies.
**Nearest enemies.
*Become CC immune does not remove
*Mark disappears when the unit dies.
*Demon Gaze is independent from Arlott. The ability keeps its cooldown when he dies.
*Reapplying Mark through control effects refreshes the duration.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Dauntless Strike
skills.description:
Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning the targets in the area.
Targets hit by the further part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Vengeance
skills.description:
Arlott charges at an enemy and deals 160 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement).
If Arlott's target is Marked, this skill will deal double damage and refresh its cooldown , and restoring 0 (+90% Total Physical Attack) HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).
skills.notes:
*The skill button glows if there exists marked enemy within range.
*The glow will only be updated after the skill ends where Arlott reaches the target and tries to apply damage.
*If the skill is pressed again while Arlott is still flying, it will be queued to immediately chain afterwards, even if there is no marked enemy within range.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Final Slash
skills.description: Arlott cleaves in front of him, dealing 400 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area and pushing them to the edge of the AOE and breifly revealing their location.
skills.notes:
*Has the range of 5.5.
*The ability can be repositioned by Flicker during the cast delay.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Siphon Starlium
skills.description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the stacks and be replaced with Siphon Starlium, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) (+200× Lifesteal) plus (+10 × Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only 20 (+100× Lifesteal)% against non-hero units). Siphon Starlium can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia that are within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot critically strike.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.
skills.notes:
*According to Ixia's official concept video, her basic attacks travel in a . I travels in a curved trajectory that takes longer to travel to its target than any ranged basic attacks that has straight trajectory.
*Starlium Charge counts as a debuff and can be removed by skills such as Purify.
*Starlium Charge stacks on enemies lasts for 5 seconds or until it is siphoned by Ixia.
*Ixia cannot apply stacks to turrets.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Dual Beam
skills.description:
Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 120-225 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy heroes by 40%. Upon hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.
Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Star Helix
skills.description: Ixia launches a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies, and pulling enemies in range to the center line after a short delay (approximately 0.5 seconds) and dealing 200-300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
skills.notes: *The knockback and pull effects of this skill has 0.1 seconds stun.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Full Barrage
skills.description: Ixia disassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage state for 4 seconds. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in a large fan-shaped area but not outside of it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.
skills.notes:
*Ixia cannot target turrets during the Barrage state.
*This skill reveals enemies within the fan-shaped area.
*Ixia cannot move in Barrage state.
*This skill can only be interrupted with suppressed crowd control.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Dimensional Rift
skills.description:
Nolan's skills will leave a Rift that lasts 5 seconds and slows enemies by 30%. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will activate and pull enemies to their center and deal 220 (+140% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a short delay.
Each time a rift activation hits an enemy hero or Creep, Nolan will gain 15 Energy and heals 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) for himself. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced to 40%.
Cosmic Leap: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5 seconds, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a rift. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)
skills.notes:
*
Dimensional Rifts
*Rift lasts 5 seconds.
*Within the next 0.5s after a Rift activation, a new Rift that comes in contact also gets activated.
*The Rifts do not need to intersect as long as they are very close in proximity.
*Does not activate with enemy Nolan's Rift.
Enhanced Basic Attack
*The Enhanced basic attack only leaves Rift after Nolan hits the target, including turret.
**The indicator is visible to everyone.
*The enhanced basic attack cooldown is reset if taking or dealing damage to turret, enemy heroes, Lord and Turtle.
*Respawn and reincarnation restarts the cooldown.
Energy bar
*Nolan's energy bar is divided into 4 parts, each equates to 25 energy.
**The purple buff divided the energy bar into 5, each equates 20 energy.
skills.quote: The father who swore to protect his shining star.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Expansion
skills.description: Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230-480 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a rift at the first enemy hit.
skills.notes: *If cast on empty ground, the Rift is created slightly further than the indicator range.
skills.quote: The scholar that explored the edge of the universe.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Gauge
skills.description: Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70-220 (+13% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and leaving a Rift.
skills.quote: The wayfinder that measured the distance of the star

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Fracture
