skills.description: Nolan slashes the target location 3 times, 120-180 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each slash while leaving 3 Rifts and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backwards.
skills.quote: The hero that finally returned home.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Performer's Delight
skills.description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 0.75% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

levelScaling.label: Extra Movement Speed and Spell Vamp

skills.notes: *Aside from the buff indicator, a visual indicator of Delight stacks below Cici's health bar is shown and is visible to both allies and enemies.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Yo-Yo Blitz
skills.description:
Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5 seconds, hitting them up to 10 times and dealing Physical Damage equal to 60-85 plus 3-4.5 (+1.2% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack.
If there's no enemy hero within the range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead.
The skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.
skills.notes:
*Cooldown starts upon casting.
*Only suppression can cancel this skill, thus ending its duration; appropriate crowd control effects can only interrupt this skill.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Buoyant Bounce
skills.description: Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals 200-300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Curtain Call
skills.description:
Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together.
During this time, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one is within the range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25%~45%.
skills.notes: *Yoyo applied to an enemy counts as debuff, therefore, it can be removed by effects such as Purify.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Snack Time!
skills.description: Chip starts eating potato chips once every 2 seconds when out of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 45% of lost HP after finishing a whole bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip  will be full and cannot eat again for 5 seconds. (The bite count will be saved if he enters combat before finishing a whole bag)
skills.quote: Yummy...yummy...

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Crash Course
skills.description: Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing Magic Damage equal to 100-200 plus 4% of the target's Max HP and applying Chip's Mark on enemy units hit. Chip gains a 300-800 (+60% Total Magic Power) shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark, detonating the mark to deal 150-275 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun each target for 0.6 seconds.
skills.notes: *Crash Course increases Chip's basic attack range to 3.5.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Overtime
skills.description:
Chip rushes for 2 seconds, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2 seconds.
Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200-300 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back slightly.
skills.notes: *Overtime increases Chip's basic attack range to 3.5.
skills.quote: Sunshine and beach, I'm here!

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Shortcut
skills.description:
Chip drops the Main Portal on an enemy hero, dealing 200-300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 25%. the Main Portal deals 2 timesthe damage and immobilizes them for 1 second after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates Connecting Portals near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The Main Portal and Connecting Portals last up to 15 seconds.
Connecting Portal: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from Connecting Portals to the Main Portal, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds and a 500-1000 shield.
Main Portal: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the Main Portal for 2 seconds to return to the Connecting Portal they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time
skills.notes:
*The first connecting portal that a Hero comes in will be marked as the connecting portal for them.
*Going through a connecting portal will trigger Phoveus's Demonic Force but not on returning.
*A hero can only return to the previous portal once after 2 seconds of waiting delay.
*The Main Portal is treated as a creep, and is fully affected by Retribution.
*Does not create Connecting Portals to unit inside Yin's My Turn and vice versa if Chip is inside.
skills.quote: Get it done so we can get off work.

skills.heading: Special
skills.name: Why Walk?
skills.description: Chip has 4 Beacons on the map when the battle starts. Use this skill to teleport to any other Beacon. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)
skills.notes:
*Beacons in clockwise: 1 (top)>2>3>4.
*Cannot teleport within Yin's My Turn. The order is queued afterwards.
*When a beacon is hold cast, its animation changes and visible to nearby units.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Crimson Butterflies
skills.description:
Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 3% of her Max Mana.
Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.
skills.notes:
*Crimson Butterflies can only stack up on heroes and summoned units that are simultaneously applied with Soul Snare stacks from the Lantern Flare skill,
*Crimson Butterflies stacks start to decay in approximately less than a second once Lantern Flare was released and gradually decays for every & approx;0.33 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Fluttering Grace
skills.description: Zhuxin deals 150-210 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20%–40% and gains 20%–40% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Lantern Flare
skills.description:
Hold: Zhuxin can move the Spirit Lantern with the skill button, dealing 35-80 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies within range every 0.33 seconds (Magic Power increases to 60% against Minions) and applying Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. Each time (wether it hits a unit or not) consuming 90 Mana. When an enemy hero has 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies will capture them, pulling them airborne for 1 second.
Release: Throws all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200-400 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage + 10%-15% of target's Max HP to all enemies in the area. (If an enemy takes damage multiple times, subsequent damage taken will be reduced by 80%.)
After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% increased damage to that target.
skills.notes:
*Soul Snare lasts for 4 seconds.
*If Zhuxin fails to release the skill, airborne enemies will be thrown to the same location from which they were knocked airborne.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Crimson Beacon
skills.description: Zhuxin blinks to the target location while gaining a 400-700 (+100% Total Magic Power) shield. While flying, she creates a field around her for 6 seconds. The field deals 30-45 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to enemies every 0.5 seconds.
skills.notes: * Deals in total 360 / 450 / 540 (+120% Total Magic Power)

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Transient Immortal
skills.description:
Tap-casting any skill will put Suyou in his Mortal form, grant him 40 Movement Speed and decreasing the interval between Basic Attacks.
Hold-casting any skill will put Suyou in his Immortal form, increasing the damage of Basic Attacks to 125% and granting him 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In this form, for every 20 extra Physical Attack Suyou has, he gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction (up to 40%).
skills.calc: $\mathrm {total\ Physical DMG\ reduction} = (0.05 \times extra\ Physical\ ATK)\%$
skills.notes:
*Suyou's basic attack rate in Mortal Form is ≈1.25 times his total attack speed.
*Suyou loses Immortal Form upon death.
*The Physical Damage Reduction and attack speed bonus are not displayed.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Blade Surge
skills.description:
Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250-330 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375-495 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250-330 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6 seconds. The charge increase distance increases with the hold time.
Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.
skills.notes:
Tap-cast
*The dash has a range of 3.8 unit.
*After dashing, Suyou's facing direction is set to the opposite of his casting's direction.
**However, using Flicker will set the facing direction towards Flicker's angle, leading to a slash in different angle.
*The slash has a shorter range of 2 unit.
Hold-cast
*Despite the description, the mobility from holding the ability is a dash that can go through obstacles.
**This dash first slightly knockbacks the first enemies hit, then stuns them.
*When Suyou is rooted while holding Blade Surge, the ability is cancelled.
*Hold Blade Surge for up to ≈0.6 seconds to tap-cast, then keep holding for  ≈0.6–3 seconds to hold-cast, which has a total holding time of ≈2.4 seconds.
**Suyou can fully charge his hold-casting skill for up to ≈0.5 seconds to maximize range and up to ≈0.8 seconds to maximize the in-game camera zooming out.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Soul Sever
skills.description:
Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing [300-492 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) (+target's 20% Lost HP) Physical Damage] to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 250-410 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the final strike deals 400-656 (+128% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovers 150-230 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) HP for himself.
skills.notes:
*Hold Soul Sever for up to ≈0.25 seconds to tap-cast, then keep holding for ≈0.25–1 second to hold-cast, which has a total holding time of ≈0.75 seconds.
**Each hold-casting deals an attack for every ≈0.25 seconds.
*The hold-casting strikes have the same range as the attack range in Immortal Form.

skills.heading: Skill 3
skills.name: Evil Queller
skills.description:
Tap: Suyou glides backward and  swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420-580 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path back ward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
Hold: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580-800 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time.
Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.
skills.notes:
*When being controlled, the ability keeps charging.
*The arrow range begins at 3.8 unit, and up to 8 unit.
*Disabled by rooted.
**When rooted while holding Evil Queller, the ability is not canceled, but the release action is prohibited.
*Evil Queller is treated as an Ultimate with 5 upgradable level and can be learned at the level 1.
**Interactions of Unique Passive - Timestream, Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior and I Am You are still present on Evil Queller.
*Hold Evil Queller for up to ≈0.6 seconds to tap-cast, then keep holding for ≈0.6–3 seconds to hold-cast, which has a total holding time of ≈2.4 seconds.
**Suyou can fully charge his hold-casting skill for up to ≈0.75 seconds to maximize range and up to ≈0.8 seconds to maximize the in-game camera zooming out.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Hero's Resolve
skills.description:
Lukas gains 1 Resolve per second and an additional 2 Resolve when dealing damage to heroes.
Lukas consumes 10 Resolve per second while in Sacred Beast form.
skills.notes:
*Lukas also gains Hero's Resolve when attacking:
**an untargetable enemy
**Vexana's Eternal Guard.
**Zhask's Nightmaric Spawn.
**Sun's clones.
**Kupa.
**Hanzo's Kinjutsu Pinnacle Ninja.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Flash Combo
skills.description:
Passive: Lukas can enhance Flash Combo with his Basic Attacks up to 2 times, lasting 4s.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 300 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, plus additional attacks depending on the Vigor consumed (recovers HP equal to 8% of Max HP when hitting a hero):
1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him.
2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target and follows up with 2 attacks that deal 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit. He will then spin his tonfa hammers to deal 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times (cannot be interrupted).

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Flash Combo
skills.description:
Passive: Lukas can enhance Flash Combo with his Basic Attacks up to 2 times, lasting 4s.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash a tail swing, dealing 300 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, plus additional attacks depending on the Vigor consumed. When hitting a hero, he also recovers 8% of his Max HP.
1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and pounces to deal 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, knocking the enemy back.
2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target and leaps to deal 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 2 times, then summons sacred lightning, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times (cannot be interrupted)

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Flash Step
skills.description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into Flash Strike.
Flash Strike: Lukas blinks behind the enemy, dealing 60 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then increases his Attack Range, gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed, and summons lightning storms with Basic Attacks to deal 40 (+25% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage, lasting for 4s.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Flash Step
skills.description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into Lightning Clash.
Lightning Clash: Lukas charges toward the enemy, knocking them back and dealing 60 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed, and summons sacred lightning with Basic Attacks to deal 40 (+25% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage, lasting for 4s.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Unleash the Beast
skills.description:
Lukas transforms into his Sacred Beast form. While in this state, his base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects.
Use Again: Lukas in Sacred Beast form fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
"All attributes" include HP, Physical Attack, Attack Speed, Physical & Magic Defense and Attack Range.
skills.notes:
*Lukas's attack range increases from 1.8 to 2.6 for the duration.
*Lukas can hold-spin the abiity to change the facing direction.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Shockwave Blast
skills.description: The Sacred Beast fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage .
skills.notes: *The blast has a max range of 11.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Surge of Life
skills.description:
After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she will absorb it to enhance her next three Basic Attacks with different effects:
First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 120 (+10% Total HP) (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for herself and the nearby lowest HP ally.
Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, dealing 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone. Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.
skills.notes:
;Enhanced basic attacks:
*The enhanced basic attacks last as a 12-second buff, which persists as long as there is unused attack(s).
*Each next attack can be manually halted.
*The first enhanced basic attack increases her attack range into 3.2, with the indicator visible to enemies, also slightly knockback target enemy.
*The second enhanced basic attack cannot be manually cancelled, and takes (approximately) 1.2 seconds to execute.
**Any given order, such as item or ability cast will be queued afterwards.
**Using Winter Crown will pause the animation.
**The attack launches 4 projectiles locking a nearby ally to heal them, and does not change midway if the ally has more health than another nearby ally.
**If the enemy becomes dies or untargetable, the attack will not heal further but the animation persists, the third enhanced basic attack will be reserved.
*The nearby ally must be at least within (approximately) 7.5 unit.
*The first and third basic attack are dash, hence this ability triggers Phoveus's Demonic Force twice.
;Water Zone properties:
*Each Water Zone lasts 6 seconds, will combine with another Water Zone if Kalea is within the old Water Zone and is created centered at Kalea.
*It is impossible to have 2 Water Zone exist at the same time.
*Kalea does not benefit from enemy Water Zone in any way nor combine with them.
*The Water Zone gives vision within 9 units. Enemies entering the range is sighted if they are not concealed.
**When Water Zone is created in a bush when enemies are inside it, the entire bush are still visible to Kalea even after she left.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Wavebreaker
skills.description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 250 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
skills.notes: *The Water Zone has the radius of 3, which is slightly shorter than her first enhanced basic attack.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Tidal Strike
skills.description:
Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s while dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s.
skills.notes:
*Fully affect concealed and invisible enemies.
*After jumping to a wall or Water Zone, she has (approximately) 2 seconds to select the landing area until she goes down the wall.
*If Kalea is affected by crowd control effects, she is unperched from the wall or her Water Zone, waste the remaining effect.
**However, if she jumps on a temporary wall and the wall disappears when she is midair, she is not unperched.
*** This includes walls in Yin's My Turn.
*The cooldown begins as soon as the ability is cast.
*The landing animation can be blocked by Khufra's Bouncing Ball or repositioned by Flicker
*The airborne upon landing is only performed if Kalea successfully lands.
*This ability triggers Phoveus's Demonic Force twice.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Tsunami Slam
skills.description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies.
skills.notes:
*Kalea is CC Immune for the entire duration.
*Max distance is 7.5 unit.
*The ability has two phases:
**Kalea first grabs an enemy, performing a stun.
**Kalea continuously applies airborne effect and makes target enemy move along with her.
**Kalea then creates a Water Zone on the landing spot and loses CC Immune. Then dashes towards the joystick direction a distance of 1.5 unit.
**Hence this ability triggers Phoveus's Demonic Force twice.
**Due to this mechanics, the enemy can be dragged along with Kalea when she is teleported by Luo Yi'sDiversion.
*The landing area is visible to Kalea only.
*Kalea cannot use any other abilities, battle spells or equipments for the duration.
*Both Kalea and the target will be displaced if the landing area is over an obstacle.
*Despite not having Mobility tag, this skill is disabled in Minsitthar's King's Calling.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Celestial Armament
skills.description:
Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for 5s, stacking up to 10 times.
Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who dares approach her while dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Shield that lasts 3s. This effect has a 120s cooldown.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Phoenix Strike
skills.description:
Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave, up to 3 times. While casting, Zetian can move with 10% increased Movement Speed and can use other skills.
The three Phoenix Waves deal 185 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage/185 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage/330 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The third wave hits a larger area and includes a small pull effect (not considered a control effect).
This skill only has 80% Spell Vamp efficiency against Minions.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Phoenix Descent
skills.description:
Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a 50% Slow Effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10%.
While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a <%Num8> Slow Effect upon arrival.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Fury of the Phoenix
skills.description:
Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 60% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 1s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.
Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Return to Bone
skills.description: When Obsidia deals damage to enemies, she gains Bone Energy (Basic Attacks against non-hero units grant 1 Energy, against hero units grant 2 Energy, and skills grant 3 times the Energy. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps). When Bone Energy reaches 30, it forms a Bone Shard, up to 25 shards. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all Bone Shards strike the target, each dealing (7% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting 7% Attack Effects.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Abyssal Bone Needle
skills.description: Obsidia launches an Abyssal Bone Needle dealing 325 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and triggering Return to Bone on the first enemy hero attack.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Phantom Shadowmeld
skills.description: Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters Shadowmeld Form, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Hunt of Bone
skills.description:
Obsidia shoots Bones of Wrath, in the target direction, dealing 125 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit, and pulls herself near them. The Bones of Wrath then tether to the enemy, preventing Obsidia from moving more than 4 units away from them. The enemy cannot use displacement skills, and their movement will pull Obsidia along. During this time, Obsidia gains 5 temporary Bone Shard(s). This effect lasts 3s.
During this time, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving.  Phantom Shadowmeld is enhanced, with its duration increased to 1s and cooldown reduced to 33%.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Mystic Surge
skills.description:
Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent by using his Ultimate. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. At 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art.
Thunder: Converts 30% Max HP into Physical Attack at 10% ratio, adopting an assassin style.
Torrent: Converts each point of Physical Attack into 10 Max HP, adopting a tank style.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Sundering Strike
skills.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140-220 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240-440 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage. He can dash after striking.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Sundering Strike - Thunderflash
skills.description: Sora strikes four times, dealing 140-220 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240-440 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage. He can move freely during this skill.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Sundering Strike - Overwhelm
skills.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140-220 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies for 40%. He then lunges forward, dealing 240-440 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage, stunning enemies for 0.5 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Windstride
skills.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140-200 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional 140-200 (+8% Total HP) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 0.5 seconds. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Windstride - Thunder Rush
skills.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 120-180 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then summons a thunderstorm that hits for 120-180 (+6% Total HP) Physical Damage and slows them by 50% for 0.5 seconds. This skill can be cast again within 4 seconds if it hits an enemy.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Windstride - Skyfall
skills.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140-200 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies back to the landing point. He then smashes the ground and deals 140-200 (+8% Total HP) Physical Damage, knocking enemies airborne for 0.5 seconds. Successful its reduce the cooldown by 2 seconds.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Shifting Skies
skills.description:
Swipe left to ascend into Thunder for 10 seconds. Sora gains brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), dealing 140-200 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each strike.
Swipe right to ascend into Torrent for 10 seconds. After a brief delay, Sora pulls in nearby enemies and deals 250-450 (+8% Total HP) Physical Damage.
skills.notes:
* During his Ultimate:
** Thunder decreases Sora's interval between Basic Attacks.
** Torrent increases Sora's interval between Basic Attacks.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Heaven's Wrath
skills.description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 15 times, dealing 60-100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each hit. Sora can move freely during this skill.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Stormbind
skills.description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes the target area 5 time(s), dealing 100-150 (+6% Total HP) Physical Damage and briefly stunning with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Platinum Snap
skills.description:
Marcel's split soul, Clemar, enters the camera to freeze the moment. Marcel's Basic Attack deal 50 (+40% Total Physical Attack) (+40% Total Physical Defense) (+40% Total Magic Defense) Physical Damage. His Extra HP is converted into 1.5% Hybrid Defense.
Clemar automatically snaps photos of nearby enemy heroes, causing a brief Frozen Moment and dealing 20 + 5% of their Max HP True Damage (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.
skills.notes: *Frozen Moment (Ultimate level Crowd Control): Prevents a target from moving, and using Basic Attacks and skills, but does not interrupt skills, Blink, or Charge effects. Cannot be removed.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Framed Moment
skills.description: Clemar focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within 60%. After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 350 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Physical Defense) (+120% Total Magic Defense) Physical Damage to enemies within.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Tracking Shot
skills.description:
Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters Tracking Haste state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75% when moving toward an enemy hero.
Use Again: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the Framed Moment area remains at the original location.
skills.notes: *This skill's Tracking haste stacks with his ultimate's Tracking haste.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Golden Hour
skills.description:
Marcel and Clemar perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, Clemar takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters Tracking Haste state while inside the area. All other units are put into a Frozen Moment and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage).
Golden Hour resets the cooldown of Platinum Snap for each enemy hero.
Allied heroes with the Platinum Snap shield can move freely within the area.
skills.notes:
*Frozen Moment (Ultimate level Crowd Control): Prevents a target from moving, and using Basic Attacks and skills, but does not interrupt skills, Blink, or Charge effects. Cannot be removed.
*During the cast delay, Marcel cannot cast skills.
*The freezing area is cast by Clemar. During cast delay and until 1s after freezing area activated, Clemar will be outside the circle, at the position when casting started. Thus during that time:
*There will be no Platinum Snap passive (Clemar is outside and busy with ult)
*Framed Moment (skill 1) will be forced outside the circle (because it's on Clemar, not Marcel)
*Clemar will teleport to Marcel after he's done, and so will the skill 1. Then it will start doing Platinum Snap passive again.
*The field won't interrupt most channeling AoE skills such as Odette's Swan Song and Yve's Real World Manipulation. (Yve can still Tap or Swipe even if she was caught frozen in the field).
*Does not affect untargetable units. Therefore, heroes like Lunox can move freely under the effect of  Power of Order Brilliance. In addition, turrets will be interrupted when caught as well. However, if they are not within the field, they will still fire at enemies, but the projectiles will be temporarily frozen when they hit the barrier.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description:
Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.
Hirara has 2 Crimson / Death Energy. Casting a combo skill  consumes 1 Crimson / Death Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of Meisen-e. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.
Hirara only deals 30(+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Meisen-e
skills.description: Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing up two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Kaerazu
skills.description:
Hirara uses Kaerazu to unleash the Crimson Maple, dealing 150 (+65% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial Crimson Maple damage.

skills.heading: 1st + 2nd Combo Skill
skills.name: Infernal Torrent
skills.description:
Hirara enhances Meisen-e with the power of Kaerazu to cast a combo skill.
After casting the first joystick dash of Meisen-e, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the Crimson Maple damage and immobilizing enemies for 0.8s.

skills.heading: 2nd + 1st Combo Skill
skills.name: Falling Maple
skills.description:
Hirara enhances Kaerazu with the power of Meisen-e to cast a combo skill.
She becomes untargetable and immobilized for up to 1s.
After 0.6s, she deals 3 times Crimson Maple damage, and can then cast the second joystick dash of Meisen-e to end these states early.

skills.heading: Passive
skills.name: Merry Mark
skills.description:
Dori's skill damage applies a mark to targets for 4.5s. Hitting a marked enemy with a skill again detonates the mark, dealing 215 (+15*Hero Level) (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Each time Dori casts a skill, she gains 30% Movement Speed for 1s.

skills.heading: Skill 1
skills.name: Timid Courage
skills.description: Dori gains a 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) s shield for 3s, knocking back nearby enemies and dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

skills.heading: Skill 2
skills.name: Banner Twirl
skills.description:
After a short delay, Dori deals 300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the surrounding ring area, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
She also gains 15% Movement Speed for 3s.

skills.heading: Ultimate
skills.name: Starlit Parade
skills.description: After a short delay, Dori deals 360 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a large ring area, stunning them for 1s.
